AI.description: Master character artificial intelligence controller. Governs individual Goal-Oriented Action Planning (GOAP) precondition evaluation, sensory perception, order execution pipelines, squad mission targeting, combat arbitration, and movement coordination. Coordinates directly with [`Character`](character.md) for entity state, [`SensoryData`](sensorydata.md) for vision and awareness, [`AITaskSytem`](aitasksytem.md) for job/order priority stacks, [`Platoon`](platoon.md) for squad blackboards, and [`Blackboard`](blackboard.md) for collective tactical memory.

methods.getStateBroadcast: Returns pointer to outward `StateBroadcastData` reflecting animation actions, current posture, and dialogue state to external observers.
methods._notifyTaskComplete: Internal callback invoked when active motor action or GOAP task completes, advancing the task queue to the next sequential action.
methods.getHandle: Returns smart hand handle identifying parent Character actor in the game world.
methods.AI: Constructs the master `AI` controller for a character, binding outward state broadcast buffers and back-pointer to parent Character actor.
methods.~AI: Virtual destructor tearing down the GOAP task system, clearing target finder caches, releasing trading info, and unbinding from platoon blackboards.
methods.create: Binds core character subsystems (CharBody, Inventory, CharStats, MedicalSystem, Platoon) to this AI controller and initializes GOAP action repertoires.
methods.update4Frame: High-frequency per-frame simulation tick processing tactical reactions, incoming combat strikes, sensory perception updates, and motor movement directives.
methods.periodicUpdate: Low-frequency simulation tick executing Goal-Oriented Action Planning (GOAP) arbitration, re-evaluating long-term goals, checking food/hunger states, and updating job queues.
methods.periodicUpdate_KOed: Specialized low-frequency tick executed while character is unconscious, in a recovery coma, or playing dead, evaluating recovery readiness and awareness.
methods.sendMessage: Dispatches an inter-character AI communication message packet (e.g. help calls, crime alarms, surrender offers, social dialogue).
methods.load: Restores AI controller state, active tactical stances, and assigned jobs from savegame data.
methods.save: Serializes AI state, including active orders, tactical stances, permajobs, and slave state timestamps, to savegame data.
methods.underMeleeAttack: Combat notification callback triggered when engaged by a melee attacker, evaluating defensive retaliation, parry timing, and threat registration.
methods.underRangedAttack: Combat notification callback triggered when fired upon by ranged weaponry, identifying shooter trajectory and provoking cover-seeking or charges.
methods.chooseBestAttackTarget: Evaluates tactical combat stance and military engagement directive `chooseBestAttackTarget`, arbitrating friend-or-foe status and combat threat levels.
methods.setAggressionLevel: Evaluates tactical combat stance and military engagement directive `setAggressionLevel`, arbitrating friend-or-foe status and combat threat levels.
methods.getCombatTarget: Evaluates tactical combat stance and military engagement directive `getCombatTarget`, arbitrating friend-or-foe status and combat threat levels.
methods.iAmBeingMeleeAttacked_immediate: Evaluates tactical combat stance and military engagement directive `iAmBeingMeleeAttacked_immediate`, arbitrating friend-or-foe status and combat threat levels.
methods.iAmBeingMeleeAttacked_general: Evaluates tactical combat stance and military engagement directive `iAmBeingMeleeAttacked_general`, arbitrating friend-or-foe status and combat threat levels.
methods.wantGuardAggressionNeutralTargetCheck: Evaluates tactical combat stance and military engagement directive `wantGuardAggressionNeutralTargetCheck`, arbitrating friend-or-foe status and combat threat levels.
methods.isWithinChoppingRange: Evaluates boolean precondition query `isWithinChoppingRange` for Goal-Oriented Action Planning. Verifies whether character anatomical state, equipment, or environmental conditions satisfy requirements.
methods.setFunc: Registers a specific member function pointer evaluator for a GOAP state type, associating debug display name and dialogue speech triggers.
methods._setupGOAPFuncs: Static initialization function binding precondition evaluator function pointers to their respective StateType identifiers in `stateFuncs`.
methods.setTaskRepertoireFlag: Enables a behavioral capability bitflag in `taskRepertoireFlags` (e.g. permitting combat, healing, looting, or fleeing).
methods.clearTaskRepertoireFlag: Clears a behavioral capability bitflag from `taskRepertoireFlags`, prohibiting corresponding action categories.
methods.forceOrderInsert: Forces immediate high-priority insertion of a player or tactical order ahead of standard autonomous AI goals.
methods.stateIsTrue: Evaluates whether a specified GOAP world state precondition evaluates to true for a given subject entity or spatial location.
methods.addAIGoalsFrom: Parses and loads a package of AI goals from an FCS `GameData` template record into the character's active task system.
methods.isWithinGivenRange: Evaluates boolean precondition query `isWithinGivenRange` for Goal-Oriented Action Planning. Verifies whether character anatomical state, equipment, or environmental conditions satisfy requirements.
methods.getTaskSystem: Returns pointer to the `AITaskSytem` managing active, goal, and job queues.

methods.AIPackage: Initializes a new `AIPackage` instance. Sets default values for handles and nullifies pointers, preparing the object for configuration via its template data.
methods.~AIPackage: Destroys the `AIPackage` instance. Cleans up any child packages, specifically ensuring `leadsToPackage` is safely terminated if applicable, and unbinds from the platoon blackboard.
methods.activateAndSetup: Activates the AI package and prepares it for execution. This involves binding necessary platoon context and optionally triggering initial dialogs if an employer or target requires engagement.
methods.endPackage: Finalizes the AI package's lifecycle. It triggers the ending dialogue based on success criteria and initiates the transition to a successor package if `leadsToPackage` is configured.
methods.signalStart: Invoked when the package becomes the active operational focus. Base implementation typically updates internal state to flag successful startup sequence.
methods.signalEnd: Invoked when the package is preempted, completed, or cancelled. Facilitates graceful tear-down of active tasks, like unsetting destination markers.
methods.getMyTarget: Evaluates the intended target for a given character under this package's context. Often resolves handles like `missionTarget` to explicit instances if valid in the current loaded area.
methods.getLeader: Retrieves the designated leader driving this package's operations. This is frequently the platoon leader of the bound `squad`, but specialized packages might assign dynamic leaders.
methods.notifyMyTargetPathfindImpossible: A callback invoked by the navigation mesh subsystem when an assigned agent cannot find a valid path to its target. Typically triggers package abortion or fallback behaviors.
methods.getDesiredTravelSpeed: Determines the preferred movement speed constraint for the given character while executing this package. Modulates pacing, such as forcing walking speeds during patrols.
methods.notifyBetrayal: Processes a betrayal event relevant to the package, such as an employer attacking the contracted platoon. Sets the `wasBetrayed` flag and typically invalidates mission terms immediately.
methods.periodicUpdate: Tick method invoked during the blackboard update cycle to maintain package state. Handles time-gated logic, distance checks to towns, or dynamic requirement validation.
methods.assessNeutral: Evaluates if a target should be treated as neutral within the scope of this package. Allows packages to temporarily override standard faction diplomacy rules for mission targets.
methods.assessEnemy: Evaluates if a target should be forcibly treated as an enemy by this package. Overrides global diplomacy if the mission demands hostility (e.g. assassination contracts).
methods.wasASuccess: Determines the completion status of the package. This directly influences whether the active or passive ending dialogue plays during `endPackage`.
methods.save: Serializes the package's internal state into the provided save game block. Preserves vital handles like `missionTarget` and tracking variables across game sessions.
methods.load: Restores the package's state from a save game data block. Rebinds references to characters and towns using saved handles, reconstructing the mission context.
methods.iAmActivePackage: Checks if this specific instance is currently the highest-priority executing package on the platoon's blackboard. Important for conditional logic and UI indicators.
methods.getGUIData: Populates a target UI data panel with string representations and context details regarding this package's current task. Used to inform the player of AI goals.
methods.wantsRenewButton: Indicates whether this package type supports a manual "renew contract" interaction from the player UI, typical for mercenary hire packages.
methods.autoNotifyJobsPanel: Automatically pushes state updates or task name modifications to the squad's job panel in the user interface. Ensures player-facing goals remain synchronized with package state.
methods.showManagementPanelCallback: Callback triggered when a user explicitly interacts with the package's UI representation. Useful for opening specialized configuration dialogues if the package has advanced parameters.

properties.missionTown: Destination or base town target handle.
properties.key: Signal key enum identifying package category.
properties.unloadedMode: Behavior mode when platoon is streaming unloaded.
properties.endingDialogPassive: Dialogue script triggered on passive termination.
properties.endingDialogActive: Dialogue script triggered on active completion.

AnimationClass.description: Core skeletal animation controller and locomotion blending coordinator governing character poses, movement cycles, combat techniques, stumbles, and ragdoll transitions. Manages Ogre3D skeletal animation layers, motion smoothing filters, pain overlay blend masks, and physics ragdoll kinematics coupling. Interacts directly with [`Character`](character.md) for actor state, [`CharMovement`](charmovement.md) for locomotion velocity and steering, [`AppearanceBase`](appearancebase.md) for skeletal mesh scaling and body morphs, and [`CombatClass`](combatclass.md) for attack and parry sequence timing.

methods.create: Initializes the `AnimationClassAnimal` instance using character movement and appearance data. methods.rotationUpdate: Performs the per-frame rotation update logic. It calculates the necessary orientation changes based on the animal's turn speed and time elapsed. It additionally adjusts normal vectors if the character is in water and interacting with the ground. It sets the `_isTurningFar` flag if the required rotation exceeds a single step's delta.

AnimationClassBase.description: Core skeletal animation subsystem base class for characters and creatures in Kenshi. Manages skeletal bone queries, world-space and local-space bone caching, animation track blending across layered channels (`AnimationLayer`), root motion relocation, and playback timing synchronization with the locomotion kinematic controller (`CharMovement`).

methods.AnimationClassBase: Primary constructor for `AnimationClassBase`. Initializes master playback timeline (`masterTime = 0.0f`), playback speed scale (`masterSpeed = 1.0f`), orientation quaternion, and layer container.
methods.~AnimationClassBase: Virtual destructor stopping active animations, clearing animation layers, freeing bone transform maps, and unlinking from character movement controller.
methods.create: Binds locomotion kinematic interface (`CharMovement*`), allocates skeletal animation layers (LOWER, UPPER, OVERLAY, TAIL, EARS), and initializes bone transform cache.
methods.setVisible: Controls visibility of the underlying Ogre 3D mesh entity (`body`) and associated scene graph node.
methods.getVisible: Queries whether the mesh entity is currently visible.
methods.getCharacter: Retrieves owning `Character` entity linked to this animation controller via `movement`.
methods.setMasterTimeSpeed: Sets the global animation playback speed multiplier (`masterSpeed`), scaling playback rates uniformly across all active tracks and layers.
methods.getMasterTimeSpeed: Queries the global animation playback speed multiplier.
methods.getMasterTime: Retrieves the accumulated master animation clock time in seconds (`masterTime`).
methods.isVisibleEntity: Checks if the Ogre rendering entity (`body`) exists and is attached to a visible scene node.
methods.getBoneWorldOrientation: Computes world-space orientation quaternion of the named bone by combining scene node orientation with bone hierarchy rotation.
methods.getBoneWorldPosition: Computes world-space 3D coordinates of the named bone, applying parent node translation, skeletal rotations, and optional scaling factor.
methods.getHasBone: Queries whether the skeletal rig contains a bone with the specified name.
methods._getBone: Resolves an individual skeletal bone pointer (`Ogre::OldBone*`) by case-sensitive bone name string from the skeleton instance.
methods.getSceneNodePosition: Retrieves world position of the character's primary Ogre scene node (`node`).
methods.getSceneNodeOrientation: Retrieves world orientation quaternion of the character's primary scene node.
methods.getBoneLocalOrientation: Retrieves local orientation quaternion of the named bone relative to its parent bone.
methods.getBoneLocalPosition: Retrieves local position vector of the named bone relative to its parent bone in the skeletal hierarchy.
methods.getRootBoneWorldPosition: Returns world-space position of the root motion bone (`rootBonePosition`).
methods.getRootBoneLocalPosition: Returns local position offset of the root motion bone relative to the character scene node origin.
methods.getBoneInitialLocalPosition: Retrieves initial bind-pose local position of the named bone before animation deformation.
methods.getBoneInitialLocalOrientation: Retrieves initial bind-pose local orientation quaternion of the named bone.
methods.getBoneInitialWorldPosition: Retrieves cached bind-pose world position of the named bone from `boneInitialWorldPositions`.
methods.getBoneInitialWorldOrientation: Retrieves cached bind-pose world orientation quaternion of the named bone from `boneInitialWorldOrientations`.
methods.getOrientation: Returns current target character orientation quaternion (`desiredOrientation`).
methods.initBoneInitialWorldPositions: Traverses the skeletal hierarchy in bind pose, caching initial world-space bone positions and orientations into lookup maps.
methods.resetOrientation: Resets character scene node orientation and desired orientation quaternion to identity.
methods.setVerticalPosition: Applies a vertical elevation offset to the character's visual mesh and scene node (e.g. bed height, chair elevation, or water immersion depth).
methods.stopAllAnimation: Stops all active animations across all layers. If `hardStop` is true, immediately zeroes blend weights; otherwise initiates smooth fade-out.
methods.clearAllAnimationUT: Clears all animation layers immediately without thread synchronization locks (unsafe / internal use).
methods.getAnimationCurrentWeight: Queries the current blend weight [0.0, 1.0] of the specified `AnimationData` track.
methods.getTotalActionAnimationWeight: Sums the total active blend weight across all upper body and whole body action animation tracks.
methods.stillPlayingAnActionOrSomething: Tests whether an action animation (e.g. attack strike, lockpick, medical treatment, stumble) is actively playing and preventing transition to idle.
methods.getAnimation_Medic: Resolves the appropriate medical first-aid treatment animation track based on patient posture, height, and target limb.
methods.getAnimation_Lockpick: Resolves the appropriate lockpicking animation track based on lock mechanism height and character posture (standing vs kneeling).
methods.hasAnimation: Queries whether the mesh entity contains an animation clip matching the specified string identifier.
methods.getAnimationProgress: Calculates normalized playback progress [0.0, 1.0] for the active combat technique animation.
methods.getAnimationPlaying_animName: Searches all animation layers for an active `SingleAnimation*` matching the given internal clip name.
methods.getAnimationPlaying_datName: Searches all animation layers for an active `SingleAnimation*` matching the FCS template identifier string.
methods.getAnimationPlaying: Searches all animation layers for an active `SingleAnimation*` executing the specified combat technique.
methods.isAnimationPlaying: Queries whether an animation matching the specified clip name is currently active and blending with non-zero weight.
methods.getAnimationState: Resolves underlying Ogre `AnimationState*` for the named clip from the mesh entity.
methods.getAnimation: Resolves underlying Ogre `Animation*` definition from the skeleton instance.

methods.AnimationData: Constructor for the `AnimationData` class. Initializes an instance by decoding animation descriptors and setup properties from a provided database `GameData` structure.
methods.checkWeaponArms: Evaluates whether the animation is valid based on the character's weapon-wielding arm status. Returns true if the animation matches the arm requirements (broken/usable) compared to the current character state.
methods.checkModes: Determines if the animation's designated mode flags (such as combat mode and stealth mode) align with the requester's actual stance.
methods.scoreInjury: Computes an affinity score based on the leg injury level required by this animation. Compares the provided left or right leg health from requirements against the animation's defined min/max and ideal damage ranges.
methods.scoreSpeed: Generates a match score for how well the animation represents the character's target velocity. This utilizes a custom scoring curve normalized through a sigmoid-like logistic function that dampens deviations around the ideal speed.
methods.scoreCarryMode: Determines the suitability of the animation regarding the entity's carry state (carrying left, right, or being carried). Applies multipliers or penalties to the score if the requested animation fails to match carry configuration.
methods.scoreWeaponType: Checks if the equipped weapon classification on the entity aligns with the `weaponTypeFlags` bitmask of the animation. Used extensively in filtering combat swings and stances based on weapon weight class and grip type.

AppearanceBase.description: Base visual appearance and 3D mesh deformation controller for all characters and creatures in Kenshi. methods.AppearanceBase: Primary constructor for `AppearanceBase`. methods.activate: Activates the appearance subsystem, attaching Ogre scene nodes to the scene graph and enabling visual rendering updates.
methods.deactivate: Deactivates the appearance subsystem, detaching scene nodes from scene graph and disabling animation transforms and rendering updates.

AttackSlotManager.description: Tactical combat slot arbiter managing simultaneous melee engagement reservations around a defender. Enforces engine attack slot limits (vanilla default of 1 simultaneous attacker, moddable up to 5 via `MAX_NUM_ATTACK_SLOTS`), queues surplus attackers into waiting and circling states, detects slot timeouts, and notifies queued opponents via `informOfFreeAttackSlot` when slots become vacant.

methods.AttackSlotManager: Constructs the `AttackSlotManager` arbiter, binding the owning character and combat class references, and initializing all 5 `SlotData` records to empty null handles.
methods.~AttackSlotManager: Destructs the `AttackSlotManager` instance, cleaning up all `SlotData` elements.
methods.hasFreeAttackSlot: Checks whether there is at least one unassigned attack slot available under the active slot limit (`getNumAttackSlots`).
methods.addToSlotH: Claims an open attack slot for the requesting attacker handle. If the attacker already holds a slot, returns true; otherwise assigns the first vacant slot.
methods.freeSlotH: Releases the attack slot held by the specified attacker handle, clearing handle data and resetting the occupancy timer.
methods.freeAllSlotsH: Clears all 5 attack slots, releasing all reserved attacker handles and zeroing timers.
methods.getNumAttackSlots: Calculates the effective maximum number of simultaneous attackers allowed against this defender, taking into account global constants, race bonuses, and passive states.
methods.getMaxPossibleAttackSlots: Retrieves the engine-wide global upper bound for attack slots from `g_globalConstants.MAX_NUM_ATTACK_SLOTS`.
methods.periodicUpdate: Low-frequency update loop. Increments slot timers, detects dead or incapacitated attackers, frees abandoned slots, and notifies queued opponents via `informOfFreeAttackSlot`.
methods.update: Per-frame tick hook for attack slot adjustments.

properties.me: Owner character whose immediate combat perimeter is governed by this slot manager.
properties.combatClass: Parent combat coordinator controlling state machine transitions.
properties.attackSlotH: Fixed array of 5 engagement slot entries ($5 \times \text{0x28} = \text{0xC8}$ bytes: `0x010`–`0x0D8`), each holding attacker handle `who` and occupancy timer `time`.

methods.Blackboard: Constructs a new Blackboard instance and ties it to a target platoon. It initializes all the unordered maps and standard tracking handles required for AI routines.

methods.periodicPackageCheck: Evaluates queued packages based on a specified priority slice. Ensures packages are still valid for their given goal conditions and purges completed tasks.
methods.dialogEventsCheck: Validates and polls conditions matching current dialog hooks against incoming game events. Often transitions an NPC's behavior state depending on dialog outcome.
methods.resetAllTheStaticData: Clears global/static constraints from the blackboard states. Restores variables associated with static behavior markers to baseline.
methods.createNewPackage: Constructs a new `AIPackage` derivative based on `typeId` (such as `Package_OccupyTown` or `CannibalRetreatFromRaid`). Connects relevant callback functions.
methods._activateCurrentPackage: Suspends or clears the currently executing package, resetting local tracking flags. Replaces it with the provided new `AIPackage` reference.
methods._addPackage: Enqueues an AI task definition into the priority tier queues without immediately executing it. Allows complex queuing of behaviors over time.
methods.clearAllPackages: Iterates through `packagesMain` queues and terminates all pending or active routines. Used during platoon destruction or combat override.
methods._addFromData: Decodes a serialized behavior tree payload into local instances and loads them onto the active execution stack.

methods.getPackageList: Retrieves the underlying queue struct associated with a requested priority level from `packagesMain`.
methods.setContractJob: Extracts standard contract behavior from `GameData` by looking up the "AI contract" entry in the parameters unordered map. If validated, pushes down into `_setContractJob`.
methods._setContractJob: Assigns an overriding mercenary contract task at a specific priority. Halts lower priority goals.
methods.endContractJob: Concludes the currently active mercenary contract package. Triggers dialog/payment handlers for successful termination.
methods.isMissionComplete: Checks if the main directive tied to the squad's primary `AIPackage` has fulfilled its goal conditions.

BountyManager.description: Law enforcement, criminal offense, and judicial bounty manager in Kenshi. Embedded within `Character::crimes` at offset `0xF0`. Manages active faction bounties (`bounties`), witnessed criminal infractions (`committingCrime`, `crimeExpiry`), sovereign law-enforcement delegation (`_getBountyFaction`), temporary access authorizations (`_hasAccessPass`, `accessPassExpirationTime`), judicial incarceration sentencing (`prisonSentenceToServe`, `prisonSentenceBeganTime`), and police visual recognition thresholds (`getBountyRecognitionThreshold`).

methods.BountyManager: Primary constructor for `BountyManager`. Links the owning character entity (`Character* me`), initializes the faction bounty hash map (`bounties`), resets active crime tracking state, clears prison sentence variables, and sets default expiry timers.
methods.~BountyManager: Destructor for `BountyManager`. Clears all active faction bounty entries from `bounties` and releases associated memory.
methods.load: Deserializes faction bounties, criminal charges, prison sentence timers, and temporary access passes from a `GameData* state` record during game loading.
methods.save: Serializes active bounties, committed crimes, remaining incarceration sentence durations, and access pass timestamps into `GameData* state` for save games.
methods._getBountyFaction: Resolves the governing law-enforcement faction associated with faction `f`, mapping subordinate or allied factions to their parent sovereign authority.
methods._getHighestBountyFaction: Iterates across all active bounties issued against this character, returning the faction that has posted the highest bounty reward.
methods.getPercievedBounty: Calculates the perceived bounty value of this character from the perspective of an observing character (`whosLooking`), accounting for disguise effectiveness, faction allegiances, and recognition distance.
methods.getActualBounty: Returns the exact actual numerical bounty value currently registered against this character by faction `whosLooking`.
methods.getBountyRecognitionThreshold: Queries the minimum bounty threshold required for guards and police to actively identify and attack or arrest this character on sight (typically 10,000 Cats).
methods.getTotalBounty: Calculates the sum total of all active bounties across all factions currently wanted on this character.
methods.assignBountyForCrimes: Converts ongoing witnessed crimes into an official registered bounty under law-enforcement faction `enforcer`.
methods.unfairAddToBounty: Directly adds an arbitrary numerical penalty amount to the bounty issued by `enforcer` (e.g. scripted events or illegal smuggling bribes).
methods.clearBounty: Clears and forgives all criminal charges and bounty penalties issued by faction `enforcer` (e.g. after sentence completion, pacifier bribery, or expiration).
methods.setCrime: Sets active ongoing crime state on character (e.g. lockpicking, stealing, trespassing, assault), recording the victim faction and victim entity handle.
methods.notifyCrimeWitnessed: Triggered when an NPC witnesses this character committing a crime. Sets expiry duration, alerts nearby guards, and registers criminal offense.
methods.notifyPossibleCrimeWitnessed: Extends or refreshes potential crime suspicion timer when character is caught performing suspicious acts in guard line of sight.
methods.isCommittingCrime: Queries whether character is currently engaged in an active, ongoing criminal act (`committingCrime != NO_CRIME`).
methods.crimeToStr: Static helper converting a `CrimeEnum` value into a localized user-facing string description for UI display.
methods.getBountyForCrime: Static table lookup returning the baseline bounty monetary penalty (in Cats) assigned for a specific crime type.
methods.notifyPlayerClaimBounty: Records that the player character faction has turned in this wanted outlaw to faction `whosLooking`, awarding reward Cats and flagging bounty as claimed.
methods.bountyAlreadyBeenClaimedByPlayer: Queries whether the player faction has already claimed the bounty reward for this character from faction `whosLooking`, preventing duplicate rewards.
methods.notifyStartPrisonSentence: Commences a formal prison sentence under law-enforcement faction `law`. Locks character into prison cage, calculates required sentence hours from bounty, and records sentence start timestamp.
methods.hasAccessPass: Evaluates whether this character holds an active, unexpired temporary authorized access pass granted by faction `forFac` (e.g. visiting nobility or holy nation clearances).
methods.giveAccessPass: Grants a temporary authorized access pass from faction `who` valid for `minutes` in-game time.
methods.getPrisonSentenceInHours: Static calculation deriving required prison incarceration duration in in-game hours from total bounty penalty value.
methods.getBountyExpirationTime: Static calculation determining time in game hours until a low-level bounty naturally expires and drops off.
methods.update: Per-frame simulation update step. Advances crime expiration timers, checks natural bounty degradation, updates prison sentence progress, and expires temporary access passes.
methods.getGUIData: Generates localized UI datapanel label/value string pairs representing active criminal charges, highest bounty issuer, and reward sum.
methods.getGUIDataForAppend: Appends detailed breakdown of individual crimes committed against each faction to `outs` for extended UI inspect panels.
methods.getBountyExpiryStringForGUI: Formats a user-facing string detailing time remaining until active bounty expires, or 'Never' if permanent.

Building.description: Master architectural and structural simulation entity representing buildings, outposts, town gates, defensive walls, manufacturing facilities, and interior furniture items. Manages construction material delivery, construction progress tracking, structural dismantling, town ownership, power grid connectivity, Havok navmesh cutouts, PhysX collision hulls, Ogre3D scene node hierarchies, positional audio emitters, interior visibility culling, and character job/usage interaction nodes. Interacts directly with [`Town`](town.md) for settlement ownership, [`TownBuildingsManager`](townbuildingsmanager.md) for municipal infrastructure, [`BuildingInterior`](buildinginterior.md) for interior furniture layouts, [`DoorStuff`](doorstuff.md) for gateway/door security, [`UsageNode`](usagenode.md) for worker and craft station bindings, and child specializations ([`UseableStuff`](useablestuff.md), [`StorageBuilding`](storagebuilding.md), [`ProductionBuilding`](productionbuilding.md), [`CraftingBuilding`](craftingbuilding.md), [`FarmBuilding`](farmbuilding.md), [`WallBuilding`](wallbuilding.md), [`GatewayBuilding`](gatewaybuilding.md)).

CharBody.description: Motor controller and physical action execution layer in Kenshi. Embedded within `Character`. Bridges high-level AI decisions (`OrdersReceiver` and `Tasker`) to the physical game world by dispatching animations (`AnimationClass`), driving navmesh locomotion and crowd steering (`CharMovement`), triggering tactical combat actions (`CombatClassAI`), and managing atomic task lifecycles.

methods.CharBody: Primary constructor for `CharBody`. Initializes the virtual method table, resets target entity handle (`target`), clears stance flags (`gotItem`, `crouched`, `jogMode`, `amIdle`), zeroes delta frame timer (`frameTIME`), and nulls all active action and subsystem pointers.
methods.~CharBody: Virtual destructor for `CharBody`. Gracefully terminates and destructs the active `Tasker` action, destroys the attached `CombatClass` subsystem, unlinks parent character references, and deallocates base Ogre memory.
methods.create: Binds motion controller, AI decision subsystem, animation layer, owning character entity, and attribute stats to `CharBody`. Allocates and constructs the specialized `CombatClassAI` motor instance (size `0x2F8`), storing it in `combatClass`.
methods.update: Virtual per-frame motor update tick. Validates platoon assignment, synchronizes active action subject on the platoon blackboard, caches `frameTIME`, evaluates ragdoll state versus motorized locomotion, executes active `Tasker::runAction`, and triggers task completion or failure transitions.
methods.periodicUpdate: Periodic low-frequency motor and combat update tick. Forwards execution directly into `CombatClass::periodicUpdate()` to refresh weapon ranges, attack slot reservations, and sensory combat awareness.
methods.setCurrentAction: Creates and initiates a new atomic action of the requested `TaskType` targeting `RootObject* target`. Requests a task instance from `TaskRepertoire`, assigns it urgent execution priority (`TP_URGENT`), enqueues it into `taskSystemAI`, and triggers execution.
methods.getCurrentAction: Retrieves the atomic `Tasker` action currently executing within this body instance.
methods.getCurrentActionOrMessage: Retrieves the active action or pending message task currently bound to `currentAction`.
methods.endAction: Public interface terminating the currently running action and resetting motor state. Forwards call directly to protected virtual `_endAction()`.
methods.isIdle: Queries whether the character's physical body is currently in an idle resting state without active motor execution.
methods._endAction: Internal virtual termination routine. Invokes `Tasker::endAction(this)` on active task, releases task memory via destructor, and clears `currentAction` pointer.
methods.notifyBodyTaskComplete: Dispatches notification to `AITaskSystem` signaling that the physical motor component of the current task has concluded.
methods.notifyTaskComplete: Virtual notification dispatched when an action completes successfully. Signals `AITaskSystem` to advance high-level task queue progression.
methods.notifyTaskImpossible: Virtual failure notification dispatched when an active task cannot be completed due to environmental blockage, unreachable interaction slots, or missing items.
methods.notifyPathImpossible: Virtual navigation failure signal informing AI task hierarchy that pathfinding to target entity handle `h` has failed or navmesh connectivity is broken.
methods.getCombatClass: Retrieves the active `CombatClass` subsystem attached to this character body.
methods.isCrouched: Queries whether character is currently maintaining stealth sneaking or crouched locomotion posture.
methods.getUpFromRagdoll: Transitions character out of ragdoll physics simulation back into motorized skeletal animation, initiating specified recovery get-up animation sequence.
methods._move: Issues low-level locomotion request to destination vector `location` or interaction offset around target object `who`. Automatically adjusts approach offsets within weapon reach and switches movement mode based on sensory threat levels.
methods._patrol: Executes patrol route waypoint navigation within designated patrol area bounds and town perimeter. Computes patrol radii, updates steering target, and maintains squad spacing.

CharStats.description: Attribute, combat skill, racial bonus, damage curve, and experience points (XP) calculation engine for `Character` actors. Manages primary attributes (Strength, Dexterity, Toughness, Perception) and secondary proficiencies (Martial Arts, Melee Attack/Defence, Weapon proficiencies, Athletics, Stealth, Thievery, Crafting, Medicine, Crossbows, and Turrets). Governs movement dynamics (run speed, encumbrance penalties, swim speed, stealth speed), combat speed (attack/block timing, weapon weight penalties), damage scaling (cut, blunt, pierce, bleed), environmental weather hazard protection, and experience event dispatching. Coordinates directly with [`Character`](character.md) for entity state, [`MedicalSystem`](medicalsystem.md) for health and wound penalties, [`Inventory`](inventory.md) for weight encumbrance, and [`CombatClass`](combatclass.md) for attack selection and damage resolution.

methods.init: Initializes character statistics from savegame or template `GameData`, binding parent `Character` actor and `MedicalSystem` subsystem, loading racial baseline attributes and scaling coefficients.
methods._randomiseStats: Applies a random perturbation to all base attributes and skill values scaled by `amount`, providing NPC stat variance across generated squads and recruits.
methods.periodicUpdate: Low-frequency simulation tick evaluating hunger depletion, updating stat refresh timers, and recalculating speed penalties based on current health degradation.
methods.animalRecruitReduceStats: Scales down raw combat attributes when recruiting a wild animal into a player faction, balancing progression curves against animal age growth multipliers.
methods._recalculateStats: Internal virtual helper recalculating derived movement velocities, encumbrance speed multipliers, and weapon weight speed penalties following equipment or health changes.
methods.~CharStats: Destructs the `CharStats` instance, deallocating dynamic STL map tree nodes for `_weatherProtections` and `bonusRaces` via Ogre NedPooling deallocation before releasing base allocated object memory.

Character.description: Primary entity actor representing all humanoid and creature characters across the game world. Coordinates AI execution, combat, movement, anatomical damage, inventories, equipment, physics ragdolls, perception, and dialogues. Interacts directly with [`MedicalSystem`](medicalsystem.md) for anatomical limb damage and vital hitpoints, [`CharStats`](charstats.md) for attributes and skill calculations, [`AI`](ai.md) for Goal-Oriented Action Planning and jobs, [`CombatClass`](combatclass.md) for melee combat execution, [`RangedCombatClass`](rangedcombatclass.md) for crossbow targeting, [`Inventory`](inventory.md) for equipment slots and items, [`CharMovement`](charmovement.md) for locomotion pathfinding, [`CharBody`](charbody.md) for visual mesh and detached limbs, and [`Platoon`](platoon.md) for squad membership and command structures.

properties._base: Inherited base class state (world handle, transform scene node, scene placement; 0xC0 / 192 bytes: `0x000`–`0x0C0`).
properties.offscreenFrameTime: Accumulated delta-time when character is offscreen.
properties.bodyDecayTimer: Corpse decay timer tracking despawn progression.
properties._isOnARoof: Cached flag indicating character is standing on a building roof.
properties._lightLevel: Calculated ambient light level at character position.
properties.needsLightLevel: Flag indicating whether light level calculation is required.
properties.isVisibleUpdateMode: Flag enabling high-detail visibility update mode.
properties.setVisibleMsg: Queued message flag requesting visibility change notification.
properties.playerWantsMeToGetUp: Set when player explicitly orders a playing-dead character to stand up.
properties.crimes: Infractions, bounties, and arresting faction records (0xA8 bytes: `0x0F0`–`0x198`).
properties.currentSkillUsing: Skill currently earning experience (e.g. stealth, athletics, katana).
properties.stateBroadcast: Broadcast packet containing posture, law enforcement status, and faction alignment.
properties.isVisibleAndNear: Fast culling flag indicating character is near camera and visible.
properties.isOnScreen: Viewport culling flag indicating character is within camera frustum.
properties.disguiseGUIFeedbacks: Disguise recognition suspicion progress keyed by observer faction (64 bytes: `0x1B0`–`0x1F0`).

CharacterEditWindow.description: Plastic surgeon and character creation window. Provides procedural bone scaling sliders, muscle and bulk blend curves, posture options, race/gender selection, and mesh export/import. Coordinates an orbital preview camera ([`CharacterEditCamera`](#)), multi-character squad setups ([`Character`](character.md)), procedural skeletal morph blending, and disk persistence for `.bod2` body preset files.

methods.CharacterEditWindow: Primary constructor for `CharacterEditWindow`. Initializes BaseLayout XML interface, creates orbital inspection camera (`CharacterEditCamera`), sets up 3D viewport platform and lighting nodes, builds race/subrace tables, initializes multi-character array, and configures UI category buttons.
methods.~CharacterEditWindow: Virtual destructor deallocating 3D preview platform, releasing orbital camera controller, cleaning up temporary mesh clones and appearance dictionaries, and unregistering MyGUI listeners.
methods.update: Per-frame update tick for the character creation screen. Updates orbital camera interpolation, applies pending live character model rebuilds, and animates character idle stance.
methods.loadData: Loads race templates, sub-race definitions, mesh attachment lists, and morph slider definitions from game data.
methods.initCharacters: Initializes editable character array, populating default appearance records, cached poses, and initial positions for all squad members participating in new game setup.
methods.confirmButton: Handles the 'Confirm' / 'Done' button click. Validates character names, prompts for plastic surgeon fee confirmation in midgame mode, or commits changes and closes the editor.
methods.confirmMessageCallback: Callback dispatched from the confirmation message box when the player confirms or cancels changes in plastic surgeon mode.
methods.setupUI: Builds and attaches MyGUI widgets for name input, race cycling buttons, gender toggles, category tabs, and action buttons.
methods.setUIEnabled: Enables or disables interactive UI controls during camera transitions, file import/export modal dialogues, or character mesh reloading.
methods.refreshUI: Synchronizes all UI widget states, slider positions, labels, and text fields with the currently selected character's appearance data.
methods.nameChanged: Text input change event handler updating the character's display name string from `txtName`.
methods.prevRace: Cycles to the previous available race category, updating race display labels and filtering sub-race selections.
methods.nextRace: Cycles to the next available race category, refreshing sub-race options and reapplying race morph limits.
methods.prevSubRace: Cycles to the previous available sub-race variant within the active race group.
methods.nextSubRace: Cycles to the next available sub-race variant within the active race group.
methods.updateRace: Applies race and sub-race changes to the active character, rebuilding skeletal meshes, swapping base textures, updating race lore description, and synchronizing stat preview panels.
methods.changeGender: Toggles or cycles character biological gender (Male/Female), reloading gender-specific body meshes, animations, and morph ranges.
methods.changeAppearanceData: Swaps appearance data structures when transitioning between different races or genders, preserving proportional facial and body sliders where compatible.
methods.prevCharacter: Selects and displays the previous squad member in multi-character game setups (e.g. 'Nobodies' or custom squad starts).
methods.nextCharacter: Selects and displays the next squad member in multi-character game setups.
methods.updateCharacter: Switches the active character in the 3D preview platform, updating the character index label (`txtCharIdx`) and refreshing all sliders and labels.
methods.showCharacter: Controls visibility of the 3D scene entity for the specified character on the inspection platform.
methods.updateLiveObject: Requests an immediate refresh of the character's live in-world visual representation from updated morph settings.
methods.getCharacterEntity: Retrieves the Ogre rendering entity (`Ogre::Entity*`) for the character at the specified index.
methods.updateCharacterPoses: Updates and blends all skeletal vertex poses across the character mesh based on current posture slider values.
methods.clearCharacterPoses: Clears and resets all active vertex poses and posture animation tracks on the preview character.
methods.changeCategory: Switches the active slider category (e.g. Body, Face, Posture, Hair, Skin), updating category tab highlights and regenerating slider widgets in the scrollview.
methods.updateCurrentCategory: Instantiates and arranges the procedural slider widgets and attachment scrollbars for the currently selected morph category.
methods.resetAppearance: Resets all morph sliders, colors, attachments, and posture curves of the active character back to race default templates.
methods.updateAppearanceSlider: Callback handling single-value scalar bone scale morph slider adjustments, applying real-time skeletal transformations to the 3D preview model.
methods.updateAppearanceSliderPose: Callback handling posture and pose blend slider adjustments, blending Ogre skeletal poses and posture offsets in real time.
methods.updateAppearanceSliderVector: Callback handling 3D vector bone scaling adjustments (e.g. width, depth, height proportions).
methods.updateAppearanceList: Callback handling discrete attachment selection list changes (e.g. hair styles, beards, horns, markings).
methods.updateAppearanceMultiSlider: Callback handling multi-slider compound adjustments (e.g. paired left/right facial features or linked bone pairs).
methods.updateAnimationIdle: Switches the active idle animation pose demonstrated by the character model in the preview viewport.
methods.refreshCharacterPoses: Re-evaluates and refreshes posture blend animations across all characters in the squad.
methods.getCurrentHeadName: Retrieves the asset mesh name of the currently equipped head/face geometry.
methods.getCurrentAttachmentName: Retrieves the asset mesh name of the attachment assigned to the designated attachment slot (e.g. hair, beard, horns).
methods.setCurrentHeadName: Sets the active head/face mesh geometry for the character by index into the available head list.
methods.setCurrentAttachmentName: Assigns an attachment asset to the designated attachment slot by index into available assets.
methods.randomiseAll: Randomizes all morph sliders, body proportions, face shapes, skin tones, hair styles, and posture settings within the valid race limits.
methods.randomisePart: Randomizes only the sliders belonging to the currently active morph category (e.g. only randomize face features or only body sliders).
methods.importCharacter: Opens the file import dialog to load an exported character body morph preset (.bod2 file) from disk.
methods.exportCharacter: Opens the file export dialog to save current character body proportions, facial morphs, and attachments into a .bod2 file.
methods.loadImportedCharacter: Callback executed when the user selects a preset file in the open/save file dialog. Parses the .bod2 file and applies appearance attributes to the active character.
methods.toggleClothes: Button callback toggling underwear/clothing visibility on the preview character model.
methods.setClothesVisible: Directly controls clothing sub-mesh visibility on the specified character's 3D rendering entity.
methods.exportMeshes: Developer and modding export utility generating finalized skinned mesh assets to disk from procedurally scaled bone transforms.

CombatClass.description: Master tactical melee combat controller governing realtime weapon exchanges, directional swing trajectories, defensive blocking arcs, damage mitigations, and attack slot reservations. Coordinates directly with [`AnimationClass`](animationclass.md) for skeletal motion, [`CharStats`](charstats.md) for combat formulas and weapon skills, [`MedicalSystem`](medicalsystem.md) for anatomical trauma, and [`CharMovement`](movement.md) for combat spacing.

methods.CombatClass: Constructs the `CombatClass` melee state machine controller, binding subsystems for locomotion, artificial intelligence, skeletal animation, attributes, and medical trauma, while registering discrete state handler classes into `stateMap`.
methods.~CombatClass: Destructs the `CombatClass` instance, resetting targeting notifications, removing active attacker registrations, and releasing dynamically allocated `CombatState` objects in `stateMap`.
methods.setup: Initializes global static particle memory pools for combat effects (blood splatters, weapon sparks, dust clouds).
methods.destroy: Destroys and reclaims global static particle memory pools allocated for combat impact visual effects.
methods.initCombatMode: Enters or reconfigures active combat mode against an opponent target, establishing engagement timestamps, locking target handles, and synchronizing stance animations.
methods.getCombatState: Retrieves the active primary melee state enum from `combatState`.
methods.getBlockStateEnum: Returns the canonical `BLOCK` state enum identifier.
methods.setCombatState: Sets the internal `combatState` enum, terminating active attack animations if switching back into decision phase, unless currently locked in stumble.
methods.changeState: Queues a state change and enforces a minimum execution time window before subsequent state transitions can occur.
methods.getStateClass: Looks up the dedicated `CombatState` logic handler instance corresponding to the given state enum from `stateMap`.
methods._isInCombatMode: Returns whether the controller is actively engaged in combat mode.
methods.readyToFinishCombatMode: Queries whether combat mode is ready to terminate, verifying that the current state is `COMBAT_FINISHED` and any residual technique animation has completed past 99%.
methods.getTimeSinceLastCombatModeInHours: Calculates elapsed game simulation hours since the most recent combat mode activity.
methods.go: Main per-frame combat execution entry point. Updates dead timers, attack progress, target orientation, and advances active state machine logic.
methods.update: Dispatches execution to the current active state handler based on `combatState` (`CHOP_WEAPON`, `BLOCK`, `STUMBLE`, `DECISION`).
methods.periodicUpdate: Low-frequency tick updating attack slots, pruning invalid threat handles, synchronizing pointer-handle caches, and toggling ping-pong waiting counters.
methods.startupState: Evaluates initial transition out of idle into attack, block, or stagger depending on queued moves and incoming threats.
methods.attackState: Drives melee swing progression, monitors technique animation timeline, checks for emergency block interruptions, and executes impact detection at the strike window.
methods.attackImpactCheck: Evaluates weapon collision against the primary target and collateral cleave entities within the swing arc once animation enters the impact frame.
methods.isAttacking: Checks whether this combat controller is currently attacking the specified character, returning the normalized attack execution progress.
methods._isAttackingUpdate: Calculates internal attack progress value based on skeletal animation state, technique progress, or active stumble status.
methods.calculateTargetsInAttackZone: Sweeps a conical arc in front of the character based on weapon reach and technique cleave angle, populating `targetsInAttackZone`.
methods.isInAttackZone: Tests whether the specified character is inside the current weapon attack cleave volume.
methods.getNearestEnemyInAttackZone: Finds the closest hostile character situated within `targetsInAttackZone`.
methods._getAttackTarget: Returns the persistent handle of the current attack target.
methods.setAttackTarget: Sets the primary attack target pointer and dispatches mutual attacking notifications to manage engagement state.
methods.setAttackTargetHandle: Sets `currentTargetHandle` from the given character pointer, handling handle equality checks.
methods.lookatTarget: Adjusts root movement yaw orientation to maintain gaze and weapon alignment towards the target during combat exchanges.
methods.getAttackAimAdjustmentThreshold: Calculates aim adjustment angle threshold based on defender's melee defense skill contrasted against attacker's melee attack and active enemy queue depth.
methods.blockState: Executes defensive weapon parry or dodge posture, maintaining block alignment until the incoming attack clears or block animation duration expires.
methods.initialiseBlock: Selects and initiates a defensive blocking or dodging technique based on incoming attack cut direction, character weapon type, and dexterity/unarmed dodge stats.
methods.blockWaitingState: Maintains defensive ready stance while waiting for incoming strike to enter the parry window.
methods.canBlock: Evaluates whether character has functional arms, non-zero melee defense, and is not stunned or immobilized.
methods.checkForNeedBlock: Checks whether any hostile attacker within range is currently executing an attack past `thresholdIncomingAttack`, and verifies if our own attack is early enough to be aborted.
methods.notifyBlockNeeded: Signals that an incoming strike requires a defensive response, setting `wantsToBlock = true` and `nextMove = BLOCK`.
methods.stumbleState: Processes stagger animation countdown, decaying knockback velocity and testing whether character can recover into a block.
methods._iHitYouAreYouHit: Core melee outcome arbitrator. Determines whether an incoming strike connects with flesh, is parried by weapon/armor, is dodged, or constitutes a criminal assault against law enforcement.
methods._getHit: Receives a successful physical strike, breaking stealth, applying post-hit dead time, calculating total impact force, and queueing stumble knockback.
methods._blockHit: Processes a successful defensive block/parry, resetting failsafe timers and calculating block recovery dead time based on weapon deflection stats.
methods.informOfFreeAttackSlot: Polymorphic callback invoked by opponent's `AttackSlotManager` when a melee engagement slot opens up, prompting queued attackers to step in.
methods.youDoKnowImAttackingYouRight: Registers incoming attack intention from an opponent handle, appending to `notifiedThreats` to track hostile awareness.
methods.getAttackers: Provides direct reference to the list of opponent handles actively attacking this entity.
methods.getNumOpponents: Returns the total count of active hostile attackers currently engaging this character.
methods.getNumWaitingAttackers: Returns the number of surplus enemies queued for an available attack slot, querying the currently active alternator buffer.
methods.addAttackerH: Attempts to add a character to active direct attackers. If slots exceed limit (4 attackers), increments waiting counters and denies immediate slot.
methods.isInAttackerListH: Checks whether the given character is present in `attackersH`.
methods.removeAttackerH: Removes character from active attackers list, freeing an attack slot for waiting opponents.
methods.checkForBadHandles: Audits `attackersH` and `threatsH`, removing handles whose underlying character entities have died, despawned, or been deleted.
methods.getBiggestThreat: Scans an array of hostile threats, scoring them by proximity, active attack state, and combat relative power to pick the most dangerous immediate opponent.
methods.assessIncomingAttacks: Scans all registered attackers and populates output array with opponents currently executing strikes aimed at this character.
methods.getTotalRelativeStrengthOfAttackers: Computes aggregate combat strength of all engaging opponents based on active attackers and waiting queue depth.
methods.areYouFightingAndInNeedOfHelp: Computes distress score for AI ally reinforcement queries, evaluating health deficits, overwhelm counts, and unconscious states.
methods.isFightingAnAllyOfMine: Checks whether opponent character is currently targeting a member of our faction or squad.
methods.getCurrentTechniqueSection: Returns the tracked animation sequence section index of current technique.
methods.calculateCurrentTechniqueSection: Calculates multi-hit combo section index and intra-section normalized progress fraction from active skeletal animation clip.
methods.weaponReach: Calculates effective melee striking reach in engine world units ($0.5 \times \text{weapon length}$).
methods.getMeiMin: Returns minimum effective engagement inner radius (`MEI_MIN`).
methods.getMeiMax: Computes maximum effective engagement outer radius based on base `MEI_MAX` and equipped weapon reach.
methods.packPtrsToHandles: Serializes live pointers (`currentTarget`, `blockingTarget`) into persistent entity handles (`currentTargetHandle`, `blockingTargetH`) prior to save state writing or level streaming.
methods.unpackHandlesToPtrs: Restores live pointers (`currentTarget`, `blockingTarget`) from persistent entity handles (`currentTargetHandle`, `blockingTargetH`) following save loading or streaming sector unpacks.
methods.getCombatEffect: Queries game data container for visual particle effect blueprint matching the material collision type (blood for flesh, sparks for sword/metal).
methods.addEffect: Queues a combat particle visual effect to be attached to a specific character bone or spawned at a world position.
methods.shiftEffects: Shifts all active combat particle systems in world space when floating origin rebasing occurs.
methods.updateEffects: Flushes queued effect requests in `effectsToAdd`, spawning scene nodes and updating particle lifespans in `effectsPool`.
methods.isAI: Queries whether this combat controller instance is governed by AI automation rather than direct player commands.
methods.isStationary: Queries whether character is currently stationary in combat posture.
methods.hasFocusedTarget: Returns the locked focus target handle if manual target focus mode is active.
methods.gotMoreImportantThingsToDoThanFightingYo: Virtual heuristic query determining whether higher-priority AI packages (fleeing, healing wounded allies, extinguishing fires) supersede attacking the opponent.

properties._vftable: Virtual method dispatch table pointer resolving polymorphic combat methods (`isAI`, `attackState`, `blockState`, etc.).
properties.attackSlots: Internal attack slot manager instance arbitrating incoming hostile engagement slots (`0x008`–`0x0E0`).
properties.stateMap: Hash map associating discrete combat state enums (`CHOP_WEAPON`, `BLOCK`, `STUMBLE`) with state handler objects.
