properties.whenCanStopStumble: Minimum elapsed stumble time required before character is permitted to cancel stagger into a block.
properties.stumbleForce: Total physical impact magnitude ($blunt + cut + pierce + extraStun$) determining knockback severity.
properties.combatModeActive: Master toggle indicating active participation in tactical melee engagement mode.
properties.lastCombatModeTimeStamp: High-precision game timestamp of most recent combat encounter, used for out-of-combat decay.
properties._isAttacking: Normalized attack execution progress or execution status (-100 = ragdoll, -1 = stumble, 0.0–1.0 = attack cycle).
properties.inDeadTime: Dead time state flag freezing state transitions following heavy impact or swing completion.
properties.deadTimer: Active countdown in seconds before character can initiate subsequent combat actions.
properties.stateTimer: Elapsed simulation time accumulator for current combat state phase.
properties.currentTechnique: Pointer to FCS combat technique template defining animation set, swing trajectory, and damage multipliers.
properties.currentTechniqueHasFinished: Flag indicating technique animation has reached terminus or impact window.
properties.attackStartPos: World-space coordinates where current melee attack swing originated.
properties.frameTIME: Cached frame delta time in seconds passed down during simulation step.
properties.movement: Character locomotion controller driving root motion, directional facing, and spacing.
properties.ai: High-level decision engine supplying tactical goals, package overrides, and target priorities.
properties.animation: Skeletal animation blender coordinating strike transitions, recovery poses, and blend layers.
properties.me: Owning character entity possessing this combat controller.
properties.stats: Character attributes, skill levels (Melee Attack, Melee Defense, Dexterity, Strength), and weapon masteries.
properties.medical: Anatomical limb health, blood loss, and physical impairment telemetry.
properties.myRadiusX: Bounding combat collision radius governing weapon reach and spacing checks.
properties.blockingTarget: Active opponent whose incoming attack is being guarded against.
properties.blockingTargetH: Persistent entity handle referencing defended opponent for safe serialization.
properties.lastIncomingAttackComboSection: Tracked animation sequence index of incoming attack used to sync defensive parry timing.
properties.calculatedTargetsInAttackZoneThisFrame: Frame-cached validity toggle preventing redundant cleave sweep queries.
properties.targetsInAttackZone: Dynamic array of potential collateral cleave target handles within weapon swing arc.
properties.nextMove: Queued follow-up state enum scheduled for evaluation upon current state exit.
properties.attackersH: Array of persistent handles for all hostile characters currently attacking or targeting this entity.
properties.numEnemiesWaitingForMe1: Attack slot overflow counter (buffer 1) tracking enemies queued for an engagement slot.
properties.numEnemiesWaitingForMe2: Attack slot overflow counter (buffer 2) tracking enemies queued for an engagement slot.
properties.waitCountAlternator: Ping-pong buffer toggle alternating between overflow counters across update ticks.
properties.threats: Resolved pointers to active hostile characters within immediate tactical threat radius.
properties.threatsH: Persistent entity handles for active hostile threats.
properties.notifiedThreats: Hostile entities already notified of incoming strikes to prevent duplicate block alerts.
properties.currentComboSection: Multi-hit combo stage index currently executing within active animation clip.
properties.lastComboSection: Previous combo stage index used to detect section boundary events.
properties.lastSoundIndex: Audio trigger marker index preventing duplicate weapon swing sound effects.
properties.techniqueIntegrityCheckTimer: Failsafe timer aborting frozen or desynchronized animations.
properties.MEI_MIN: Minimum effective melee engagement distance (inner collision boundary).
properties.MEI_MAX: Maximum effective melee engagement distance (outer weapon reach boundary).
properties.MINIMUM_DISTANCE_TO_OTHERS: Personal space repulsion threshold preventing combatants from clipping into each other.
properties.BLOCKING_MEI_DISTANCE_MIN: Minimum spatial separation required to raise defensive weapon block.
properties.BLOCKING_MEI_DISTANCE_MAX: Maximum spatial separation beyond which incoming attacks cannot be blocked.
properties.currentTarget: Resolved live pointer to primary targeted opponent.
properties.currentTargetHandle: Persistent entity handle referencing primary targeted opponent (`0x298`–`0x2B8`).

CombatClassAI.description: Autonomous tactical combat decision engine extending [`CombatClass`](combatclass.md) with NPC AI behaviors. Implements tactical target selection, NavMesh line-of-sight raycasts, distance maintenance (`isInMeiDistance`), circling and strafing maneuvers (`circleState`), attack slot queue waiting (`waitState`), and priority arbitration (`whoAttacksYouOrMe`).

methods.CombatClassAI: Constructs the `CombatClassAI` controller, initializing base `CombatClass`, allocating the line-of-sight raycast tracer, and setting target tracking defaults.
methods.~CombatClassAI: Destructs the `CombatClassAI` instance, releasing allocated line-of-sight tracer objects.
methods.update: Drives AI combat evaluation tick. Updates line-of-sight raycasts to target, then dispatches to tactical decision, waiting, circling, or base attack/block handlers.
methods.periodicUpdate: Performs periodic maintenance tick. Calls base `CombatClass::periodicUpdate` and synchronizes target pathfinding requests through `CharMovement`.
methods.tracerUpdate: Casts a Havok NavMesh line-of-sight ray from character's collision capsule to current target, caching obstruction state into `targetTraceBlocked`.
methods.targetPathBlocked: Returns whether line of sight to current combat target is obstructed.
methods.decisionState: Core AI tactical branch arbitrator. Evaluates current animation status, picks or validates attack target, checks engagement spacing (`isInMeiDistance`), attempts attack slot acquisition, or transitions to circling/waiting.
methods.startupState: Initializes AI combat engagement, choosing an initial target and entering decision phase.
methods.isInMeiDistance: Tests whether spatial separation to current target lies strictly within effective melee engagement bounds ($MEI\_MIN \le \text{dist} \le MEI\_MAX$).
methods.waitState: Executes `WAIT` state handler from `stateMap`, maintaining defensive distance while queued for an available attack slot.
methods.circleState: Executes `CIRCLE` state handler from `stateMap`, strafing tangentially around the opponent while waiting for attack opportunities.
methods.hesitateState: Brief tactical pause state between combat actions, allowing AI to re-evaluate threats.
methods.attackState: AI melee attack execution override. Verifies target validity, evaluates emergency parry requirements via `checkForNeedBlock`, and advances swing execution.
methods.blockState: AI defensive block execution override. Maintains weapon parry or unarmed dodge alignment towards attacking opponent until strike resolves.
methods.informOfFreeAttackSlot: Callback received when opponent's attack slot opens up. Prompts waiting AI to break out of `waitState` or `circleState` and launch an attack.
methods.whoAttacksYouOrMe: Arbitrates initiative between this AI and an opponent when both seek to strike simultaneously, comparing dexterity, weapon speed, and combat dice rolls.
methods.chooseAttackTarget: Tactical target selection algorithm. Scans active threats, respects `focusedTarget` if locked, weighs distance vs threat score, and applies target change cooldown to prevent thrashing.
methods.gotMoreImportantThingsToDoThanFightingYo: Heuristic check against active AI package goals. Returns true if high-priority non-combat tasks (fleeing, healing dying comrades, urgent repairs) override engaging this opponent.
methods.initCombatMode: AI combat mode entry override. Sets `focusedTarget` and locks `reFocusableMode` if direct focus was requested.
methods.isAI: Returns true to indicate this combat controller is driven by autonomous NPC AI logic.
methods.hasFocusedTarget: Returns the locked `focusedTarget` handle if single-target focus mode is active.

properties._base: Inherited base tactical combat coordinator (0x2B8 bytes).
properties.tracer: Continuous line-of-sight raycast tracer querying NavMesh obstacle intersections between combatants.
properties.targetTraceBlocked: Flag indicating direct line of sight to current target is obstructed by geometry or closed doors.
properties.focusedTarget: Forced priority target handle assigned by high-level AI tactical goals (0x20 bytes: `0x2C8`–`0x2E8`).
properties.reFocusableMode: Toggle determining whether AI is permitted to dynamically switch targets based on immediate threat scoring.
properties.targetLastChangedTimer: Game timestamp of most recent target selection, preventing rapid target thrashing.

methods.~CombatClassPlayer: Pure virtual destructor for the `CombatClassPlayer` interface class. This ensures that any derived implementations properly clean up their allocated player-specific combat resources upon destruction.
methods.whoAttacksYouOrMe: Pure virtual initiative arbiter method. Determines whether the current player character or the targeted opposing character has the right of way to attack, factoring in player commands.
methods.update: Pure virtual per-frame motor update function. Subclasses must implement this to process continuous combat logic and handle active player command overrides like hold, block, and passive stances.

properties._base: Inherited CombatClass base coordinator (0x2B8 bytes).

methods.CombatTechniqueData: Constructs a new combat technique instance by parsing raw configuration data. This initializes all the properties of the combat technique using the key-value mappings present in the provided `GameData` definition.
methods.hasSkillType: Checks whether the combat technique applies to a given weapon class. It achieves this by reading from the internally parsed skill applicability bitmask.
methods.numImpactPoints: Retrieves the total number of distinct impact timings defined within this technique. This count represents how many consecutive strikes the animation contains.
methods.impactPoint: Accesses detailed parameters for a given collision frame in the technique animation. This uses pointer arithmetic over the internal `impactPoints` collection buffer.

properties.animation: Name of the animation resource for this martial art/weapon technique.
properties.isBlock: True if this technique functions as a weapon block.
properties.isDodge: True if this technique functions as a martial arts evasion dodge.
properties.stumbleDodge: True if executable while recovering from stagger.
properties.gainsGround: True if root motion steps forward toward target.
properties.isProne: True if attack sweeps low to the ground.
properties.hesitationPoint: Normalized animation point where attacker pauses to read defense.
properties.acceptableEndTime01: Normalized animation frame after which follow-up actions can queue.
properties.minSkill: Minimum required skill rating to unlock this technique.
properties.maxSkill: Skill rating where technique reaches maximum selection weight.
properties.maxEncumbrance: Maximum gear encumbrance before technique is locked out.
properties.maxTargetHits: Maximum targets cleavable by a single swing.
properties.skillTypes: Bitmask array of compatible weapon skill categories.

ContainerItem.description: Wearable backpack and storage container item. Extends [`Item`](item.md) and [`RaceLimiter`](racelimiter.md) with nested [`Inventory`](inventory.md) management, weight reduction scaling, athletics speed modifiers, combat skill penalties, stealth penalties, and race equipment whitelist/blacklist verification.

methods.ContainerItem: Constructs a `ContainerItem` instance, initializing base item states, reading backpack combat and speed penalties from the FCS blueprint, instantiating the internal nested `Inventory`, and populating race exclusion lists.
methods.~ContainerItem: Destructs the `ContainerItem`, closing any open GUI panels via `ForgottenGUI::closeInventory`, deleting the nested `Inventory`, clearing race sets, and invoking base item destructors.
methods.doubleCheckHandle: Validates that the container's handle is registered with the global `HandleManager`, repairing and re-registering the handle mapping if corrupted.
methods.getInventory: Returns the internal nested `Inventory` instance managing this container's stored items.
methods.createInventoryLayout: Instantiates a `BackpackInventoryLayout` GUI layout descriptor for rendering this container's grid in the player interface.
methods.getClassType: Returns the container item type enumeration code (`itemType::CONTAINER` = 0x2E).
methods.getPosition: Returns the spatial coordinates of the container: queries the wearing character's position if worn, or returns internal ground coordinates if dropped.
methods.setProperOwner: Updates the rightful owner handle on this container and propagates the ownership change recursively to all items stored inside the nested inventory.
methods.canEquip: Verifies whether a specific character race is permitted to equip this container, checking against the `racesExclude` blacklist.
methods.equipItem: Delegates equipment event notifications to the owning character (`callbackOwner`).
methods.unequipItem: Delegates unequip event notifications to the owning character (`callbackOwner`).
methods.dropItem: Delegates item drop requests to the wearing character (`callbackOwner`).
methods.takeMoney: Delegates currency deduction to the wearing character (`callbackOwner`).
methods.getMoney: Delegates currency balance inquiry to the wearing character (`callbackOwner`).
methods.getTooltipData1: Constructs GUI tooltip strings displaying backpack grid size, weight reduction factor, athletics speed multiplier, combat speed penalty, stealth modifier, and excluded races.
methods.getTooltipData2: Constructs secondary GUI tooltip strings for mercantile evaluation, trade pricing, and stolen status.
methods.serialise: Serializes the container item into a savegame record, serializing base item data and invoking recursive serialization on the internal inventory.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Restores container item attributes and inner inventory contents from a savegame state record.
methods._serialise: Low-level serialization routine recording item records and serializing the nested inventory as a linked instanced record.
methods._loadFromSerialise: Low-level deserialization routine restoring container properties and reconstructing the nested inventory from saved child records.

properties._base: Inherited base item state, transform, visual meshes, and physics actors (0x1E8 bytes: `0x000`–`0x1E8`).
properties._limiter: Inherited race restriction manager controlling race equipment eligibility (0x48 bytes: `0x1E8`–`0x230`).
properties.callbackOwner: Wearing character entity receiving equip, unequip, and currency transaction notifications.
properties.athleticsMult: Athletics movement run-speed multiplier while container is worn (e.g. 0.8f for a 20% speed penalty).
properties.weightMult: Encumbrance reduction multiplier applied to items stored inside this container (e.g. 0.5f for 50% mass reduction).
properties.combatSpeedMult: Combat animation attack and block speed multiplier (e.g. 0.9f for a 10% penalty).
properties.combatSkillBonus: Flat combat skill bonus/penalty applied to wearer while backpack is equipped.
properties.stealthMult: Sneaking visibility and stealth effectiveness multiplier (e.g. 0.7f).
properties.racesExclude: Hash set of character race FCS records prohibited from equipping this container (0x40 bytes: `0x250`–`0x290`).
properties.inventory: Pointer to internal nested inventory grid holding stored items.

CraftingBuilding.description: `CraftingBuilding` extends `ProductionBuilding` to implement Kenshi's item creation system, powering weapon smithies, armour workbenches, crossbow fletchers, leather tanneries, robotics benches, and medical craft tables.

methods.CraftingBuilding: Constructs a new `CraftingBuilding` workstation in the game world, initializing recipe queues, skill ceilings, and item category filters from blueprint data.
methods.~CraftingBuilding: Destructs the `CraftingBuilding` instance, releasing active recipe queue items, deleting in-progress item instances, and clearing input references.
methods.hasCraftingQueued: Evaluates whether the crafting queue currently contains active recipe orders awaiting fabrication.
methods.getCraft: Retrieves a queued recipe order item descriptor by zero-based index from the order deque.
methods._addCraft: Enqueues a new crafting recipe order at the tail of the production queue, instantiating the item blueprint and setting base fabrication time.
methods._removeCraft: Cancels and removes a recipe order at the specified queue index, refunding unprocessed raw materials.
methods.getAvailableCrafts: Collects all crafting recipes unlocked by the player faction's researched technology tree that are compatible with this workbench type.
methods.calculateCriticalChance: Calculates the percentage probability (0.0% - 50.0%) that the fabricated item will critically succeed to the next quality grade, based on the smith's skill exceeding the tier's minimum requirement.
methods.getCriticalSuccessWeapon: Resolves the upgraded weapon model tier record awarded on a critical success roll, advancing from Refitted Blade to Catun, Mk, or Edge Type.
methods.predictCraftersBestWeapon: Predicts the highest weapon grade a craftsman can produce at this workbench given their current skill level and workbench tier ceiling.
methods.playerManufacturerData: Retrieves the singleton FCS manufacturer template record representing player-crafted weapon branding and grade thresholds.
methods.getPlayerCraftedWeaponLevel: Computes the baseline weapon grade level for an item fabricated by player characters.
methods.createInventoryLayout: Constructs a specialized `CraftingInventoryLayout` GUI controller managing recipe selection buttons, queue lists, and input/output inventory sections.
methods.update: Simulation tick for the crafting workbench. Advances base machine state, checks operator presence, and refreshes the queue GUI.
methods.operate: Advances active recipe crafting progress under character operation. Checks power, consumes ingredients, rolls quality, and awards crafting experience to the operator.
methods.tryOperate: Validates whether a character can begin operating this crafting bench, verifying queue presence, material availability, and output clearance.
methods.givePower: Supplies electrical wattage to motorized workbenches (e.g. robotic smithies or electric smelters).
methods.updateOutput: Accumulates recipe fabrication progress; upon reaching 100%, generates the finished item, executes quality rolls, applies critical model bonuses, and handles repeat queue looping.
methods.addFinishedCraftItem: Deposits a newly fabricated item into the workbench output section or drops it on the floor if output space is filled.
methods.notifyCraftFailiure: Triggers an audible notification and UI status message indicating fabrication has stalled due to missing raw materials.
methods.destroyProductionItem: Destroys the temporary physical item template used during the crafting cycle.
methods.setupFromData: Parses the FCS `BUILDING_FUNCTIONALITY` record, loading craftable item type filters, skill ceilings, and recipe categories.
methods.setProductionItem: Sets the active production item to match the current recipe order at the head of the queue.
methods.updateInventoryWindow: Synchronizes the crafting GUI window, updating recipe queue listboxes, progress bars, and material requirements.
methods.isProductionFull: Evaluates whether the output section has sufficient room to accept the largest item in the current recipe queue.
methods.getProductionItemData: Resolves the item blueprint record for the recipe currently being crafted at the head of the queue.
methods.getCurrentProductionQuantity: Returns the count of finished items resting in the output inventory grid.
methods.isAnyInputsInvalidType: Verifies that items resting in input inventory sections match ingredients demanded by the active recipe queue.
methods.getItemsWeWantRidOf: Populates a list of finished crafted equipment ready to be hauled away to storage bins.
methods.canHaveSomeOfThese: Determines whether this workbench can accept the proposed item blueprint during hauling deposits, matching against ingredients for all queued recipes.
methods.newCraftingButton: MyGUI click event callback opening the recipe selection modal dialog.
methods.getGUIData: Renders telemetry data to the HUD Datapanel, displaying active crafting recipe name, completion percentage, and craftsman name.
methods.getGUIState: Renders current operational state string (e.g. "Crafting", "Queue Empty", "No Materials", "Output Full") to the HUD.
methods.serialise: Serializes recipe queue orders, progress percentages, repeat flags, and active craftsman handles into savegame delta records.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Restores recipe queue orders, progress percentages, and repeat flags from serialized savegame records.

properties._base: Inherited industrial production machine state (`0x490` bytes).
properties.maxCraftLevel: Maximum skill ceiling supported by this tier of crafting workbench.
properties.crafting: Queued crafting recipe orders scheduled by the player.
properties.specialCraftItemType: Specific item type filter restricting craftable categories (e.g. `WEAPON`, `ARMOUR`, `CROSSBOW`).
properties.repeat: Loop toggle re-adding finished recipes to the queue tail indefinitely.
properties.whosCrafting: Persistent runtime handle of the craftsman character currently operating the bench.
properties.itemCrafted: Flag set upon successful recipe cycle completion.
properties.failiureNotified: Flag suppressing duplicate UI notifications when missing raw materials.
properties.biggestCraftableItem: Size reference item record used for inventory footprint validation.
properties.outItem: Concrete finished physical product instance under construction.
properties.inItems: Specific physical material items claimed from inventory during the active crafting cycle.

Crossbow.description: Ranged weapon class extending `Weapon`. Implements properties for bolts, max range, and entity representation for equipping logic.

methods.~Crossbow: Cleans up resources for the `Crossbow` and destroys the `GunClassPersonal` components.
methods.isCrossbow: Runtime type identification method returning `this` pointer cast to Crossbow.
methods.getClassType: Returns the fundamental item classification logic enum for inventory operations.
methods.getCraftMaterialMult: Retrieves the material cost multiplier when crafting this crossbow. Modifies the required resources for manufacturing based on object tier.
methods.getCraftTime: Calculates the time duration required to craft the base `Crossbow` object, scaling by tier and workbenches.
methods.getRangeInUnits: Fetches the maximum effective range of the crossbow based on the currently initialized `gunClass`.
methods.getTooltipData2: Collects auxiliary text for the tooltip generation including localized descriptors or secondary attributes.

Damages.description: The `Damages` struct is Kenshi's core value-type data structure representing multi-channel physical trauma payloads. It is constructed during combat attacks, passed across animation hit callbacks, mitigated by armour calculations, and applied to character anatomical health systems.

methods.~Damages: Destructor for the damage payload. Deallocates resources if allocated via Ogre's memory pool policy.
methods.multiply: Scales the primary physical damage channels (`cut`, `blunt`, `pierce`, and `extraStun`) in-place by the specified multiplier. Does not scale `bleedMult` or `armourPenetration`. Used for critical strike multipliers, strength scaling, and body part toughness degradation.
methods.total: Calculates the absolute aggregate raw hitpoint damage represented by this payload by summing `cut`, `blunt`, and `pierce`. Used for floating combat text numbers, weapon tooltip comparisons, and threat aggregation calculations.

properties.cut: Lethal laceration and slicing damage. Direct contributor to open flesh wounds and immediate bleeding rates.
properties.blunt: Non-lethal concussive trauma. Contributes to temporary KO thresholds, unconsciousness time, and limb shock.
properties.pierce: High-velocity ballistic/harpoon penetration damage. Pierces armor plating with specialized damage mitigation curves.
properties.extraStun: Additional stun damage applied directly to character incapacitation meters without reducing structural hitpoints.
properties.bleedMult: Scalar multiplier applied to the target's bleeding rate calculation when laceration occurs. Default is `1.0f`.
properties.armourPenetration: Percentage factor (`0.0f` to `1.0f`) that bypasses the target's equipped armor defense layers during mitigation.

Faction.description: Political superstructure governing diplomatic reputation scores, sovereign territorial biomes, military squad rosters, law enforcement alliances, economic trade cultures, and war campaigns. Interacts directly with [`FactionManager`](factionmanager.md) for global faction registration, [`Platoon`](platoon.md) for military and civilian squad simulation, [`Character`](character.md) for individual entity allegiance, [`FactionRelations`](factionrelations.md) for pairwise diplomatic standings, [`FactionWarMgr`](factionwarmgr.md) for military assaults, [`TradeCulture`](tradeculture.md) for contraband and tariffs, and [`FactionLeader`](factionleader.md) for political leadership hierarchies.

methods.Faction: Primary constructor initializing faction political identity, allocating active and unloaded platoon containers, and initializing trade culture, racial fitness selectors, and diplomatic relations.
methods.~Faction: Virtual destructor releasing all active squads, unloading background platoons, destroying diplomatic relations tables, and unregistering from the global FactionManager.
methods.clearAndDestroy: Purges all squads, resets relations, and clears building swaps, resetting the faction to a blank uninstantiated state.
methods.setup: Stage 1 setup: parses FCS faction record, configures racial distribution tables, law enforcement alliances, rank titles, and building swap rules.
methods.setup2: Stage 2 setup: initializes trade culture, contraband policies, and links diplomatic relations with other recognized factions.
methods.setup3: Stage 3 setup: binds AI strategic packages, spawns initial diplomatic pacifiers, and resolves home territory biomes.
methods.getData: Retrieves the underlying FCS `GameData` template record defining this faction's attributes.
methods.isThePlayer: Queries whether this faction instance represents the user's player faction (the Nameless).
methods.isNotARealFaction: Queries whether this faction is a pseudo-faction placeholder used for wild fauna, wandering drifters, or neutral unaligned entities.
methods.getName: Retrieves the localized display name of the faction.
methods.setName: Sets the faction name string and updates UI header references.
methods.getNewPlatoonID: Generates a unique persistent platoon ID string using the faction's internal sequence counter.
methods.resetPlatoonID: Resets the internal platoon ID sequence counter back to zero.
methods.createNewEmptyUnloadedPlatoon: Creates a new empty unloaded platoon tracked in the background simulation without instantiating physical characters.
methods.createNewEmptyActivePlatoon: Creates a new empty active platoon directly in the live world reality.
methods.createPlatoonUnloaded: Creates and registers an unloaded platoon from serialized savegame state data.
methods.createPlatoonAuto: Automatically resolves whether to spawn a platoon as active or unloaded based on proximity to player camera and active zone chunks.
methods.createPlatoonsAuto: Batch spawns a collection of squad templates across the faction's sovereign territory.
methods.createReplacementPlatoonForPlayerWhenSav: Emergency recovery method constructing a fallback squad for the player if savegame corruption destroyed active squads.
methods.restorePlatoon: Restores a deregistered or serialized platoon back into the faction's active or unloaded rosters.
methods.resetSquadPositions: Resets spatial positions of all squads belonging to this faction around target coordinates (e.g. Reset Squad Position savegame option).
methods.destroyPlatoon: Queues a platoon for immediate or deferred destruction, queuing its members for cleanup.
methods.removePlatoon: Removes a platoon from active and unloaded rosters without deleting the object.
methods._newPlatoon: Internal protected factory method allocating a new `Platoon` instance and initializing its internal squad state.
methods._addActivePlatoonToList: Appends an active platoon to the live active squads vector.
methods.addPlatoon: Enrolls a newly instantiated platoon into the faction's managed collections.
methods.changePlatoonIndex: Reorders a platoon within the squad hierarchy index (used when player rearranges squads in the squad management UI).
methods.spawnSquadMissionsUpdate: Periodic evaluation updating roaming patrol squads, caravans, and war raid campaign spawns.
methods._spawnASquad: Internal helper spawning a squad from a named FCS spawn list with a designated size multiplier.
methods.countPopulation: Calculates total living population count across all squads stationed in or assigned to a specific town.
methods.countNumSquads: Counts number of instantiated squads matching a specific template assigned to a town.
methods._activateUnloadedPlatoons: Scans unloaded platoons and activates any squad whose coordinates intersect an active, streamed zone chunk.
methods.choosePlatoon: Selects a suitable active platoon for an assigned character or roaming recruit.
methods.getActivePlatoons: Returns pointer to vector of all currently active (streamed into 3D world) platoons.
methods.getUnloadedPlatoons: Returns pointer to vector of all unloaded (background simulated) platoons.
methods.getFactionSize: Computes aggregate total population of the entire faction across all active and unloaded platoons.
methods.getNumPlatoons: Retrieves the count of platoons matching a squad template, optionally filtering for temporary squads and home town origin.
methods.getAllActiveSquads: Returns pointer to immutable list of all active squad references.
methods._switchToUnloadedPlatoon: Internal helper transferring an active platoon pointer from activePlatoons to unloadedPlatoons.
methods.deactivatePlatoon: Deactivates an active platoon whose chunk is unloading, serializing character states and converting to abstract unloaded simulation.
methods.activatePlatoon: Activates an unloaded platoon, instantiating 3D character entities, physical ragdolls, and weapons into the active world reality.
methods.getCharactersInArea: Finds all faction member characters within a spatial spherical radius around given world coordinates.
methods.getSelectedObjects: Collects player-selected or type-filtered root objects belonging to this faction.
methods.removeObject: Removes an entity object from its containing platoon and faction rosters.
methods.destroyObject: Destroys an entity object and unregisters it from all squads.
methods.processKillList: Processes the deferred kill list, executing teardown and freeing memory for deceased units and deleted squads.
methods.addActiveObject: Enrolls an active entity (character or animal) into the specified active platoon.
methods.getSquadThatOwns: Finds the primary resident squad that owns or is garrisoned in a specified building.
methods.getAllSquadsThatOwn: Collects all squads claiming ownership or residency rights inside the specified building.
methods.update: Main simulation frame update tick: advances faction game time, evaluates active squad AI, processes kill lists, and updates war campaigns.
methods.periodicUpdateThreaded: Threaded background simulation update tick processing time-sliced movement and tasks for unloaded squads.
methods.periodicUpdateMT: Main thread periodic update committing results of threaded unloaded squad processing into main simulation state.
methods.updateUnloadedPlatoons: Updates unloaded squad virtual navigation, territorial patrols, and hunger/healing rates.
methods.updateActivePlatoons: Updates active squad logic, verifying member coherence, pathfinding progress, and combat states.
methods.getFundamentalNPCType: Retrieves the baseline character archetype classification (e.g. HUMAN, MILITARY, LAW_ENFORCEMENT, ANIMAL) for spawned members.
methods.getProsperityMultiplier: Retrieves the economic prosperity multiplier modifying town vendor wealth and squad equipment quality.
methods.getRandomLockLevel: Calculates lockpick difficulty level for chests and doors owned by this faction based on technological tier.
methods.getGUIData: Populates UI inspector panel with diplomatic status, population statistics, and active military campaigns.
methods.getDefaultDivision: Retrieves default military division FCS record configuring equipment uniforms and weaponry.
methods.getFactionColorScheme: Retrieves the faction's uniform primary and secondary color palette definition for dyed armor.
methods.getRoadPreference: Retrieves the road-following pathfinding preference weight for squads of this faction (higher values favor roads over cross-country terrain).
methods.isAntiSlavery: Queries whether the faction holds an ideological anti-slavery stance (causes hostility toward slave traders and frees slaves).
methods.getLawEnforcementFaction: Retrieves pointer to allied faction responsible for enforcing law, policing crimes, and holding prisoners in this faction's settlements.
methods.chooseARace: Selects a character race from the faction's weighted racial distribution table when generating new squad recruits.
methods.getBuildingReplacement: Returns replacement building blueprint for architectural style overrides when taking over towns.
methods.loadState: Restores faction diplomatic relations, active squad rosters, and leadership states from savegame data.
methods.saveState: Serializes faction reputation scores, alive squads, leadership status, and discovered territory into savegame records.

properties.characteristicsData: Flee ratios and behavioral traits (12 bytes: `0x00C`–`0x018`).
properties.ranks: Military and civic rank hierarchy identifiers (24 bytes: `0x018`–`0x030`).
properties.allowSlavesWeapons: Flag permitting slaves to bear arms.
properties.fundamentalNPCType: Default archetype for spawned faction members (4 bytes: `0x034`–`0x038`).
properties.myLawEnforcementFaction: Allied law enforcement jurisdiction pointer (8 bytes: `0x038`–`0x040`).
properties.isALawEnforcementFaction: Police authority flag granting crime arrest rights.
properties.factionLeader: Leader character entity, territory biomes, and worst enemy (40 bytes: `0x048`–`0x070`).
properties.diplomatMgr: Unique NPC and pacifier squad coordinator (8 bytes: `0x070`–`0x078`).
properties.relations: Pairwise diplomatic reputation score table (8 bytes: `0x078`–`0x080`).
properties.factionOwnerships: Faction asset ledger, shared cats, and slave registry (8 bytes: `0x080`–`0x088`).
properties.warMgr: Military raid and campaign orchestrator (8 bytes: `0x088`–`0x090`).
properties.tradeCulture: Economic culture, illegal contraband, and price multipliers (184 bytes: `0x090`–`0x148`).
properties.raceSelector: Weighted racial distribution table for recruitment (96 bytes: `0x148`–`0x1A8`).
properties.name: Faction identifier name (40 bytes: `0x1A8`–`0x1D0`).
properties.platoonKillList: Squads scheduled for deferred destruction (24 bytes: `0x1D8`–`0x1F0`).
properties.activePlatoons: Live instantiated squad list in active reality (24 bytes: `0x208`–`0x220`).
properties.periodicUpdateCounter_active: Round-robin tick counter for active squads (4 bytes: `0x238`–`0x23C`).
properties.periodicUpdateCounter_unloaded: Round-robin tick counter for unloaded squads (4 bytes: `0x23C`–`0x240`).
properties.data: FCS faction template record pointer (8 bytes: `0x240`–`0x248`).
properties.isAI: AI strategic decision package pointer (8 bytes: `0x248`–`0x250`).
properties.spawnTimeStamp: Timestamp of last recruit spawn wave (4 bytes: `0x258`–`0x25C`).
properties.diplomatTimeStamp: Timestamp of last pacifier interaction (4 bytes: `0x25C`–`0x260`).
properties.platoonPeriodicUpdateIndex: Current squad index in time-sliced update loop (4 bytes: `0x268`–`0x26C`).
properties.buildingSwaps: Town override building swap rules (24 bytes: `0x270`–`0x288`).

FactionRelations.description: Diplomatic matrix manager maintaining pairwise reputation values (-100.0 to +100.0), ally thresholds, permanent enemy states, and hostility calculations.

methods.~FactionRelations: Destructs the `FactionRelations` instance and releases allocated resources.
methods.update: Executes simulation and state update tick for `FactionRelations`.

properties.owner: Faction entity owning this diplomatic relations table.
properties.relations: Pairwise diplomatic standing scores from -100.0 to +100.0.
properties.defaultRelation: Baseline standing score with unlisted factions.
properties.allies: Cached list of allied factions standing >= +50.0.

FactionWarMgr.description: Military offensive campaign manager evaluating town threat levels, muster quotas, raid cooldowns, and tactical assault execution.

methods.~FactionWarMgr: Destructs the `FactionWarMgr` instance and releases allocated resources.
methods.periodicUpdate: Executes simulation and state update tick for `FactionWarMgr`.

properties.owner: Faction entity owning this war manager.
properties.activeCampaigns: Currently marching or assaulting military campaigns.
properties.pendingRequests: Queued campaign requests awaiting squad mobilization.
properties.townThreatLevels: Aggregated danger ratings for candidate target settlements.
properties.lastCampaignLaunchTime: Timestamp of most recently mobilized war party.
properties.campaignCooldownHours: Minimum mandatory interval between consecutive offensive raids.
properties.maxSimultaneousCampaigns: Hard concurrency limit on active expeditions.
properties.assignedForces: Character handles committed to ongoing war operations.

FarmBuilding.description: `FarmBuilding` powers wheatstraw fields, greenfruit patches, cotton crops, hemp farms, cactus gardens, and riceweed paddies across Kenshi's diverse biomes.

methods.FarmBuilding: Constructs a new `FarmBuilding` crop field or hydroponic tray, evaluating local soil fertility, setting up foliage shaders, and initializing plant batches.
methods.~FarmBuilding: Destructs the `FarmBuilding` instance, unregistering plant meshes from the batch coordinator and releasing interaction collision hulls.
methods.createPhysical: Creates physical collision geometry and instantiates procedural 3D plant specimens across the field grid.
methods.destroyPhysical: Removes all plant mesh instances and deletes interaction collision hulls when the field is dismantled or unloaded.
methods.setVisible: Toggles visibility of foliage submeshes and ground click hulls.
methods.update: Simulates botanical growth, deducting water from the reservoir, tracking drought timers, scaling 3D plant models, and evaluating crop death.
methods.needsUpdate: Queries whether this agricultural field requires per-frame simulation updates.
methods.operate: Executes manual agricultural labor. When crops are mature, harvests produce into the output section. When crops are dead, clears withered stalks to prepare for replanting.
methods.destroyAPlant: Destroys a single plant specimen instance due to pest grazing, animal feeding, or drought damage.
methods.timeSkip: Accelerates crop simulation across large elapsed time intervals (e.g. during fast travel or loading unloaded zones).
methods._updateInputs: Deducts water from the farm's input reservoir proportional to active crop consumption rates.
methods.eat: Called when wild animals or starving bandits graze upon the crop field, damaging crops and consuming nutrition.
methods.isCropsEdible: Queries whether the crop species cultivated in this field is edible by animals or starving characters in raw form.
methods.resetFarm: Resets field maturity, death ratios, and clearing progress to zero, preparing the soil for the next planting cycle.
methods.getYieldChancePerCrop: Computes environmental yield probability for a crop species given biome climate, soil moisture, and ground fertility.
methods.getCropMult: Retrieves the environmental growth rate multiplier for the specified crop species in this zone.
methods.getFertilityMultiplier: Evaluates the scaled fertility coefficient for a crop blueprint under local environmental conditions.
methods.setupMiningResourceLevel: Samples local terrain fertility and subterranean water tables at the field's world coordinates.
methods.setupMaterial: Clones dynamic foliage shader materials to allow unique color tints and wilted drought appearances.
methods.updateMaterial: Updates foliage shader parameters, tinting plants brown when suffering drought and scaling mesh vertices as plants mature.
methods.updatePlantInstance: Synchronizes 3D transform and scale for an individual plant mesh instance based on maturity.
methods.createPlants: Instantiates batched plant meshes across the field's grid rows.
methods.createClickHull: Builds the invisible interaction bounding volume used for mouse picking and order targeting.
methods.createEntity: Creates the primary OGRE scene node and mesh entity representing field fencing or hydroponic basin structures.
methods.isAnyInputsEmpty: Queries whether the field's water reservoir is completely dry, signaling logistics haulers to fetch water wells.
methods.isProductionFull: Evaluates whether the harvested crop output container is filled to capacity.
methods.howMuchPowerDoYouWantForSortingFunction: Determines electrical power priority sorting weight for hydroponic artificial sun lamps.
methods.dontNeedWorkRightNow: Evaluates whether farmer characters can operate this field right now. Returns `true` (no work needed) while crops are still growing and water is satisfied.
methods.getDirectionMarker: Computes navigation orientation markers guiding farmers toward available crop rows.
methods.upgrade: Upgrades field scale or converts traditional outdoor field to an enclosed hydroponic facility.
methods.getGUIData: Renders telemetry readouts to the HUD Datapanel, displaying crop maturity percentage, environmental fertility, and water levels.
methods.getGUIEfficiency: Renders active growth speed percentage to the HUD panel.
methods.getGUIWorkers: Renders active farmer count and capacity to the HUD.
methods.getGUIState: Renders current operational botanical state (e.g. "Growing", "Ready for Harvest", "Drought", "Dead Crops", "Output Full") to the HUD.
methods.getGUIFertility: Renders environmental soil fertility ratings to the Datapanel.

GameData.description: Universal object-relational data model record for the Kenshi engine and Forgotten Construction Set (FCS). Encapsulates typed primitive dictionaries (bool, int, float, string, file, vector, quaternion), ordered references with integer triplet values, world placement instances, dirty tracking for mod stack layering, and binary/text disk persistence. Interacts directly with [`GameDataContainer`](gamedatacontainer.md) for master mod record ownership, [`GameDataManager`](gamedatamanager.md) for active file mod stacking, and [`RootObjectFactory`](rootobjectfactory.md) for converting data templates into live game objects.

GameDataContainer.description: Core game database container maintaining multi-index hash lookup maps across all Kenshi template and instance records (`GameData`). Provides $O(1)$ indexed retrieval by unique integer ID (`gamedataID`), global string ID (`gamedataSID`), category and name (`gamedataCatName`), and category and string ID (`gamedataCatSID`). Serves as base class for `GameDataManager`.

methods.GameDataContainer: Primary constructor for `GameDataContainer`. Initializes multi-index hash lookup tables (`gamedataCatName`, `gamedataID`, `gamedataCatSID`, `gamedataSID`), allocates master set container (`mainList`), resets integer ID counter (`currentID = 0`), and initializes baseline flags.
methods.~GameDataContainer: Virtual destructor for `GameDataContainer`. Traverses all managed `GameData` objects, removes back-references, purges multi-index maps, and deallocates owned objects.
methods.setName: Sets the friendly or mod filename string identifier for this container instance.
methods.createNewData: Factory method instantiating a new `GameData` object of the specified `itemType`, assigning an integer ID and registering it across all multi-index lookup tables.
methods.getNewID: Generates and returns a unique, strictly ascending sequential integer ID (`currentID++`) for indexing newly created `GameData` instances.
methods.addNewData: Registers an existing `GameData` object into this container, assigning a string ID if specified, setting `sourceContainer = this`, and inserting into all 4 lookup maps.
methods.renameData: Renames a managed `GameData` object, updating internal category-name lookup hash tables (`gamedataCatName`) to keep indices consistent.
methods.removeDuplicatesOf: Purges any earlier duplicate records matching the string ID of `dat` across all multi-index containers.
methods.checkForDuplicates: Checks whether an incoming record has an ID or string ID collision with existing records, updating pointer tables if resolving mod overrides.
methods.getData: Performs fast $O(1)$ hash lookup for a record by its unique global string ID (`gamedataSID`).
methods.getDataByName: Queries `gamedataCatName` for a record matching both category type and user-friendly name.
methods.getDataOfType: Populates list with all managed records belonging to a specified `itemType` category.
methods._getAllData: Retrieves direct const reference to the internal integer ID lookup map (`gamedataID`).
methods.preLoadAllReferencePtrs: Iterates across all loaded records and resolves string ID references into direct cached memory pointers (`GameData*`), accelerating runtime cross-references.
methods.clearAllReferencePtrs: Invalidates and clears all cached direct memory pointers across all records, preparing for mod reload or state purging.
methods.findAllDataThatReferencesThis: Scans all records in container, collecting every record of type `ofType` that references target record `what` inside reference list `listname`.
methods.loadGameDataReturn: Loads game data records from a binary or text file, optionally marking records read-only or active file members, returning success status.
methods.load: Primary mod loading interface reading a mod file (`.mod`) or base data file into this container with mod indexing and instance deletion tracking.
methods.save: Serializes all records in this container to disk at `filename`, invoking auxiliary serialization via `moreData`.
methods.removeData: Removes a specific `GameData` record from all lookup maps without deleting the underlying object.
methods.removeAllDataOfType: Removes and deallocates all records matching the specified `itemType` category.
methods.clearInstances: Purges temporary world object instances while retaining static master template records.
methods.clearButDontDestroy: Clears all multi-index lookup containers without deallocating the underlying `GameData` objects.
methods.clearButDontDestroyPlatoons: Clears all multi-index containers while explicitly preserving platoon and squad records.
methods.clearAndDestroy: Completely empties all lookup containers and deallocates every owned `GameData` object, freeing heap memory.
methods.flushKillList: Processes and deallocates all `GameData` records enqueued in the global static `killList` deferred deletion set.
methods.destroyHomelessData: Destroys a standalone unparented record (`dat->sourceContainer == nullptr`), queuing it for disposal.
methods.destroyData: Removes record `dat` from all lookup tables and enqueues it into global deferred destruction kill list (`killList`).
methods._addToKillList: Internal routine inserting a `GameData*` into the static global `killList` set for deferred cleanup.

GameWorld.description: Master game world simulation coordinator. Manages global game databases (gamedata, leveldata, savedata), physics, audio, root object factories, active mod lists, frame speeds, simulation pause states, system messages, and entity destruction queues. Interacts directly with [`GameDataManager`](gamedatamanager.md) for FCS template assets and world state storage, [`RootObjectFactory`](rootobjectfactory.md) for entity instantiation, [`FactionManager`](factionmanager.md) for diplomatic alignments and warfare, [`NavMesh`](navmesh.md) for terrain pathfinding geometry, [`ZoneManager`](zonemanager.md) for spatial world chunk paging, and [`PlayerInterface`](playerinterface.md) for human player commands.

Gear.description: Base class for equippable items and gear in the game. Extends `Item` by adding crafting attribution, level/quality scaling, and faction uniform data.

methods.Gear: Constructs a new `Gear` instance and initializes its state. Sets up the item's uniform faction, crafting details, and calculates the float level based on the integer level provided.
methods.~Gear: Destructor for the `Gear` class. Cleans up internal structures such as the `crafter` string and base `Item` components.
methods.isGear: Runtime type identification method for the `Gear` class.
methods.getLevel01: Retrieves the gear's quality level as a float multiplier.
methods.getLevel: Retrieves the gear's absolute integer quality level.
methods.isAFactionUniform: Checks if the gear serves as a uniform for a specific faction.
methods.isPlayerCrafted: Determines if the gear was crafted by a player character. This is checked by verifying if the `crafter` string is non-empty.
methods.setInventoryWeAreIn: Updates the internal inventory handler struct (`hand`) that tracks where this gear is located. Overrides the base `Item` implementation.
methods._serialise: Serializes the `Gear` instance state into a `GameData` structure for saving. Records uniform faction status and the crafter's name if applicable.
methods._loadFromSerialise: Deserializes a saved `GameData` state into this `Gear` instance. Restores base item properties, re-links the faction uniform pointer, and retrieves the crafter's name.

GunClass.description: Base ranged weapon subsystem in Kenshi managing both handheld crossbows (`GunClassPersonal`) and mounted building turrets (`GunClassTurret`). Encapsulates projectile ballistics raycasting (`physHit`), aiming kinematics, reload cycle progression, elevation/wall bonus computations, bowstring rendering states, and visual projectile tracer streams (`ConstantTracerT`).

methods.GunClass: Primary constructor for `GunClass`. Parses core weapon configuration parameters from `GameData* gundat`, initializing range bounds, reload timing limits, projectile speed scalars, and allocating tracer interfaces.
methods.~GunClass: Virtual destructor for `GunClass`. Tears down physical scene node attachments, detaches loaded ammo mesh entities, releases tracer objects (`ConstantTracerT`), and frees live ammo string names.
methods.createPhysical: Creates visual 3D entities and scene node hierarchies under `parentNode`, assigning custom materials and initializing bowstring meshes (`drawnStringMesh`, `slackStringMesh`).
methods.destroyPhysical: Destroys and unlinks physical Ogre scene nodes, detaching and destroying movable mesh components, bowstrings, and tracer attachments.
methods.isActive: Queries whether the weapon is active and enabled for aiming, reloading, and projectile firing.
methods.reactivationCheck: Evaluates operating condition and user binding, verifying whether the weapon should transition between active and dormant operational states.
methods.update: Per-frame kinematic update step. Updates aim pitch and yaw tracking towards target, synchronizes world transform coords, advances reload progression timers, and updates bowstring slackness.
methods.aimAt: Steers the weapon elevation and azimuth towards a specified target coordinate, restricted by `aimSpeed` and physical gimbal/joint rotational limits.
methods.getBarrelPos: Calculates the global world-space coordinates of the weapon's barrel muzzle exit point.
methods.getBarrelPosForTrace: Calculates barrel muzzle origin extrapolated along firing line by distance `dist` to avoid self-intersection with weapon housing during ballistic raycasts.
methods.getRelativeBarrelPos: Retrieves the local relative offset vector of the barrel tip with respect to the weapon root scene node (`gunBarrelOffsetPos`).
methods.getAimDir: Computes normalized line-of-sight unit direction vector pointing from barrel muzzle towards a target coordinate.
methods.reloadAmmo: Advances ammo reload sequence by `frameTime` seconds scaled by operator skill, replenishing current shot magazine count once `reloadState >= 1.0f`.
methods.shoot: Executes firing cycle: decrements ammo magazine count, computes accuracy spread deviations, launches visual/physical projectile, spawns tracers, and triggers gunshot audio.
methods.isAnimationReadyToShoot: Queries whether character animation playback has reached the designated firing release trigger frame.
methods.setAnimationReadyToShoot: Notifies the weapon controller that character animation playback has reached or left the release frame trigger.
methods.isReloading: Evaluates whether the weapon is currently actively executing a reload cycle.
methods.calculateReloadTime: Calculates actual reload time duration by interpolating between `reloadTimeMax` and `reloadTimeMin` based on operator skill parameter `stat01`.
methods.didThisTraceHitOurMountedBuilding: Determines whether a raycast trajectory hit intersected the defensive wall or building structure that this turret is mounted atop.
methods.trace: Performs primary line-of-sight PhysX raycast along direction `dir`, detecting terrain, buildings, and optionally character collision capsules.
methods.trace2: Performs secondary specialized line-of-sight raycast incorporating penetrating obstacle filtering and cheating tracer overrides.
methods.calculateHeightBonus: Calculates elevation advantage damage and range bonus scalar based on vertical height difference between barrel position and target position.
methods.calculateWallBonusMult: Calculates combat effectiveness and cover bonus multiplier granted when firing from fortified defensive walls or towers.
methods.getPowerEfficiencyMult: Queries electrical power efficiency multiplier affecting turret tracking speed and reload cycles (1.0f on personal weapons).
methods.calculateAccuracyDeviationAngle: Calculates random angular trajectory spread cone deviation in radians based on normalized operator accuracy skill.
methods.getARandomDamage: Rolls a randomized base kinetic/pierce damage value within the weapon's configured minimum and maximum damage range bounds.
methods.isPersonalCrossbow: Downcasts this weapon pointer to `GunClassPersonal*` if this instance is a handheld personal crossbow.
methods.isTurret: Downcasts this weapon pointer to `GunClassTurret*` if this instance is an emplaced mounted turret.
methods.setCharacter: Binds the operating character entity handle to this weapon rig, updating skill parameters and user references.
methods.getGUIData: Populates UI datapanel lines with weapon statistics including range, accuracy, damage range, and ammo status.
methods.setStateForGUI: Updates the normalized reload progress progressbar in the UI datapanel.
methods.setSkillForGUI: Transfers operator skill level and operator handle to the weapon UI display layer.
methods.getReloadStateForGUI: Calculates current reload progress percentage for UI display, optionally dividing by full reload duration.
methods.setVisible: Toggles visibility of weapon scene nodes, bowstring meshes, and attached loaded ammunition models.
methods.loadEntityCallback: Background resource loader callback invoked when mesh/material resources finish asynchronous streaming.
methods.onEntitiesLoaded: Virtual hook invoked once all visual mesh components finish loading, refreshing part visibilities and bowstring nodes.
methods.updatePartVisibilities: Synchronizes visibility of drawn vs slack bowstrings and loaded ammo bolts depending on current reload progression and magazine fullness.
methods.serialise: Serializes weapon state (remaining shots, reload progress, operator handle) into `GameData* state` for save game files.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Deserializes weapon state from `GameData* state` during game load, restoring ammo count and reload timing timers.

properties.maxRange: Maximum effective firing range in meters (`0x008`–`0x00C`).
properties.accuracySkillRequired: Skill threshold required to achieve nominal accuracy (`0x00C`–`0x010`).
properties.accuracyDeviationBase: Base angular trajectory cone spread in radians (`0x010`–`0x014`).
properties.aimSpeed: Tracking angular steering rate towards targets (`0x014`–`0x018`).
properties.shotSpeed: Projectile flight velocity scalar in m/s (`0x018`–`0x01C`).
properties.numShotsCurrent: Currently loaded remaining shots in magazine (`0x020`–`0x024`).
properties.reloadTimeMin: Minimum possible reload duration at max operator skill (`0x024`–`0x028`).
properties.reloadTimeMax: Maximum reload duration at zero operator skill (`0x028`–`0x02C`).
properties.userSkill01: Normalized operator proficiency skill scalar (0.0 to 1.0) (`0x02C`–`0x030`).
properties.reloadAnimation: Animation asset definition governing reloading posture (`0x050`–`0x058`).
properties.harpoonMaterial: Custom harpoon cable / projectile line material (`0x070`–`0x080`).
properties.cheatingTracer: Secondary / AI visual tracer ray controller (`0x088`–`0x090`).
properties.gunBarrelOffsetPos: Local relative offset vector from root node to muzzle tip (`0x090`–`0x0A0`).
properties.ammoObjects: Loaded visual ammunition mesh entity collection (`0x0A0`–`0x0B8`).
properties.liveAmmoMesh: Mesh resource name used for active flying projectile (`0x0B8`–`0x0E0`).
properties.loadingEntitesLeft: Counter of asynchronous streaming mesh entities remaining (`0x110`–`0x111`).

GunClassPersonal.description: A specialized implementation of `GunClass` representing ranged weapons wielded personally by characters (e.g., crossbows). It manages character-specific weapon mechanics, animation states, and entity material bindings.

methods.GunClassPersonal: Constructs a new `GunClassPersonal` instance, initializing its stats based on the provided `GameData` and item level (quality).
methods.~GunClassPersonal: Destroys the `GunClassPersonal` instance and cleans up allocated memory.
methods.scoreTarget: Calculates a priority score for targeting a specific character. It evaluates visibility, relative floor levels, and positional advantage.
methods.getAimDir: Calculates the normalized direction vector from the weapon's barrel position to the specified target position.
methods.getAimCloseness: Evaluates how close the weapon's current aim is to the target. Used for animation tracking and hit probability.
methods.isAnimationReadyToShoot: Checks if the character's firing animation has reached the point where a projectile can be spawned.
methods.getDamageMin: Retrieves the pre-calculated minimum damage this weapon can inflict.
methods.getDamageMax: Retrieves the pre-calculated maximum damage this weapon can inflict.
methods.getPowerEfficiencyMult: Retrieves the power efficiency multiplier. Usually defaults to 1.0 for personal weapons as power is not consumed.
methods.calculateWallBonusMult: Calculates the range/damage bonus when shooting from a wall. For personal weapons, this might query the character's current position.
methods.didThisTraceHitOurMountedBuilding: Checks if a physics trace collided with the building the character is mounted on (to prevent self-hitting geometry).
methods.setCharacter: Binds this weapon instance to a character's hand, associating the weapon with its wielder.
methods.clearEntitesPtr: Clears the internal pointers relating to visual entities.
methods.getParentNode: Retrieves the visual scene node this weapon is attached to (likely a bone on the character's skeleton).
methods.getAudioObject: Retrieves the audio object ID used for playing weapon sounds (reloading, firing) from the wielder's position.
methods.isPersonalCrossbow: Runtime type identification method returning the `this` pointer cast to `GunClassPersonal`. Used to distinguish personal weapons from turrets.
methods.onEntitiesLoaded: Callback invoked when the visual entities for the weapon have finished loading. Applies materials and configured visual settings.

properties._base: Base class.
properties.animReadyToShoot: State flag indicating if the character's animation is ready to fire.

GunClassTurret.description: `GunClassTurret` represents a mounted turret weapon in the game world. It inherits from `GunClass` and links directly to a `TurretBuilding` entity, handling the physical representation, aiming, and target scoring specific to stationary defenses.

methods.GunClassTurret: Constructs a new `GunClassTurret` instance, initializing it with the specified game data and linking it to a parent `TurretBuilding`.
methods.~GunClassTurret: Destroys the turret weapon instance and frees associated resources.
methods.scoreTarget: Evaluates a potential target character, returning a score that determines target priority. Targets standing directly in front of the turret are scored highly.
methods.aimAt: Points the turret's physical weapon meshes toward a specific 3D coordinate. Updates `lastTarget`.
methods.getAimCloseness: Returns a measurement of how closely the turret's current physical alignment matches its designated target direction.
methods.getPowerEfficiencyMult: Calculates a multiplier for the turret's effectiveness based on the building's current power levels. If underpowered, the turret performs worse.
methods.calculateWallBonusMult: Determines the positional damage/range bonus for this turret based on the wall or structure it is mounted on.
methods.isOutOfPower: Checks if the turret has insufficient power to operate.
methods.getDamageMin: Retrieves the minimum possible damage output per shot for this turret.
methods.getDamageMax: Retrieves the maximum possible damage output per shot for this turret.
methods.didThisTraceHitOurMountedBuilding: Checks if a projectile or raycast collision hit the specific building structure that this turret is mounted on, typically to avoid turrets shooting their own bases.
methods.createPhysical: Initializes the 3D meshes, materials, and Ogre entities for this turret, attaching them to the provided scene node.
methods.destroyPhysical: Destroys the Ogre entities and visual meshes associated with this turret, removing them from the scene.
methods.clearEntitesPtr: Clears internal pointers to the turret's physical Ogre entities, usually called during cleanup.
methods.onEntitiesLoaded: Callback triggered immediately after the turret's physical 3D entities have finished loading asynchronously.
methods.getParentNode: Retrieves the Ogre scene node that acts as the parent transform for this turret.
methods.getGUIData: Populates a target GUI datapanel with information about this turret's stats and current status.
methods.getAudioObject: Retrieves the Wwise audio object ID associated with this turret for 3D sound spatialization.
methods.isTurret: Runtime type identification method returning the `this` pointer cast to a `GunClassTurret`.

properties._base: Base gun class
properties.turretBuilding: Pointer to the associated turret building structure
