HavokCharacter.description: Autonomous navigation agent and kinematic path follower bridging character locomotion kinematics (`CharMovement`) to Havok AI navigation meshes (`hkaiNavMesh`). Executes string-pulling portal funneling across NavMesh edge corridors (`EdgePathNode`), local obstacle avoidance steering, dynamic obstacle cylinder-sweep collision detection (`EdgeCache`), and water immersion speed damping.

methods.new: Custom SIMD-aligned heap allocator for `HavokCharacter`. Allocates memory aligned to a 16-byte boundary via `_aligned_malloc` to satisfy Havok AI and SSE/AVX `hkVector4f` vector register alignment constraints.
methods.delete: Custom SIMD-aligned heap deallocator for `HavokCharacter`. Releases memory previously allocated with 16-byte alignment via `_aligned_free`.
methods.HavokCharacter: Primary constructor for `HavokCharacter`. Initializes spatial position, agent footprint radius, acceleration constants, sensory subsystem links (`SensoryData`), resets path state to idle, clears face indices, and configures collision bounds.
methods.~HavokCharacter: Destructor for `HavokCharacter`. Deallocates path nodes in `currentPath`, clears local dynamic edge cache arrays (`edgeCache.edges`), releases boundary buffers via `hkContainerHeapAllocator`, and clears collision state references.
methods.setHandle: Associates or updates the entity handle (`hand`) referencing the owning character possessing this Havok agent.
methods.setManualMode: Toggles manual navigation steering override mode, bypassing autonomous edge-following path logic for direct manual control.
methods.setPosition: Sets the agent's spatial position and updates the current NavMesh polygon face key. Marks `positionChanged = true` to force edge cache and spatial partition updates.
methods.getPosition: Retrieves the current world-space position vector of the Havok navigation agent.
methods.setVelocity: Explicitly assigns the linear kinematic velocity vector of the navigation agent.
methods.getVelocity: Queries the current linear velocity vector of the character.
methods.getWaypointDirection: Queries the normalized direction vector towards the currently targeted NavMesh edge or intermediate waypoint.
methods.getDirectionMoved: Queries the actual travel direction vector traversed during the most recent kinematic simulation integration step.
methods.updateVelocity: Integrates kinematic acceleration towards a specified target direction over a simulation delta time interval, clamping output velocity to `desiredSpeed` scaled by environmental water drag modifiers.
methods.setWaterModifier: Applies a speed attenuation multiplier to account for water immersion drag or deep wading resistance.
methods.setDesiredSpeed: Configures the desired forward travel speed target for the kinematic steering controller.
methods.getState: Queries high-level character navigation state (IDLE, GOAL_REACHED, FOLLOWING_PATH, or MANUAL).
methods.getPathState: Queries detailed status of active path computation and execution (NONE, COMPLETE, INCOMPLETE, FAILED, WAITING, UPDATING, BROKEN).
methods.isOnNavmesh: Determines whether the agent is currently positioned on a valid Havok NavMesh polygon face.
methods._getFace: Retrieves the SIMD 4-vector position and the active NavMesh face key currently inhabited by the character.
methods._getFaceKey: Directly queries the current NavMesh polygon face key.
methods.getClosestPoint: Queries the closest valid NavMesh boundary or portal point within a specified maximum radius, optionally taking dynamic building doorways and obstacles into account.
methods.requestPath: Dispatches an asynchronous A* pathfinding query request to the Havok navigation generator queue towards a targeted goal coordinate.
methods.clearPath: Clears and invalidates active path structures, resetting path state to `NONE` and clearing pending waypoints.
methods.invalidate: Invalidates current path progress if matching an invalidated request ID or region ID, forcing path recalculation.
methods.setPath: Processes a completed `HavokCharacterMessage` containing newly solved A* path corridors and edge sequences, populating `currentPath` and resetting edge indices.
methods.atGoal: Evaluates whether the agent has reached the final destination goal point within acceptable spatial tolerance threshold.
methods.calculateFuturePosition: Calculates projected future agent position and steering orientation along the active path corridor over a specified distance horizon.
methods.update: Primary per-frame simulation update step for the Havok character. Advances kinematic movement along path, integrates velocity, executes edge collision queries, and updates steering vectors.
methods.moveAlongPath: Advances the agent along the current polyline path corridor for a given time step, updating current waypoint and triggering portal funneling string-pulling.
methods.calculatePathVector: Computes directional steering vector towards the next path portal, calculating slow-down target points for cornering and vertex funneling.
methods.pullThroughVertex: Applies string-pulling funnel algorithms across shared NavMesh polygon edges, tightening path corners around left or right portal vertices.
methods.updateNextEdge: Advances the active path traversal index `nextEdge` to the subsequent polygon boundary edge along `currentPath`.
methods.updateEdgeCache: Refreshes local obstacle edge cache (`EdgeCache`) within a spherical search volume around a given center point.
methods.getCollidedCharacter: Queries the entity handle of another character currently colliding with or impeding this agent.
methods.handleCollision: Detects and reacts to dynamic agent-agent and agent-obstacle collisions, adjusting local trajectory and triggering avoidance maneuvers.
methods.calculateAvoidanceVector: Calculates local avoidance steering repulsive vector away from nearby dynamic obstacles and characters, returning penetration depth.
methods.moveCollide: Sweeps a character cylinder/sphere proxy from start coordinate along a displacement vector, detecting contact with cached boundary edges.
methods.edgeCollision: Checks for immediate penetration between the agent's collision cylinder and nearby NavMesh border edges.
methods.resolveProblems: Resolves edge cases such as agent getting stuck outside NavMesh boundaries, off-mesh fall recovery, or trapped inside dynamic obstacles.

properties.currentPath: Active polyline path corridor edge sequence (`0x000`–`0x010`).
properties.startingFace: NavMesh face key where path query commenced (`0x010`–`0x014`).
properties.currentFace: Active NavMesh face key currently occupied by agent (`0x014`–`0x018`).
properties.nextEdge: Index of subsequent target edge portal along path corridor (`0x018`–`0x01C`).
properties.waypointDirection: Direction heading towards immediate portal waypoint (`0x050`–`0x060`).
properties.directionMoved: Actual displacement direction vector traveled during last frame (`0x060`–`0x070`).
properties.radius: Agent navigation collision cylinder radius in meters (`0x070`–`0x074`).
properties.waterModifier: Water drag speed attenuation scalar multiplier (`0x074`–`0x078`).
properties.acceleration: Kinematic linear acceleration rate in m/s^2 (`0x078`–`0x07C`).
properties.desiredSpeed: Target steering travel speed in m/s (`0x07C`–`0x080`).
properties.positionChanged: Spatial transformation dirty flag forcing cache invalidation (`0x080`).
properties.timeOffPath: Accumulated duration spent off valid NavMesh corridors (`0x084`–`0x088`).
properties.characterState: High-level agent movement state (IDLE, GOAL_REACHED, FOLLOWING_PATH, MANUAL) (`0x088`–`0x08C`).
properties.lastState: Previous movement state prior to transition (`0x08C`–`0x090`).
properties.collided: Entity handle of colliding obstacle character (`0x0B8`–`0x0D8`).
properties.boundaryPos: Position of nearest NavMesh boundary edge (`0x0E0`–`0x0F0`).
properties.boundary: Cached boundary edge nodes surrounding agent (`0x0F0`–`0x100`).
properties.sensoryData: Pointer to character awareness and perception subsystem (`0x100`–`0x108`).
properties.edgeCache: Local dynamic obstacle edge cache structure (`0x150`–`0x178`).
properties.resolveFlag: Recovery and problem resolution mode indicator flag (`0x180`).

HealthPartStatus.description: Individual anatomical body part health record tracking flesh health, bandage healing, blunt stun, robotic wear damage, amputation, and bleeding contributions.

methods.update: Executes simulation and state update tick for `HealthPartStatus`.
methods.updateDerivedHealths: Executes simulation and state update tick for `HealthPartStatus`.
methods.serialise: Performs persistence serialization operation `serialise` for `HealthPartStatus`.

properties.fleshHealth: Current structural biological flesh hit points.
properties.bloodLoss: Rate of active haemorrhage from this limb.
properties.bandageHealth: Temporary bandaged hit points undergoing healing.
properties.stunDamage: Temporary blunt stun damage decaying over time.
properties.wearDamage: Robotic wear damage requiring repair kit.
properties.maxHealthVal: Maximum anatomical hit points derived from toughness.

InputHandler.description: Input processing subsystem bridging raw OIS mouse and keyboard hardware events to MyGUI widgets, game world selection boxes, camera controls, and hotkey actions.

methods.~InputHandler: Destructs the `InputHandler` instance and releases allocated resources.

properties.mouseX: Current screen space mouse horizontal coordinate.
properties.mouseY: Current screen space mouse vertical coordinate.
properties.mouseDeltaX: Relative horizontal mouse motion since last frame.
properties.mouseDeltaY: Relative vertical mouse motion since last frame.
properties.mouseButtons[8]: Bit array of 8 mouse button down states.
properties.keys[256]: Direct keyboard scan code down state buffer.
properties.keyBindings: Configured action to scan code binding dictionary.
properties.guiCapturedMouse: MyGUI mouse input focus override latch.
properties.guiCapturedKeyboard: MyGUI keyboard text entry focus override latch.
properties.dragStartPos: Screen coordinate where mouse drag selection began.
properties.isDragging: Active RTS box selection drag state flag.

Inventory.description: Master container and item lifecycle coordinator governing multi-section 2D item grids, equipment paperdoll slots, automated item arrangement, container weight multipliers, encumbrance recalculations, currency transactions, theft status validation, and savegame serialization. Interacts directly with [`InventorySection`](inventorysection.md) for spatial slot arrays, [`Item`](item.md) for concrete physical objects, [`Character`](character.md) for personal equipment, and [`ShopTrader`](shoptrader.md) for mercantile inventories.

methods.Inventory: Constructs an `Inventory` instance, assigning the owning entity, allocating the room cache, and initializing section lookup structures.
methods.~Inventory: Destructs the `Inventory` instance, clearing all items, deleting child `InventorySection` instances, and releasing the room cache.
methods.clearAll: Removes all stored items across all managed sections, optionally purging items from the game world and preserving unique quest items.
methods.initialiseNewSection: Creates, configures, and registers a new 2D grid section (`InventorySection`) within the inventory, linking attachment restrictions and layout priority.
methods.resizeSection: Resizes an existing inventory section grid to new cell dimensions, optionally purging existing contents.
methods.removeAllSections: Destroys all registered `InventorySection` grid components and clears lookup tables.
methods.getSection: Looks up a section by its registration name string.
methods.getSectionOfType: Returns the first section configured with the specified attachment slot restriction.
methods.getAllSectionsOfType: Populates output list with all sections configured with the given attachment slot type.
methods.getAllSections: Provides direct reference to the ordered array of registered sections.
methods.addItem: Attempts to add an item into the inventory across available sections. If insertion fails, optionally drops the item onto the ground or destroys it.
methods.tryAddItem: Scans all sections in priority order to find a valid grid position or existing stack to receive the item.
methods.hasRoomForItem: Queries whether the inventory has sufficient spatial capacity to accommodate an item of the given blueprint, consulting the acceleration cache.
methods.transferMouseItem: Transfers an item currently dragged on the mouse cursor into this inventory.
methods.equipItem: Attempts to equip an item into its designated equipment slot section (e.g. Weapon, Head, Body, Legs, Boots).
methods.removeItemDontDestroy_returnsItem: Extracts an item from its containing section without destroying the object, returning the detached item pointer or split stack copy.
methods.removeItemAutoDestroy: Extracts and immediately destroys an item from the inventory and game world.
methods.dropItem: Ejects an item from the inventory onto the ground at the owner entity's world position.
methods.takeOneItemOnly: Extracts exactly one unit of an item matching the specified blueprint.
methods.takeItem_EntireStack: Extracts the complete stack of the specified item instance from its section.
methods.getNumItems: Returns the total accumulated quantity of items matching the given blueprint across all sections.
methods.countItems: Counts how many units of the given item blueprint exist across all sections.
methods.hasItem: Checks whether inventory contains at least `quantity` units of the given item blueprint.
methods.getItem: Finds the first item instance matching the given blueprint.
methods.hasItemType: Checks whether inventory contains any item matching the given `itemType` category.
methods.getAllItemsOfType: Collects all items belonging to the given type into the output array.
methods.isEmpty: Returns whether the inventory contains zero items.
methods.getEquippedWeapons: Collects all weapons equipped in primary and secondary weapon slots.
methods.getPrimaryWeapon: Retrieves the weapon equipped in the primary weapon section ("Back").
methods.getSecondaryWeapon: Retrieves the sidearm equipped in the secondary weapon section ("Hip").
methods.getEquippedArmour: Collects all protective armor items currently equipped across Head, Body, Legs, and Boots sections.
methods.hasWeaponEquipped: Returns whether the character has at least one weapon equipped.
methods.getBestFoodItem: Finds the best edible food item, checking race-restricted nutrition first (e.g. foul meat for Hivers) before falling back to standard food.
methods.getNumFoodItems: Returns total edible food items available for the given character race.
methods._getBestFoodItem: Evaluates food items matching function, selecting the one with the highest nutrition value compatible with race biology.
methods._getNumFoodItems: Counts edible items matching specific food function type.
methods.hasItemFunction: Checks whether inventory contains any item possessing the given functional role.
methods.getAllItemsWithFunction: Collects all items possessing the specified functional capability.
methods.getBestItemWithFunction: Finds the highest quality/potency item matching the function flag.
methods.getBestItemWithLowestCharges: Finds an item matching blueprint with the fewest remaining charges to deplete partially used kits first.
methods.getAllStolenItems: Gathers all items marked as stolen from factions.
methods.hasStolenItems: Checks whether any stolen goods reside in the inventory.
methods.getExcessLoot: Identifies excess contraband or stolen gear for AI looting routines.
methods.getResourceItems: Populates set with all raw material or trade commodity blueprints present in inventory.
methods.deathCheck: Verifies whether removing this item causes instant death or vital organ failure (e.g. animal vital parts, robot CPU cores).
methods.recalculateTotalWeight: Traverses all sections and recalculates `totalWeight`, applying container weight mitigation factors (e.g. wooden backpack 50% reduction).
methods.getTotalWeight: Returns the cached aggregate weight of all items in kilograms.
methods.getMoney: Queries current Cats currency balance belonging to the owning faction.
methods.takeMoney: Deducts currency from the owning faction balance.
methods.buyItem: Purchases an item from a merchant inventory, transferring currency and moving the item into the buyer's inventory.
methods.fillFromVendorList: Populates merchant inventory from an FCS vendor list blueprint, spawning items scaled by quality and vendor wealth.
methods.serialise: Serializes all inventory sections, stored items, stack counts, and theft records into savegame FCS records.
methods.loadFrom: Deserializes inventory layout and item instances from an FCS savegame container.
methods.notifyModified: Invalidates room cache and alerts GUI and callback objects that contents have changed.
methods.getCallbackCharacter: Resolves owning or listener character entity.
methods.getCallbackObject: Returns the registered callback listener object.
methods.getOwner: Returns the entity owning this inventory.
methods.isAContainer: Checks whether owner is a static or carried container item.
methods.getHandle: Returns persistent handle of owning entity.
methods.getInventoryGUI: Retrieves MyGUI display controller widget bound to this inventory.
methods.isVisible: Returns whether this inventory GUI window is currently open and visible to the player.
methods.autoArrange: Invokes 2D packing optimization algorithm across all sections to consolidate loose items and maximize contiguous free space.
methods.refreshGui: Triggers HUD redrawing for active inventory windows.
methods._sectionAddItemCallback: Callback triggered when an item is placed into any child section.
methods._sectionUpdateItemCallback: Callback triggered when an existing item stack count is altered.
methods._sectionRemoveItemCallback: Callback triggered when an item is evicted from any section.
methods._addToList: Appends an item to linear registry array `_allItems` if not already present.
methods._removeFromList: Removes item from linear registry array `_allItems`.

properties._vftable: Virtual method dispatch table pointer resolving polymorphic inventory routines (`addItem`, `hasRoomForItem`, etc.).
properties.hasRoomCache: Lookup acceleration cache indexing item grid fit results to avoid redundant spatial scans across sections.
properties._allItems: Flat linear dynamic array indexing all concrete item instances currently stored across all child sections (0x18 bytes: `0x010`–`0x028`).
properties.sections: Hash map associating unique section name strings with concrete `InventorySection` grid instances (0x40 bytes: `0x028`–`0x068`).
properties.sectionsInSearchOrder: Ordered priority array of sections traversed during automated item insertion and loot auto-packing (0x18 bytes: `0x068`–`0x080`).
properties.callbackObject: Entity receiving inventory modification and update event notifications (typically owner character or building).
properties.owner: Owning polymorphic game entity (`Character`, `Building`, `ContainerItem`) possessing this inventory container.
properties.totalWeight: Cached aggregate mass of all stored items in kilograms, incorporating container weight mitigation factors.

InventoryGUI.description: 2D graphical inventory window governing tile grid interactions, drag-and-drop item movement, shop barter validation, paperdoll equipment slots, and thievery detection. Coordinates child windows for equipped backpacks ([`ContainerItem`](containeritem.md)), communicates with `ForgottenGUI` for modal dialogue popups, and integrates with `DatapanelGUI` for live character stat readouts.

methods.autoChangeSelectedObject: Virtual notification handler invoked when the active game entity selection changes. InventoryGUI overrides this as a no-op.
methods.update: Per-frame window update method. Refreshes hover tooltips, processes pending dirty section redraws (`needItemsUpdate`), updates thievery probability indicators, and synchronizes datapanel stats.
methods.show: Controls visibility of the inventory window. Hides tooltips when closing, marks sections dirty when opening, and toggles underlying MyGUI widget visibility.
methods.setPositionReal: Positions the inventory window in normalized screen space coordinates.
methods.isVisible: Queries whether the inventory window is currently visible on screen.
methods.windowButtonPressed: Handles window titlebar button events (such as the close button). Dispatches inventory close requests to `ForgottenGUI`.
methods.getWindowCoord: Retrieves the absolute screen pixel coordinates and dimensions of the inventory window widget.
methods.InventoryGUI: Primary constructor for `InventoryGUI`. Initializes `GUIWindow` base state, configures layout manager, links callback entity, sets up MyGUI window listeners, and builds section maps.
methods.~InventoryGUI: Virtual destructor releasing all managed GUI widgets, closing child backpack windows, unregistering from global trade tables, and destroying icon resources.
methods.onWindowFocus: Window focus change callback. Brings the inventory window and its associated child backpack windows to the front of the MyGUI layer stack.
methods.windowMoved: Window move callback. Repositions attached child backpack windows synchronously so they remain anchored to the parent inventory window.
methods.refreshSection: Refreshes visual item icons and grid tiles for a specific `InventorySection`. Synchronizes item quantities, condition bars, charges progress, and stolen status indicators.
methods.getInventory: Resolves and returns the underlying `Inventory` model instance linked to this GUI window via `selectedObject` handle.
methods.hasSameOwner: Checks whether this inventory window and another `InventoryGUI` share the same underlying entity owner.
methods.getCallbackCharacter: Retrieves the owning `Character` entity associated with this inventory window.
methods.getCallbackObject: Retrieves the primary `RootObject` entity owning or dispatching events for this inventory window.
methods.getSelectedItem: Retrieves the currently selected or highlighted `Item` residing in the named inventory section.
methods.refreshAllSections: Iterates through all registered inventory sections in `inventorySections` and rebuilds all child item icon widgets, refreshing layout and dirty flags.
methods.updateDatapanel: Updates the attached datapanel sidebar (`DatapanelGUI`), displaying character equipment stats, encumbrance, combat attributes, and item tooltips.
methods.getSection: Resolves the underlying logical `InventorySection` by name from the associated `Inventory` model.
methods.makeIconForItem: Static factory function allocating and constructing an `InventoryIcon` widget for the given item at specified grid coordinates.
methods.pickupItemToMouse: Picks up an item from the specified inventory section grid and attaches it to the mouse cursor for drag-and-drop movement. Handles single item or partial stack detachment.
methods.placeItemFromMouse: Places the item currently held on the mouse cursor into the designated inventory section at the given mouse coordinates. Validates slot bounds, checks auto-stacking, verifies commercial affordability if trading, and tests thievery detection if looting.
methods.getMouseItem: Retrieves a pointer to the item currently attached to the mouse cursor during a drag-and-drop operation.
methods.takeCertainAmountFrom: Splits a designated numerical quantity from an existing stackable item, cloning a new `Item` instance holding the extracted amount and decrementing the base item's quantity.
methods.playSound: Dispatches an item audio event (e.g. pickup, drop, equip, rustle) to Wwise sound engine based on the item's material type and designated sound event ID.
methods.returnItem: Returns an item held on the mouse cursor back to its originating inventory section and slot coordinates (e.g. after a cancelled drag or rejected placement).
methods.hasMouse: Tests whether the cursor is currently hovering within the bounding geometry of this inventory window widget.
methods.getSectionWithMouseLocal: Determines which specific inventory section grid or equipment slot widget is currently positioned under the mouse cursor.
methods.getSlotWithMouse: Calculates the discrete grid slot coordinates (X, Y) corresponding to the mouse cursor position within the currently active inventory section.
methods.sectionMouseButtonPressed: Handles mouse button down events inside inventory section grids. Initiates item pick-up on left-click, triggers auto-equip or auto-trade on right-click, and manages stack splitting on modifier keys.
methods.sectionMouseButtonReleased: Handles mouse button release events. Drops or places held mouse items into the targeted slot or section, checks thievery detection rolls, and finalizes barter transactions.
methods.lockedItemCheck: Validates whether a locked equipment item (e.g. slave shackles, torture gear) is actively locked on the character. Returns true if the item is equipped and its lock mechanism has a positive difficulty level and is not currently open.
methods.autoArrangeButton: UI callback invoked when the user clicks the Auto-Arrange button. Invokes `Inventory::autoArrange` on the associated container to compact and reorganize items in the grid, updates all visual sections, and plays the standard UI click sound.
methods.openBackpackButton: UI callback invoked when the user clicks the backpack button. Resolves the backpack attachment section (`ATTACH_BACKPACK`) from the character inventory, toggles the child backpack window visibility, positions it adjacent to the main inventory, and links parent-child inventory references.
methods.openLimbsInterface: Opens the robotic prosthetics and surgical limbs interface. Resolves the character's robotic limbs manager from callback data and requests `ForgottenGUI` to display the robotic limbs slot UI.
methods.showBackpack: Displays or hides the secondary backpack inventory window associated with this inventory. When hiding, closes child inventory panels and unhooks active trader linkages.
methods.getBackpack: Retrieves the currently equipped backpack container item by checking the inventory's `ATTACH_BACKPACK` slot.
methods.setItemToPlayerPortrait: Transfers an item directly to a character by dropping it onto their squad portrait in the HUD. Validates container distance, auto-stacks or auto-places the item in the recipient's inventory or backpack, and initiates trade or thievery alerts if applicable.
methods.rightClickAutoEquipping: Executes right-click auto-equip logic for the item hovered under the mouse cursor. Inspects the item's attachment type, finds an appropriate target equipment slot, checks weapon slot priority (primary vs secondary), swaps or displaces existing gear if necessary, and updates audio and dirty flags.
methods.tryToEquip: Attempts to equip the specified item into an appropriate equipment slot on the character. Validates race/body restrictions, equipment slot availability, and swaps existing equipped gear back into the main inventory grid if `replace` is true.
methods.setTradingTown: Sets the static trading settlement identifier (`currentTradeTown`), establishing the municipal jurisdiction governing price markups, legal prohibitions, and contraband checks during merchant bartering.
methods.getTradingTown: Retrieves the active trading town pointer by resolving the static `currentTradeTown` handle through `HandleManager`.
methods.addTradePartner: Registers an inventory window as an active trade partner in the global barter map (`traders`). Configures transaction parameters including whether money exchange is required, whether items can be freely dropped without payment, and whether the partner represents a player character.
methods.removeTradePartner: Removes an inventory window from the global trade partner map. If any open fencing or confirmation message box is pending, closes it via `ForgottenGUI`.
methods.clearTradePartners: Clears all active trade partners from the global `traders` map and deallocates map nodes using `Ogre::NedPoolingPolicy`.
methods.canDropMouseItemWithoutPaying: Checks whether an item picked up from the specified source inventory can be dropped into another inventory or container without requiring payment.
methods.getTrader1Trader2: Resolves the primary buyer and seller inventory windows (`trader1` and `trader2`) from the active `traders` registration map, verifying that exactly two trading entities participate.
methods.getNPCTrader: Scans active trade partners to identify the non-player merchant character. Resolves the owner handle of non-player trade partners through `HandleManager`.
methods.isTradingForMoney_static: Static query checking whether the active trading session involves financial currency transactions (Cats) rather than free container looting. Returns the NPC entity if selling/buying for money.
methods.isTradingAndStealing_static: Static query checking whether the active trading session involves looting or stealing from an unwilling or unconscious NPC. Returns the victim `RootObject` if items are considered stolen.
methods.getTraderPriceMultiplier: Calculates the dynamic trade price multiplier for the current merchant transaction based on the NPC trader's platoon economy settings (`priceMultWhenITrade`).
methods.RClickAutoTrade: Executes right-click automated barter/transfer of a single item or stack from the specified section coordinates to the partner inventory. Handles price computation, money deduction, thievery detection, crime alerts, and inventory space validation.
methods.RClickAutoTradeAll: Transfers all matching items of the same type from the source inventory section to the destination inventory window in batch mode (Shift+Right Click).
methods.isTradingForMoney: Determines whether transferring an item from `cameFrom` into this inventory represents a commercial purchase/sale requiring Cats exchange.
methods.isWithinRangeToTrade: Validates spatial proximity between the player character and the target trading partner or container. Rejects transactions if entities exceed maximum interaction distance.
methods.getPlayerTradeCharacter: Identifies the player character currently engaged in the barter session by querying active trade partner registrations.
methods.stealingGUIInfoUpdate: Updates thievery UI information strings and chance-of-success indicators (`stealingGUIInfo`). Computes lighting levels, character thievery skill, target awareness, line-of-sight penalties, and updates hover tooltip displays.
methods.isStealing: Evaluates whether transferring an item from `cameFrom` constitutes theft. Evaluates item ownership, faction relations, unconscious/imprisoned state of owner, and container legality.
methods.fencingConfirmation: Displays a confirmation dialog when attempting to sell stolen goods to a fence or vendor who recognizes the stolen property. Computes fence chance based on merchant faction and skill.
methods.fencingConfirmationCallback: Callback dispatched when the user confirms or declines the fencing dialog. If confirmed (`b == 2`), proceeds with the stolen goods transaction at the agreed fence price.

properties.win: Root MyGUI window widget managing position, dimension, and viewport rendering.
properties.selectedObject: Persistent game handle of the entity/container currently inspected in the window (`0x010`–`0x030`).
properties.layoutMgr: Layout builder and XML definition loader generating UI section widgets.
properties.ownerInventory: Pointer to parent or owner inventory window during trade or container looting.
properties.childInventory: Pointer to attached child backpack or sub-container inventory window.
properties.mouseFocus: True if the mouse cursor currently hovers over any slot or element within this window.
properties.callbackObject: Owning game entity receiving inventory transaction and modification events.
properties.needItemsUpdate: Dirty flag requesting full visual grid refresh on subsequent frame update.
properties.inventorySections: Map of visual section wrappers indexed by compartment name string (`0x060`–`0x090`).

InventorySection.description: Discrete 2D spatial inventory container grid managing item tile placement, cell occupancy bitmaps, equipment slot validation, stack bonuses, backpack weight reductions, and event callbacks. Each `InventorySection` belongs to a parent [`Inventory`](inventory.md) instance and coordinates directly with [`Item`](item.md) instances, [`Character`](character.md) equipment slots, and [`RaceLimiter`](racelimiter.md) gear restriction rules.

methods.InventorySection: Constructs an `InventorySection` instance, configuring grid dimensions, parent container reference, attachment slot constraints, equipment flags, and allocating the 2D occupancy grid.
methods.~InventorySection: Destructs the `InventorySection`, tearing down all placed items through `GameWorld::destroy`, freeing `veryLimitedSlot` buffers, deallocating the 2D grid via NedPooling allocator, and clearing the item vector.
methods.resize: Reconfigures grid dimensions, resizing the underlying 2D cell occupancy array and optionally clearing all active cell references.
methods.canItemGoHere: Validates whether an item can be legally positioned at coordinates `(x, y)`, verifying section enable state, slot compatibility, and bounding rectangle bounds.
methods.getValidInventoryPosition: Calculates a clamped valid position for the specified item nearest to the requested `(x, y)` coordinate, adjusting inward to prevent bounding overflow.
methods.findNearestPlaceForItem: Systematically scans the 2D grid row-by-row and column-by-column to locate the first free spatial footprint with zero item overlaps.
methods.getItemsInFootprint: Collects all distinct items whose bounding footprints intersect the rectangular boundary defined by `(x, y, itemWidth, itemHeight)`.
methods.existsItemInFootprint: Tests whether any placed item collides with the spatial footprint of `item` placed at `(x, y)`.
methods.numItemsInFootprint: Returns the exact number of distinct items currently residing within the footprint of `item` placed at `(x, y)`.
methods.getItemAt: Retrieves the item occupying grid cell `(x, y)`, throwing `std::out_of_range` if coordinates exceed section bounds.
methods.autoArrange: Reorganizes all stored items to maximize available space, sorting items by geometric area in descending order and repacking from top-left to bottom-right.
methods.hasRoomForItem: Evaluates whether an item blueprint can fit into this section, verifying stack merging potential against existing items and scanning vacant grid cells if stack merging cannot absorb the quantity.
methods.addItem: Adds an item into this inventory section, handling stolen status resolution if returning to the rightful owner, stacking into existing stacks, or searching for vacant grid placement.
methods._addItem: Low-level internal insertion routine updating item coordinates, section name, ownership handle, filling the 2D cell occupancy grid, updating total weight, and invoking inventory change callbacks.
methods.removeItem: Removes the specified item from this section, clearing occupied grid cells, shifting the items vector, recalculating weight, resetting item ownership and inventory flags, and notifying callbacks.
methods.clearAllItems: Iterates backwards through all stored items, removing each from the grid and optionally calling `GameWorld::destroy`, with an option to preserve unique story items.
methods.hasItem: Checks whether any item matching the specified FCS template record exists within this section.
methods.hasItemType: Queries if any item possessing the specified item type enumeration resides in this section.
methods.getAllItemsOfType: Collects all items in this section matching the concrete type category and characteristics of `item`.
methods.getAllItemsOfName: Finds and appends all items whose display names match `itemName`.
methods.getNumItems: Calculates the total aggregate count of items across all stacks residing in this section.
methods.isEmpty: Checks if the section contains zero item entries.
methods.getItem: Retrieves the first item stored in this section, commonly used for single-slot equipment or weapon sheaths.
methods.getItems: Provides direct const access to the internal list of placed section items and coordinates.
methods.getFillPercentage: Calculates the proportion of occupied storage, evaluating either the stack capacity ratio for specialized single-item containers or the ratio of filled 2D grid cells.
methods.getLimitedSlot: Returns the attachment slot category constraint configured for this section.
methods.isLimitedSlotCompatible: Evaluates whether an FCS item blueprint satisfies the section's whitelist, armor filter, and attachment slot constraints.
methods.addVeryLimitedSlot: Appends an item template to the specialized whitelist and expands section grid dimensions if necessary to fit the item's footprint.
methods.clearVeryLimitedSlot: Clears the specialized whitelist array and invalidates parent inventory lookup caches.
methods.getVeryLimitedSlot: Retrieves the whitelist of permitted FCS item blueprint records.
methods.setItemsLimitCount: Configures the maximum number of distinct item stacks permitted within this section.
methods.getItemsLimitReached: Checks whether the current number of distinct stored items has met or exceeded `itemsLimit`.
methods.setupContainerData: Initializes container parameters from an FCS container blueprint, reading `'stackable bonus minimum'` and `'stackable bonus mult'` properties.
methods.applyStackingBonuses: Computes effective stack size for trade goods based on section container multipliers, clamping base amount if specialized whitelists are present.
methods.recalculateTotalWeight: Recalculates aggregate mass of all stored items in kilograms, incorporating backpack nested container reduction multipliers and bubbling updates to owning characters.
methods.setWeightMultiplier: Sets the mass scaling factor applied to all contents stored within this section.
methods.setStackingBonus: Directly overrides baseline minimum stack threshold and scaling multiplier.
methods.getMaxStack: Returns the baseline stacking bonus minimum threshold configured for this section.
methods.notifyModified: Clears parent inventory fit lookup caches and notifies parent inventory of structural modifications.
methods.setupEquipCallbacks: Registers the listening callback entity that receives equipment placement and removal notifications.
methods.getEnabled: Queries whether this section is active and enabled for item interactions.
methods.setEnabled: Updates enabled state and refreshes the corresponding inventory GUI window if active.
methods.getInventory: Returns the parent `Inventory` instance managing this section.

properties._vftable: Virtual method table dispatch pointer for polymorphic section routines (`addItem`, `hasRoomForItem`, etc.).
properties.name: Human-readable and internal section identifier string (e.g., `"main"`, `"backpack_attach"`, `"armour"`).
properties.width: Total horizontal grid tile dimensions of the storage section.
properties.height: Total vertical grid tile dimensions of the storage section.
properties.armourOnly: Restricts acceptable items exclusively to wearable gear (`itemType::ARMOUR`).
properties.items: Linear list of active item records containing item pointers, top-left grid coordinates, and dimensions (0x20 bytes: `0x040`–`0x060`).
properties.content: 2D tile occupancy grid mapping cell coordinates `(x, y)` to occupying `Item*` pointers (0x28 bytes: `0x060`–`0x088`).
properties.stackingBonusMin: Minimum baseline threshold quantity before stack scaling multiplier is applied.
properties.stackingBonusMult: Multiplier scaling maximum stack capacity for eligible stackable trade items.
properties.veryLimitedSlot: Dynamic whitelist array of specific FCS blueprint records permitted in specialized storage containers (0x18 bytes: `0x090`–`0x0A8`).
properties.itemsLimit: Hard ceiling on the count of distinct item instances allowed within this section.
properties.weightMultiplier: Encumbrance scaling factor applied to all items stored inside this section (e.g., backpack weight reduction).
properties.totalWeight: Cached aggregate mass of all stored items in kilograms, incorporating container weight mitigation factors.
properties.isAnEquippedItemSection: True if this section represents a paperdoll equipment slot rather than a generic storage bag.
properties.limitedSlot: Specific attachment slot enumeration constraining acceptable item types (`ATTACH_ANY` = 7).
properties.containerSlot: True if this section represents an attached container (e.g., backpack attachment slot).
properties.callbackObject: Owning or listening entity notified when section items are added, removed, or modified.
properties.parentInventory: Parent inventory coordinator holding and managing this section.
properties.enabled: Active state flag; when false, interaction, insertion, and queries are locked out.

Item.description: Base class representing all concrete physical object entities in Kenshi. Governs 3D OGRE mesh instantiation, PhysX rigid body dynamics, world streaming paging checks, inventory containment links, ownership and theft tracking, persistence across saves, crafting attributes, and specialized downcast RTTI methods for [`Armour`](armour.md), [`Weapon`](weapon.md), [`Crossbow`](crossbow.md), [`Gear`](gear.md), and [`LockedArmour`](lockedarmour.md).

methods.Item: Constructs an `Item` instance, initializing base `InventoryItemBase` parameters, copying manufacturer and material references, setting default physics flags, and clearing entity pointers.
methods.~Item: Destructs the `Item` instance, tearing down active PhysX rigid bodies and OGRE visual meshes via `destroyPhysical()`, then invoking the base destructor `InventoryItemBase::~InventoryItemBase()`.
methods.resetAfterCopy: Resets item state following an object duplication or shallow copy, resetting quantity to 1, charges to original full charge, and detaching physics entities.
methods.activate: Activates the item in the 3D world with explicit spatial coordinates, orientation, kinematic lock flags, and dynamic physics simulation properties.
methods.deactivate: Deactivates physical existence of the item, clearing the demand flag and destroying active physics actors if currently instantiated.
methods.setPositionRotation: Updates the internal transform of the item and configures kinematic position locking.
methods.createPhysical: Asynchronously loads OGRE visual mesh resources and schedules creation of PhysX collision entities via `ResourceLoader`.
methods.destroyPhysical: Tears down active PhysX rigid bodies and OGRE visual meshes, unregistering the item from the spatial zone map (`ZoneMapContent`).
methods.loadUnloadCheck: Handles world streaming chunk paging: destroys physical representation if chunk is paged out, or verifies persistence rules and instantiates 3D actors when chunk is loaded.
methods.isPhysical: Queries if the item has an active or pending 3D physical representation in the world.
methods.setVisible: Sets the rendering visibility flag and updates the underlying OGRE visual entity.
methods.getVisible: Returns the current rendering visibility flag.
methods.getEntity: Retrieves the active OGRE visual mesh entity if currently instantiated in the physical world.
methods.getModelName: Resolves the 3D `.mesh` resource file path from the item's FCS blueprint record (`'mesh'`).
methods.getClassType: Returns the base item type enumeration code (`itemType::ITEM`).
methods.isGear: Virtual fast RTTI downcast checking if item is a [`Gear`](gear.md) instance; returns `nullptr` in base `Item`.
methods.isCrossbow: Virtual fast RTTI downcast checking if item is a [`Crossbow`](crossbow.md) instance; returns `nullptr` in base `Item`.
methods.isArmour: Virtual fast RTTI downcast checking if item is an [`Armour`](armour.md) instance; returns `nullptr` in base `Item`.
methods.isWeapon: Virtual fast RTTI downcast checking if item is a [`Weapon`](weapon.md) instance; returns `nullptr` in base `Item`.
methods.isLockedArmour: Virtual fast RTTI downcast checking if item is a [`LockedArmour`](lockedarmour.md) instance (e.g. slave shackles, fog poles); returns `nullptr` in base `Item`.
methods.isAFactionUniform: Queries if the item acts as a faction disguise/uniform, returning the associated `Faction*` if applicable; returns `nullptr` in base `Item`.
methods.isFood: Static utility evaluating whether an FCS blueprint record represents edible food (`itemFunction == 3`).
methods.isGoodFood: Checks if the item is food and still has remaining edible nutrition charges.
methods.hasIngredients: Checks whether this item requires crafting ingredients specified in its blueprint references.
methods.getCraftTime: Reads the base craft/production time requirement from the item's FCS blueprint (`'production time'`).
methods.getCraftMaterialMult: Returns the material consumption multiplier applied when crafting this item (1.0f in base `Item`).
methods.getLevel: Returns the quality level index of this item.
methods.getTimeout: Returns the item's despawn or decay expiration timestamp.
methods.getInventory: Returns sub-inventory container if item is a container (backpack, chest); returns `nullptr` in base `Item`.
methods.setInventoryWeAreIn: Updates the owning container or character handle holding this item.
methods.getInventoryWeAreIn: Returns the handle of the character or container currently holding this item.
methods.notifyTheftFrom: Registers theft of this item from an entity or storage container, tracing ownership through containers to find the true victim.
methods.findProperOwner: Static helper resolving true owner handle from a polymorphic `RootObject`, recursively resolving through containers.
methods.isPersistant: Queries whether this item is persistently tracked across world chunk streaming boundaries.
methods.setPersistant: Sets the persistent anchor handle for this item.
methods.persistantOwnerExists: Verifies whether the persistent anchoring owner object still exists in the active game world.
methods.serialise: Serializes the item into a savegame record, recording position, orientation, charges, quality, stolen status, and persistent anchor.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Restores item state from a savegame record, restoring position, charges, quality, and persistence.
methods.serialiseInInventory: Serializes the item when stored within an inventory, omitting physical world transform fields.
methods.loadFromSerialiseInInventory: Restores inventory item attributes from a saved state record.
methods._serialise: Low-level serialization routine recording charges, quality, stolen owner handle, and persistence to an FCS record.
methods._loadFromSerialise: Low-level deserialization routine restoring charges, quality, quantity, and stolen status from an FCS record.
methods.createItemEntityCallback: Callback invoked when asynchronous OGRE mesh loading finishes: attaches mesh to scene graph, orients ground placement, constructs PhysX rigid body from `.xml` or bounding box, and registers with `ZoneMapContent`.
methods.createItemEntityCallback_Equipping: Virtual callback invoked when attaching an item mesh to a character's skeleton or equipment attach node; base implementation is a no-op.
methods.destroyItemEntityCallback_Equipping: Virtual callback invoked when detaching an item mesh from an equipment attach node; base implementation is a no-op.
methods.itemEntityCreated: Virtual event hook triggered after the OGRE visual entity is created; base implementation is a no-op.

properties._vftable: Polymorphic virtual method table pointer inherited from `RootObject`.
properties.handle: Unique serialized game entity handle assigned to this physical item.
properties.data: Base FCS template blueprint defining item classification, mesh, and base stats.
properties.manufacturerData: FCS manufacturer record dictating weapon/armor manufacturer quality modifiers.
properties.materialData: FCS material record defining weight, durability, and texture tints.
properties.isInInventory: True if item is actively contained within an inventory section or equipment slot.
properties.inventoryPos: 2D top-left cell coordinate `(x, y)` inside parent section occupancy grid.
properties.inventorySection: Name of parent `InventorySection` currently housing this item.
properties.slotType: Equipment paperdoll slot constraint enum (`ATTACH_WEAPON`, `ATTACH_BACKPACK`, etc.).
properties.originalFullChargeAmount: Initial maximum medical, repair, or battery charges.
properties.isTradeItem: True if item is classified as commercial trade cargo.
properties.isEquipped: True if item is worn on an active paperdoll slot.
properties.isUnique: True if item is a designated unique story artifact protected from automated despawns.
properties.quantity: Stack count currently merged into this physical item record.
properties.itemWidth: Horizontal inventory grid tile footprint size.
properties.itemHeight: Vertical inventory grid tile footprint size.
properties.deathItem: Flag marking item as drop-on-death loot.
properties.properOwner: Entity handle of the rightful owner for crime and stolen goods detection.
properties._whosInventoryWeAreIn: Entity handle of the character or container holding this item.
properties._isResearchArtifact: True if blueprint contributes to research tech unlocking.
properties.itemGroup: Pointer to shop shelf or building item display cluster.
properties.physicalShouldExist: World streaming demand flag indicating item should have a 3D physical actor.
properties.existAsBareWeapon: Flag rendering item as an unsheathed, unholstered weapon model.
properties.persistant: Persistent anchor handle maintaining object across savegames and chunk unloads.
properties.visible: Ground visual mesh visibility state flag.
properties.physical: PhysX rigid body entity simulating collision and gravity in the physical world.
properties._isPhysical: Active simulation status flag indicating rigid body is instantiated in PhysX scene.
properties.physicalEntity: OGRE 3D graphical mesh entity rendered in the visual scene graph.
properties.creatingPhysical: Asynchronous resource loading mutex flag preventing redundant mesh requests.
properties.fixedPhysicalPosition: Kinematic fixed position lock preventing gravity and impulse displacement.
properties.useDynamicPhysics: Dynamic physics toggle allowing dropped items to roll and tumble realistically.
properties.loadingEntity: Temporary OGRE entity handle while asynchronous mesh load is in flight.

LocaleManager.description: Internationalization and localization manager handling language catalogs, translation dictionaries, East Asian typography fallbacks, and mod translation packs.

methods.~LocaleManager: Destructs the `LocaleManager` instance and releases allocated resources.

properties.localeById: Map of locale descriptors keyed by language tag.
properties.localeList: Flat storage array of all available language profiles.
properties.availableLanguages: List of active available language pointers.
properties.modLocale: Custom locale override supplied by active translation mod.
properties.localePath: Disk path to localization po/mo translation dictionaries.

LockedArmour.description: `LockedArmour` is a specialized subclass of `Armour` that incorporates a lock mechanism, primarily used for slave shackles and similar items.

methods.LockedArmour: Constructs a new `LockedArmour` instance. Initializes the base `Armour` class and dynamically allocates its `DoorLock` component, populating its attributes from the provided `baseData`.
methods.~LockedArmour: Destroys the `LockedArmour` instance, safely freeing the allocated `DoorLock` mechanism before delegating to the base `Armour` destructor.
methods.isArmour: Runtime type identification method returning the `this` pointer cast to an `Armour` pointer.
methods.isLockedArmour: Runtime type identification method returning the `this` pointer cast to a `LockedArmour` pointer.
methods._serialise: Serializes the locked armour to a `GameData` instance. Extends the base `Gear` serialization by capturing the internal lock state.
methods._loadFromSerialise: Deserializes the locked armour state from a save node. Extends the base `Gear` deserialization to restore the internal lock mechanism's configuration.
methods.getTooltipData1: Generates the tooltip UI content for the locked armour, indicating whether it's locked, unlocked, or broken, and displays the required skill/strength limits for removal.
methods.getTooltipData2: Generates supplementary tooltip data. In the case of `LockedArmour`, this acts as a stub or secondary tooltip pass.

MainBarGUI.description: Main HUD bottom control bar managing squad portraits, simulation speed controls, time and currency readouts, floor level selectors, and orders toggles. Orchestrates interactive portrait item boxes across squad tabs ([`MainTabPortraitPlatoon`](#)), contextual inspection datapanels ([`DatapanelGUI`](datapanelgui.md)), vital limb health displays ([`MedicalDatapanel`](#)), and GOAP task stance selectors ([`OrdersPanel`](#)).

methods.MainBarGUI: Primary constructor for `MainBarGUI`. Initializes `GUIWindow` base and `wraps::BaseLayout` widget hierarchy from XML, sets up bottom HUD dock geometry, binds speed buttons, day/clock text widgets, floor controls, town panels, and registers input key listeners.
methods.~MainBarGUI: Virtual destructor destroying squad portrait item boxes, deallocating tab controllers, unhooking MyGUI widget listeners, clearing registered datapanels, and tearing down sliding attribute drawer widgets.
methods.clear: Clears all dynamic HUD elements across the main control bar. Resets squad portrait tabs, unbinds selected target datapanels, clears active orders buttons, and hides contextual bounty notices.
methods.show: Controls overall HUD visibility of the bottom main bar. Toggles child widgets (portraits, speed controls, clock, datapanels) and updates layout geometry upon display.
methods.update: Per-frame HUD update tick. Refreshes in-game clock and day counters, synchronizes player faction Cats balance, updates sliding drawer animation interpolation, samples geographical biome triggers, checks town territorial jurisdiction, and updates character health and combat stance panels.
methods.autoChangeSelectedObject: Dispatched when the primary active object selection changes in the game world. Automatically inspects the newly selected object, switches the active HUD datapanel (character stats, building details, town jurisdiction), and selects the corresponding squad portrait.
methods.pressedKey: Processes direct keyboard shortcuts dispatched to the HUD main bar, including simulation speed keys (Pause, 1, 2, 3, 4), squad member selection hotkeys (1-9, F1-F12), floor level changes, and sub-window toggle shortcuts.
methods.getPausePanel: Retrieves the widget pointer for the fullscreen/modal 'PAUSED' simulation status banner widget.
methods.getLoadingPanel: Retrieves the widget pointer for the background streaming asset loading indicator panel.
methods.getBuildingInventoryPosition: Retrieves the screen pixel anchor coordinates (`buildingInventoryPosition`) where building and container inventory windows attach relative to the bottom HUD dock.
methods.setMessagePosition: Computes and establishes the screen anchor coordinate position (`messagePosition`) for floating toast notifications, tutorial hints, and dialogue speech bubbles.
methods.serialise: Serializes MainBarGUI runtime state into a `GameData` savegame record, persisting floor level settings, squad tab configurations, and extended info panel expansion flags.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Deserializes and restores MainBarGUI state from a `GameData` savegame record, restoring floor slice levels, UI layout preferences, and drawer states.
methods._getWidget: Internal helper resolving a named child MyGUI widget from the BaseLayout hierarchy.
methods.speedChanged: Callback dispatched when simulation speed is altered externally or via game systems. Synchronizes the visual pressed/highlighted state across the four playback speed buttons (Pause, 1x, 2x, 5x).
methods.setLevelEditMode: Toggles in-game FCS level editor HUD overlay mode, adjusting camera clip planes and revealing developer placement widgets.
methods.setLevelEditInteriorMode: Toggles building interior level editing mode in the in-game editor tools.
methods.changeFloorButtonUp: UI button callback for ascending the rendered building interior floor slice. Increments active interior floor level, updates floor text display, and changes building cutaway rendering planes.
methods.changeFloorButtonDown: UI button callback for descending the rendered building interior floor slice. Decrements active interior floor level down to ground floor.
methods.changeSpeed: UI button callback handling user clicks on simulation speed buttons. Determines the selected speed index from the sender widget and sets the global game simulation time factor.
methods.closeMapWindow: Explicitly closes the world map and territory navigation window via `ForgottenGUI`.
methods.toggleMapWindow: Toggles visibility of the world map and exploration navigation window.
methods.toggleFactionWindow: Toggles visibility of the Faction and Diplomatic relations window.
methods.toggleTechWindow: Toggles visibility of the Research & Technology progression window.
methods.toggleCraftWindow: Toggles visibility of the Crafting & Item Production queue window.
methods.toggleSquadWindow: Toggles visibility of the Squad Management screen (`SquadManagementScreen`), allowing squad reorganization, division of platoons, and naming.
methods.toggleInventory: Toggles visibility of the primary player character inventory window.
methods.toggleStatsWindow: Toggles visibility of the detailed Character Attributes and Combat Statistics window.
methods.toggleHelpWindow: Toggles visibility of the in-game Help and Tutorial documentation window.
methods.buildButton: Opens the base building and construction placement menu (`BuildingMode`), enabling player outpost architecture and furniture construction.
methods.getPortrait: Retrieves portrait cell data (`PortraitData`) located at the specified 2D screen coordinate within the squad portrait tray.
methods.updatePortrait: Marks the portrait of the specified character dirty, queueing a render-to-texture portrait snapshot refresh.
methods.platoonUpdated: Callback invoked when squad composition changes (e.g. member recruited, dismissed, killed, or moved between squads). Synchronizes portrait counts and rebuilds tab item box layouts.
methods.updatePotraitsPlatoon: Updates squad platoon tab headers and character portrait cards across all active squad tabs.
methods.updatePortraits: Refreshes all squad member portrait widgets, updating health indicator bars, encumbrance icons, state alerts (unconscious, dying, imprisoned), and selection rings.
methods.refreshPortraitTabs: Rebuilds and synchronizes the squad tab bar (`portraitsTabPanel`), adding or removing tab headers corresponding to the player's active squads.
methods.updatePortraitSize: Recalculates portrait card dimensions and spacing for the given squad platoon to ensure optimal layout within the portrait tray.
methods.getTabPlatoonPortrait: Retrieves the squad tab controller (`MainTabPortraitPlatoon`) at the specified numerical tab index.
methods.portraitChangeSelection: Handles portrait selection changes when the user clicks a character portrait card. Updates active character selection, supports multi-selection with Shift/Ctrl, and optionally centers the camera if `follow` is true.
methods.portraitSelectItemAccept: Handles portrait double-click or confirmation acceptance, locking camera tracking onto the selected squad member.
methods.portraitNotifyItem: MyGUI notification dispatcher handling mouse hover, drag-and-drop, and context menu events on individual squad portrait items.
methods.tabPlatoonChange: Callback dispatched when the player switches squad tabs. Activates the corresponding platoon portrait tray and hides inactive squad tabs.
methods.updateBountyPanelVisibility: Updates the visibility and contents of the bounty notification panel (`bountyPanel`). Displays wanted status, issuing faction, and bounty value if the selected character is a wanted criminal.
methods.getMedicalPanel: Retrieves the medical health monitor datapanel (`MedicalDatapanel*`) displaying vital organ damage and limb condition readouts.
methods.ordersPanelFill: Populates the combat stance and GOAP job order panel (`OrdersPanel`) with current orders and toggles for the specified character.
methods.ordersPanelClear: Clears and disables the character orders panel when no character is selected or when inspecting an un-commandable entity.
methods.getToolTip: Retrieves the fixed tooltip helper widget (`ToolTipFixed*`) used across the main HUD bar.
methods.getDatapanel: Resolves a contextual entity inspection datapanel (`DatapanelGUI*`) by string identifier key from the `datapanels` registry map.
methods.setExtendInfoPanelEnabled: Enables or disables the sliding extended character attributes drawer button depending on whether an inspectable character is selected.
methods.extendInfoPanel: Initiates drawer slide expansion or retraction animation for the extended character stats panel (`extendedInfoPanel`). Sets interpolation targets and duration.

MapScreen.description: World map cartography and tactical navigation screen in Kenshi. Embedded inside `ManagementScreen`. Manages orthographic map rendering, viewport scroll/pan and multi-tier zoom interpolation (`mapScrollView`), settlement and outpost markers (`MapMarkerTown`), squad character tracking pins (`MapMarkerCharacter`), movement destination waypoints, and road network vector overlays (`MapRoad`).

methods.MapScreen: Primary constructor for `MapScreen`. Instantiates MyGUI widgets (`mapScrollView`, `mapImage`, `cameraMarker`), initializes discrete zoom level scaling tiers (`zoomLevels[3]`), registers mouse event callbacks, creates marker containers, and loads world road overlay lines.
methods.~MapScreen: Destructor for `MapScreen`. Clears temporary and static town/character map markers, destroys road line widgets, releases MyGUI widget resources, and clears squad lists.
methods.clear: Cleans up all dynamic town and character marker widgets from the map canvas, resetting marker lookup tables.
methods.getVisible: Queries whether the map screen interface is currently open and visible to the player.
methods.hide: Hides the map UI screen and terminates active panning or dragging states.
methods.centerCamera: Centers the map viewport view on the player's active 3D camera world focus coordinate.
methods.refresh: Triggers complete refresh of town discovery states, player outpost icons, squad locations, and active road networks.
methods.update: Per-frame update loop for the map screen. Synchronizes camera look-at pin position and rotation, updates squad marker coordinates, animates movement destination pins, and updates hover tooltips.
methods.updateCameraMarker: Updates the 2D map marker position and rotation representing the 3D game camera focus point and yaw heading.
methods.centerButton: UI button event handler centering the map viewport onto current player camera coordinates.
methods.updateZoom: Applies smooth interpolated zoom magnification to `mapScrollView` canvas, adjusting marker scale and position offsets.
methods.worldToMapCoords: Projects a 3D world coordinate (X, Z) into 2D pixel coordinates on the full-resolution world map canvas.
methods.mapCoordsToWorld: Unprojects a 2D pixel coordinate on the map canvas back into 3D world coordinates (X, 0, Z).
methods.zoomInButton: UI button event handler incrementing the map magnification zoom level tier.
methods.zoomOutButton: UI button event handler decrementing the map magnification zoom level tier.
methods.getMouseWorldPosition: Converts current mouse cursor position over the map viewport into a 3D terrain world coordinate for move orders.
methods.mapMouseWheel: MyGUI mouse wheel event handler adjusting map zoom level dynamically around cursor position.
methods.mapMousePressed: MyGUI mouse press event handler initiating click-drag panning (left click) or issuing long-distance move orders (right click).
methods.mapMouseReleased: MyGUI mouse release event handler terminating drag panning operation.
methods.addSquad: Registers a player squad platoon (`Platoon*`) to display and track on the world map screen.
methods.removeSquad: Removes a player squad platoon from map tracking and destroys its associated map marker icon.
methods.refreshSquads: Iterates tracked player squads, refreshing position coordinates and updating icon selection outlines.
methods.updateCharacterMarker: Updates 2D map coordinate position and faction color for a specific character or squad leader marker.
methods.getMarkerColor: Selects the appropriate MyGUI color (Player, Ally, Neutral, Enemy) based on faction diplomatic stance with respect to player.
methods.clearTempMarkers: Clears temporary destination waypoint markers from the map canvas.
methods.setMovementMarker: Places a pulsating waypoint marker icon on the map indicating commanded squad destination with auto-fade duration.
methods.updatePlayerTownMapMarker: Updates or creates a map marker for a player-founded settlement when an outpost marker is established.
methods.refreshTowns: Refreshes all discovered town and outpost markers on the map, updating faction icon coats of arms and town names.
methods.showRoads: Toggles visibility of the road overlay network on the map screen.
methods.setupRoads: Constructs 2D polyline road networks on the map canvas extracted from zone road navigation data.
methods.updateRoads: Updates visibility and zoom-level thickness scaling of rendered road network polyline widgets.

MedicalSystem.description: Governs: - **Anatomy & Damage Types**: Cut damage (bleeding & bandage degeneration), Blunt damage (stun), Wear damage (robotics degradation), and Acid/Weather erosion. - **Bleeding & Blood Loss**: Dynamic bleed rates, blood pool splattering, and blood loss coma (`pointOfCollapseBloodloss`). - **Consciousness & Recovery**: Shock knockout thresholds, recovery timers (`knockoutTimer`), coma states (`pointOfNoReturn`), and waking up (`canGetUpWakeUp`). - **Dismemberment & Prosthetics**: Limbs severed (`amputate`), crushed (`crushLimb`), or replaced with robotic prosthetics ([`RobotLimbs`](#robotlimbs)). - **Medical Treatment**: First aid bandaging (`applyFirstAid`), bone splinting (`applyDoctoring`), and robotic repair (`applyRigging`). - **Nutrition & Starvation**: Calorie depletion (`hunger`, `fed`), starvation speed penalties, and starvation coma.

methods.addWound: Primary combat damage injection gateway: selects target bodypart based on weighted hit chances and attack direction, applies armor mitigation from `armourList`, calculates cut/blunt wound distribution, checks limb severance, and splats blood decals.
methods.applyDamage: Internal damage distribution routine routing cut damage into flesh and bleeding, blunt damage into stun, and wear into robotic degradation.
methods.amputate: Severely amputates a limb from the character, detaching it from the skeleton, spawning a physical `SeveredLimbItem` with momentum, inducing massive bleeding, and updating animations.
methods.setRobotLimbItem: Attaches or detaches a prosthetic robotic limb item on the specified limb socket.
methods.applyFirstAid: Applies first-aid bandaging to biological cut wounds, converting cut damage into bandaged state and depleting first-aid kit charges.
methods.MedicalSystem: Default constructor for `MedicalSystem`, initializing bodypart containers, vitals buffers, hunger saturation (nominal 100.0f), blood capacity, and nullifying references.
methods.~MedicalSystem: Destructs the `MedicalSystem` instance, deallocating active bodypart status records, clearing equipped armor arrays, and tearing down prosthetic limb subsystems.
methods.init: Initializes the anatomical structure of the character, instantiating `HealthPartStatus` records for every body part specified in the race template, caching limb pointers, and configuring default health multipliers.
methods.notifyRaceChange: Reconfigures the anatomical topology when race is changed, rebuilding `status` and `anatomy` lists from race body part references (Head, Chest, Stomach, Left Arm, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg).
methods.medicalUpdate: Main high-frequency per-frame simulation update, advancing blood loss calculations, natural biological wound healing, robotic wear degradation, knockout countdown timers, and updating pain animations.
methods.periodicUpdate: Low-frequency simulation tick executed roughly once per in-game hour, processing caloric hunger consumption, starvation checks, hunger coma, and blood replenishment.
methods.updateStats: Refreshes cached limb health ratings, verifies arm weapon-holding capability, evaluates leg cripple state, and recalculates derived stealth and movement penalties.

methods.applyRigging: Applies robotics repair to damaged prosthetic or skeleton limbs using a Robotics Repair Kit.
methods.drainMedkit: Drains charges from the active medical or robotics repair kit based on treatment duration and medic efficiency.

methods.calculateBleedRateForFX: Calculates particle emission intensity scalar for visual bleeding effects.
methods.isFullyRested: Checks whether all body parts are at 100% maximum health and blood volume is full.
methods.isDead: Checks whether the character has permanently died.

NavMesh.description: Master navigation system integrating Havok AI (hkaiWorld). Manages asynchronous pathfinding queries, outdoor terrain sectors, interior building NavMesh instances, door traversal gates, and origin shifts. Interacts directly with [`HavokCharacter`](havokcharacter.md) for character agent path following, [`ZoneMap`](zonemap.md) for outdoor terrain tile streaming, [`Building`](building.md) for interior navigational cutouts and door states, and [`ThreadClass`](threadclass.md) for dedicated background multi-threaded path calculation.

NavMeshGenerator.description: Background worker thread generating and carving NavMesh polygon meshes from raw terrain heightfields, static meshes, and dynamic building obstacle hulls. Integrates Havok AI (`hkaiNavMesh`, `hkaiNavMeshGenerationSettings`) with PhysX collision scenes, orchestrating multi-threaded task queues, building doorway connections, dynamic obstacle excision, and seamless adjacent zone edge stitching.

methods.isGenerating: Queries whether the generator is actively computing a task or has pending jobs remaining in the queue.
methods.setup: Initializes default Havok AI navmesh parameters: character walk slope, step height, agent radius, climbing limits, rasterization cell size, and polygon simplification thresholds.
methods.threadProc: Primary worker thread procedure. Continuously pops generation tasks from `queue`, executes voxelization, polygon extraction, carving, and stitching, and pushes completed tasks into `done` queue.
methods.updateBT: Worker thread execution tick. Processes the next active task from the queue, invoking `generateTaskBT` within a try-catch block to prevent worker thread aborts.
methods.revertSettings: Restores Havok AI generation settings back to global engine defaults after a customized building interior or obstacle carving pass.
methods.unlockTask: Releases the multi-threaded lock on a task after main thread consumption and deallocates task memory.
methods.newTask: Allocates and initializes a new NavMesh generation `Task` structure for the specified zone, bounding box, and world coordinate offset.
methods.NavMeshGenerator: Primary constructor for `NavMeshGenerator`. Initializes `ThreadClass` worker thread, binds parent `NavMesh` manager, configures Havok AI generation settings (`hkaiNavMeshGenerationSettings`), initializes task queues, and allocates PhysX shape query buffers.
methods.~NavMeshGenerator: Virtual destructor terminating background generation worker thread, purging pending and completed task queues, releasing Havok AI generation settings, and deallocating PhysX query buffers.
methods.update: Main thread update tick called from `NavMesh::update`. Retrieves finished tasks from the `done` queue, registers completed `NavInstance` meshes into the world, and initiates adjacent zone border stitching.
methods.lockZone: Acquires exclusive generation lock on the specified zone coordinates, preventing duplicate generation passes across adjacent threads.
methods.unlockZone: Releases the exclusive generation lock on the specified zone coordinates.
methods.addJob: Dispatches a NavMesh generation job for multiple building structures in a zone. If `splice` is true, performs localized mesh cutting and welding rather than full zone regeneration.
methods.addStitchJob: Enqueues an edge-stitching job between the given NavInstance and all adjacent loaded or cached navmesh boundaries.
methods.hasJob: Checks whether there are any pending or in-progress generation tasks registered for the specified zone.
methods.getCollisionShapes: Queries PhysX scene overlap within the specified 3D bounding box to extract physical collision shapes for navmesh generation.
methods.createHeightmapMesh: Extracts terrain heightfield geometry from the `ZoneMap` and constructs a Havok triangular geometry representation (`hkGeometry`) offset by world coordinates.
methods.addWaterPlane: Adds a horizontal water plane surface to Havok geometry, allowing swimming and deep-water navigation polygon classifications.
methods.generateInteriorMesh: Generates detailed interior collision geometry for a building structure, extracting stairs, multi-floor slabs, interior walls, and doorways.
methods.generateBuildingMesh: Generates exterior building collision obstacle meshes within the specified bounds, creating solid blocking volumes for building foundations.
methods.getInteriorCavers: Computes interior carving volumes for buildings within the query bounds, carving out exterior ground mesh where buildings stand.
methods.getVolumePoints: Extracts convex volume vertices from a PhysX shape under a Havok transform.
methods.getDoorPainters: Identifies doorway portals across buildings within the bounds and registers them as door painting volumes in Havok AI settings, enabling doorway connectivity.
methods.addFoliageCarvers: Extracts solid foliage and large boulder/tree collision volumes in the zone and registers them as Havok obstacle carvers.
methods.createVolume: Allocates and constructs an `hkaiVolume` obstacle representation from a PhysX collision shape.
methods.addGeometry: Appends triangle mesh collision geometry into a `hkGeometry` buffer, applying transformation matrix and material attributes.
methods.generateTaskBT: Dispatches high-level generation task logic on the worker thread based on task type: full zone generation, building splicing, or dynamic obstacle carving.
methods.validateBuildingStates: Validates construction and demolition states for all buildings involved in the generation task, ensuring destroyed or moved structures are properly excised.
methods.carve: Carves out dynamic obstacle volumes from an existing Havok NavMesh, cutting polygon edges and creating walkable boundaries around new building footprints.
methods.shiftEdge: Shifts boundary edges of a carved mesh to align seamlessly with the base navmesh border geometry.
methods.shiftHole: Fills and closes degenerate holes or gaps formed along interior carving seams.
methods.splice: Performs localized navmesh splicing, cutting a rectangular sub-region out of an existing navmesh tile and welding a newly generated replacement patch.
methods.stitch: Welds matching boundary edges between two adjacent `NavInstance` meshes, generating cross-instance transition portals (`hkaiDirectedGraphExplicitRigid`) for seamless world navigation.
methods.stitchUnloadedZone: Stitches a newly loaded `NavInstance` against an adjacent zone tile that is cached or un-instantiated, using serialized border edge records.
methods.stitchInterior: Stitches building interior navmesh floor slabs to exterior ground entrance portals, connecting doorways to the outdoor pathfinding grid.
methods.stitchExterior: Stitches exterior ground navmesh around building perimeters to surrounding outdoor terrain mesh.
methods.stitchWithInteriors: Batch stitches an exterior `NavInstance` with a collection of interior building navmesh instances.
methods.getSeedPointsFromAdjacentZone: Extracts flood-fill seed points from an adjacent zone boundary, ensuring continuous connected traversable surface discovery across zone borders.
methods.getCompletedTask: Searches the `done` queue for a completed task matching the designated UID, returning its output `NavInstance`.
