OrdersReceiver.description: Core task management, order arbitration, and player command dispatch subsystem in Kenshi. Manages player interactive action queues (`ActionDeque orders`), autonomous permanent jobs (`permajobs`), Goal-Oriented Action Planning goal priority tiers (`goals[5]`), squad AI packages (`squadAIPackage[5]`), and subordinate slave job delegations (`slaveJobs`).

methods.OrdersReceiver: Primary constructor for `OrdersReceiver`. Links owner character and AI controller (`AI*`), initializes default combat aggro mode (`AI_AGGRESSIVE`), allocates empty FIFO order deque (`orders`), initializes permajob containers, goal priority queues, and resets GOAP flags.
methods.~OrdersReceiver: Virtual destructor for `OrdersReceiver`. Clears pending action deque, releases dynamically allocated `Tasker*` jobs and permajobs, frees GOAP goal buckets across all 5 priority tiers, and clears subordinate slave jobs.
methods._forceOrderInsert: Directly forces insertion of a high-priority order task into the front of the player action queue (`orders`), bypassing standard arbitration.
methods.addOrder: Enqueues an interactive player command (move, attack, interact) into the order deque. If `clearOld` is set, discards existing queued actions; if `shift` is true, queues behind current tasks without preemption.
methods.updateLastOrder: Updates target coordinate or target entity handle of the most recently enqueued player order.
methods.getFirstOrder: Peeks at the active head order at the front of the action deque (`orders`).
methods.clearOrders: Clears and deallocates all pending interactive orders in the action deque, halting manual player tasks.
methods.setHoldPositionOrders: Assigns or clears explicit 'Hold Position' stance orders (`holdPositionOrders`), anchoring character to current coordinate.
methods.hasPlayerOrders: Checks whether the action deque contains any active, uncompleted manual player orders.
methods.hasPlayerOrder: Checks whether a specific task type is currently pending within the player order deque.
methods.hasOrders: Evaluates whether any commands (manual orders or hold position) are active on this receiver.
methods.addJob: Appends a permanent autonomous job (crafting, farming, guarding, hauling) to the permanent jobs list (`permajobs`).
methods.removeJob: Removes temporary job instances of a specific task type from the dynamic jobs list (`jobs`).
methods.removePermajob: Removes a permanent job at the specified index from `permajobs`, shifting subsequent job priorities up.
methods.movePermajob: Reorders permanent jobs in the priority list, moving a permajob from `taskIdx` to `targetIdx`.
methods.clearPermajobs: Purges and deallocates all assigned permanent jobs from `permajobs`.
methods.getPermajobName: Retrieves the display string name of a permanent job occupying a specified priority slot.
methods.getPermajob: Queries the `TaskType` enumeration of the permajob in a specified priority slot.
methods.getPermajobData: Returns pointer to the underlying `Tasker` data descriptor of the permajob in a specified slot.
methods.getPermajobCount: Returns the total number of configured permanent jobs currently assigned to this character.
methods.hasPermajob: Checks whether a permajob of the specified task type is currently configured in `permajobs`.
methods.clearJobs: Clears all temporary dynamic jobs from `jobs` list.
methods.isJobsEnabled: Queries whether the automated permanent jobs execution toggle (`doJobsEnabled`) is active.
methods.setJobsEnabled: Enables or disables autonomous permanent job execution (`doJobsEnabled`). When disabled, character idles rather than working.
methods.addGoal: Inserts an AI goal task into the appropriate priority tier array in `goals[5]`, triggering GOAP re-evaluation.
methods.removeGoal: Removes all AI goals matching specified task type across all priority tiers in `goals[5]`.
methods.hasGoal: Checks whether an active goal of the specified task type exists in any priority tier.
methods.setNeedGOAP: Sets the `needGOAP = true` dirty flag, instructing the AI subsystem to run a fresh Goal-Oriented Action Planning solve pass on next frame.
methods._clearGoals: Internal routine clearing and deallocating all goal descriptors across all 5 priority tiers in `goals`.
methods.getCurrentGoal: Retrieves const reference to the currently selected active goal match descriptor (`currentGoal`).
methods.isInChoosingGoalMode: Queries whether the AI is currently in the middle of goal arbitration and candidate evaluation (`choosingGoalMode`).
methods.clearCurrentGoal: Resets and clears the currently executing goal (`currentGoal`), optionally forcing abort even during critical actions.
methods.tryToGetCurrentGoal: Evaluates candidate goals across priority tiers, orders deque, and permajobs, returning the winning `Tasker*` candidate.
methods.getSlaveJobs: Populates `out` with delegated subordinate jobs (`slaveJobs`) inherited from owner or squad master AI repertoire.
methods.clearSlaveJobs: Clears and frees all delegated subordinate tasks stored in `slaveJobs`.
methods.serialise: Serializes active orders, permanent assigned jobs, combat aggro stance, and hold-position tasks into a `GameData` save record.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Deserializes orders, permanent jobs, and tactical stances from a `GameData` record during game loading, reconstructing task instances and enqueuing them.

properties.mainGoalTarget: Target entity or item handle of primary active goal (`0x010`–`0x030`).
properties.superDefenseMode: Passive block / hold ground defense mode toggle (`0x034`).
properties.doJobsEnabled: Global toggle enabling autonomous permanent job execution (`0x035`).
properties.orders: FIFO deque of player interactive movement and command orders (`0x038`–`0x070`).
properties.permajobs: Ordered priority list of assigned permanent jobs (`0x088`–`0x0A0`).
properties.goals: Five priority tier buckets of active autonomous GOAP goals (`0x0A0`–`0x118`).
properties.squadAIPackage: Five priority tier buckets of platoon/squad AI packages (`0x118`–`0x190`).
properties.holdPositionOrders: Explicit hold ground / stay put stance task pointer (`0x190`–`0x198`).
properties.needGOAP: Dirty flag requesting fresh GOAP planning pass next frame (`0x1B0`).
properties.choosingGoalMode: Active goal evaluation and arbitration status flag (`0x1B1`).
properties.aiImplementation: Pointer to master AI decision engine coordinator (`0x1B8`–`0x1C0`).
properties.currentGoal: Currently arbitrated and executing GOAP goal match structure (`0x1C0`–`0x208`).
properties.currentGoalScore: Utility evaluation score of the active goal (`0x208`–`0x20C`).
properties.currentGoalPriority: Priority tier classification of current goal (`0x20C`–`0x210`).

PhysicsActual.description: Concrete PhysX 2.8 physics implementation managing scene creation, raycasting queries, rigid body dynamics, collision filters, and simulation steps.

methods.~PhysicsActual: Destructs the `PhysicsActual` instance and releases allocated resources.
methods.updateUT: Executes simulation and state update tick for `PhysicsActual`.
methods.backThreadUpdate: Executes simulation and state update tick for `PhysicsActual`.

properties._base: Base physics interface and virtual method dispatch table.

PhysicsInterface.description: Abstract virtual interface decoupling game logic and character locomotion from concrete PhysX and Havok simulation implementations.

methods.~PhysicsInterface: Destructs the `PhysicsInterface` instance and releases allocated resources.

properties._vftable: Virtual method table pointer for abstract physics interface.

Platoon.description: Macro military and civilian squad controller governing group formation navigation, roster management, squad AI tasks, patrol waypoints, persistent serialization, and asset ownership. Derived from [`RootObjectBase`](rootobject.md), `Platoon` bridges active 3D world reality and abstract background simulation. Coordinates directly with [`Faction`](faction.md) for political allegiance, [`Character`](character.md) for individual squad members, [`ActivePlatoon`](activeplatoon.md) for live scene graph entities, [`Ownerships`](ownerships.md) for squad currency and property ledgers, and [`TownBase`](townbase.md) for municipal settlement assignments.

methods.Platoon: Primary constructor initializing squad identity string, allocating embedded Ownerships ledger, binding parent faction, and configuring squad template rules.
methods.~Platoon: Virtual destructor unregistering all squad characters, releasing patrol paths, cleaning up blackboard memory, and destroying embedded ownership structures.
methods.isUnconcious: Evaluates whether every active character in the squad is currently unconscious, in a coma, or dying.
methods.setFaction: Transfers ownership of the platoon to a new political faction, re-evaluating diplomatic alignments, enemy lists, and uniform color palettes.
methods.isUnique: Polymorphic RTTI downcast query checking whether this squad is a named `UniquePlatoon`.
methods.getPlatoonStringID: Retrieves the persistent unique alphanumeric identifier string assigned to this platoon.
methods.getDataType: Returns the FCS item type identifier corresponding to platoon squad entities (`itemType::SQUAD`).
methods.isIntact: Checks if the platoon has at least one conscious, active member capable of movement and combat.
methods.declareDead: Flags the squad as wiped out / dead, setting `isDead = true` and queuing members for deregistration.
methods.undeclareDead: Clears the dead flag, restoring the squad to life upon recruitment or emergency medical revival.
methods.activate: Transitions the platoon from background simulation to the active 3D world, instantiating character entities and ragdolls.
methods.deactivate: Deactivates the platoon when its world chunk unloads, converting physical characters into lightweight unloaded state structures.
methods.isFullyLoaded: Queries whether all characters in the squad have finished streaming and spawning into active reality.
methods.getActivePlatoon: Retrieves pointer to the `ActivePlatoon` container holding live character entities and physical nodes.
methods.getUnloadedPlatoon: Retrieves pointer to the `UnloadedPlatoon` container holding abstract background character data.
methods.isPersistentSquad: Queries whether this squad is marked as persistent across game saves.
methods.setPersistentSquad: Configures whether this platoon persists permanently in the save file.
methods.reCheckPersistenceOnUnload: Re-evaluates whether the squad must be retained when unloading, checking if unique NPCs or player interactions occurred.
methods.setCharacterCount: Sets the internal tracked character count for the squad.
methods.canTakeRefugees: Evaluates whether this squad has sufficient roster capacity and compatible alignment to absorb refugees from another squad.
methods.getNearestActiveCharacter: Searches squad members and returns active character closest to given 3D coordinates.
methods.getSquadLeader: Retrieves pointer to the character designated as current squad leader.
methods.getSquadLeader_theRealOne: Retrieves persistent entity handle referencing the true authoritative squad leader.
methods.getCharacterCount: Retrieves the current number of living characters in the squad.
methods.getCharacterCount_Original: Retrieves the original baseline population count of the squad when spawned.
methods.needsNewCharacters: Computes deficit between current population and original spawn quota to determine recruit replenishment needs.
methods.getSquadType: Retrieves squad operational classification enum (e.g. MILITARY, CARAVAN, PATROL, HOME_DEFENSE).
methods.setSquadType: Assigns squad operational type classification enum.
methods.hasCampaign: Checks if the squad is currently dispatched on an active war campaign or raid mission.
methods.getBlackboard: Retrieves pointer to squad AI `Blackboard` holding shared tactical intelligence and target threats.
methods.getStateBroadcast: Retrieves tactical broadcast state sharing crime alerts and target locks across nearby friendly units.
methods.reprocessTask: Re-evaluates and refreshes an assigned character task through the squad task management scheduler.
methods.taskIsComplete: Callback invoked when a squad task finishes execution, selecting the next priority queued order.
methods.notifyMissionEnded: Notifies squad that an assigned military campaign or mission objective has concluded.
methods.chooseNewHome: Evaluates candidate friendly towns within territorial range and binds a new home settlement.
methods.getCurrentTownLocation: Retrieves pointer to town structure currently enclosing or nearest to the squad's world position.
methods.setupPatrolSettings: Configures territorial patrol radius limits around home settlement or outpost anchor.
methods.getPatrolInfo: Retrieves pointer to `PatrolInfo` controlling waypoints and wandering intervals.
methods.getRoamingMapArea: Retrieves pointer to geographic biome area partition restricting squad roaming boundaries.
methods.setRoamingMapArea: Restricts squad wandering paths to the specified regional biome area.
methods.iBuyStolenGoods: Checks if merchants or fences in this squad will purchase stolen contraband goods.
methods.iBuyIllegalGoods: Checks if merchants in this squad will trade in illegal outlawed goods (e.g. Hashish, Bloodrum).
methods.getOwnerships: Retrieves pointer to embedded `Ownerships` ledger managing squad currency (Cats), captive slaves, and owned structures.
methods.showDebugMarker: Toggles rendering of the debug 3D squad locator model in the scene graph.
methods.update: Primary frame update tick evaluating member health, checking leader coherence, and triggering task step advances.
methods.periodicUpdate_active: Periodic low-frequency update for active squads, checking nutrition, medical bleeding, and camp tasks.
methods.periodicUpdate_unloaded: Periodic update for unloaded squads, updating virtual march progress and healing in the background.
methods.erasePlatoonFile: Deletes on-disk serialized platoon file when squad is permanently disbanded or wiped out.
methods.serialiseEverything: Serializes all character states, medical statuses, and equipment within the platoon.
methods.loadStateData: Restores character state data and attributes from serialized record.
methods.serialise: Exports complete squad hierarchy, members, inventory, and task queues into savegame state.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Restores platoon state, character rosters, and waypoints from loaded savegame structure.
methods.setDataFilename: Assigns custom disk filename for platoon serialization.

properties._base: Inherited root object base state (120 bytes: `0x000`–`0x078`).
properties.stringID: Persistent unique alphanumeric squad identifier string (40 bytes: `0x078`–`0x0A0`).
properties._characterCountCurrent: Current number of living squad members (4 bytes: `0x0A0`–`0x0A4`).
properties._characterCountOriginal: Original baseline squad population quota (4 bytes: `0x0A4`–`0x0A8`).
properties.hasUniques: Tristate flag indicating presence of unique/named NPCs (4 bytes: `0x0AC`–`0x0B0`).
properties.isSeparatedSquad: Entity handle of parent platoon if split/detached (32 bytes: `0x0B8`–`0x0D8`).
properties.canRefresh: Flag permitting recruit and equipment respawn.
properties.myBaseHomeTownData: FCS template record of home settlement (8 bytes: `0x0E0`–`0x0E8`).
properties.priceMultWhenITrade: Custom merchant price markup modifier (4 bytes: `0x0E8`–`0x0EC`).
properties.locatorModel: Debug 3D squad locator model node (8 bytes: `0x0F0`–`0x0F8`).
properties.blackboard: Tactical AI intelligence and threat tracking blackboard (8 bytes: `0x0F8`–`0x100`).
properties._isIntact: Operational status flag indicating active conscious members.
properties.squadTemplate: FCS template record configuring squad composition (8 bytes: `0x108`–`0x110`).
properties.malnourishedLevel: Aggregate hunger and starvation index (4 bytes: `0x110`–`0x114`).
properties.hasNeverBeenActivated: Fresh spawn latch suppressing initialization resets.
properties._persistentSquad: Flag marking squad as permanently retained in savegame.
properties.isResidentSquad: Flag marking squad as permanent municipal resident.
properties.messageOnActivation: Event message payload delivered on 3D streaming (4 bytes: `0x118`–`0x11C`).
properties.currentSpawnArea: Sector partition bounding initial spawn (8 bytes: `0x120`–`0x128`).
properties.squadleader: Entity handle of designated squad leader (32 bytes: `0x128`–`0x148`).
properties.ownerships: Embedded currency, building, and slave ownership ledger (144 bytes: `0x148`–`0x1D8`).
properties.activePlatoon: Pointer to live 3D character container when loaded (8 bytes: `0x1D8`–`0x1E0`).
properties.unloadedPlatoon: Pointer to background simulated container when unloaded (8 bytes: `0x1E0`–`0x1E8`).
properties.patrolSettings: Territorial patrol and waypoint controller (8 bytes: `0x1E8`–`0x1F0`).
properties.imprisoned: Captive slave or prisoner status flag.
properties.index: Order index within faction platoon list (2 bytes: `0x1F2`–`0x1F4`).
properties.traderInventoryRefreshTime: Timestamp for merchant inventory restocking (32 bytes: `0x1F8`–`0x218`).

PortraitManager.description: Master squad portrait renderer and texture atlas manager. Renders 3D character heads into offscreen texture sheets, caching icons and updating combat status animations.

methods.~PortraitManager: Destructs the `PortraitManager` instance and releases managed resources.
methods.updatePortrait: Performs update and simulation step for `PortraitManager`.
methods.updatePortraitImage: Performs update and simulation step for `PortraitManager`.

properties.textureSize: Dimensions of master portrait texture atlas sheet.
properties.textureName: OGRE texture resource name for portrait atlas.
properties.texturePortraitSize: Pixel dimensions of individual character portrait tile.
properties.maxIndex: Maximum portrait capacity on single atlas texture.
properties.texture: Hardware GPU texture holding baked portrait tiles.
properties.images: Array of allocated portrait cell slots on texture sheet.
properties.characterPortraits: Map of cached portrait metadata and UV coords keyed by character handle.
properties.imagesIndices: Bitmask array of occupied atlas tile slots.
properties.disableUpdate: Freeze flag disabling offscreen portrait re-renders during high action.

ProductionBuilding.description: `ProductionBuilding` forms the backbone of Kenshi's manufacturing economy, powering ore refineries, grain mills, cooking stoves, biofuel distillers, and automated mining drills.

methods.ProductionBuilding: Constructs a new `ProductionBuilding` machine instance within the game world, linking spatial placement, owner settlement, and layout context, then invokes `setupFromData()` to configure input consumption grids and output product slots.
methods.~ProductionBuilding: Destructs the `ProductionBuilding` instance, releasing allocated consumption requirement items, clearing the output section pointer, and unregistering from factory lists.
methods.getProductionBuilding: Returns the downcasted polymorphic pointer to this `ProductionBuilding` instance. Overrides `Building::getProductionBuilding()`.
methods.getProductionMult: Calculates the net production rate multiplier factoring in base blueprint output speed, terrain resource fertility rating, and environmental quality.
methods.getProductionMultForGUI: Retrieves the normalized efficiency multiplier formatted for display in the bottom HUD Datapanel inspector window.
methods.getMiningResourceLevel: Queries the environmental ground resource rating under this structure (e.g. iron quality, copper quality, stone purity, or water fertility).
methods.getMouseCursor: Determines the contextual mouse cursor icon displayed when hovering over this machine. Returns `CURSOR_OPERATE_MACHINERY`.
methods.getDefaultTask: Determines the Goal-Oriented Action Planning (GOAP) AI task assigned to characters right-clicking or working jobs at this machine.
methods.getInputValue: Calculates the raw material conversion value provided by a specific input item instance.
methods.getResourcesNeededBecauseEmpty: Gathers input raw materials that are completely exhausted, emitting high-priority hauling jobs for logistics workers.
methods.getResourcesNeededBecauseNotFull: Gathers input raw materials that have available capacity in their respective input inventory sections to maintain continuous operation.
methods.isAnyInputsEmpty: Checks if any required recipe input material is completely absent from the input inventory.
methods.isAnyInputsInvalidType: Validates that items deposited in input sections conform to expected blueprint material types.
methods.isAnyInputsFull: Checks whether any input ingredient inventory section has reached its designated capacity limit.
methods.isProductionFull: Checks whether the output section is completely filled with manufactured products, blocking further machine operation.
methods.isProductionEmpty: Checks whether the finished goods output inventory section currently holds zero items.
methods.canHaveSomeOfThese: Determines whether this machine's input sections can accept the proposed item blueprint during hauling deposits.
methods.getOutputBasedRotationSpeedMult: Computes mechanical gear rotation animation speed scaled to actual operating efficiency and power status.
methods.getItemsWeWantRidOf: Populates a list of finished manufactured items ready to be hauled away to storage bins or distribution stockpiles.
methods.getOutput: Queries the accumulated fractional completion progress toward producing the next unit of finished goods.
methods.getNumConsumtionItems: Returns the number of input ingredient consumption item descriptors defined for this recipe.
methods.getConsumtionItems: Retrieves an input consumption item descriptor by array index.
methods.createInventoryLayout: Constructs a specialized MyGUI inventory layout presenting separate visual containers for raw material inputs and manufactured output products.
methods.update: Main simulation tick. Advances sound loops, verifies active operators, and if configured as an automatic machine, invokes automated production processing.
methods.needsUpdate: Queries whether this machine requires per-frame simulation processing.
methods.operate: Drives production advancement during character operation or automatic machine ticks. Clamps rate by inputs and electrical power, consumes raw ingredients, and outputs finished products.
methods.setupMiningResourceLevel: Samples the underlying terrain biome map at the machine's world coordinates to determine mining resource quality or agricultural fertility.
methods.setProductionItem: Configures or switches the primary output product generated by this machine, updating recipe parameters and output capacity.
methods.setupFromData: Parses the FCS `BUILDING_FUNCTIONALITY` record, allocating dedicated `InventorySection` grids for raw material inputs and output goods.
methods.updateInventoryWindow: Synchronizes active GUI controls with current progress and resource levels if the container window is open.
methods.updateInputs: Consumes raw materials from input inventory sections proportional to manufactured output progress.
methods.updateOutput: Accumulates manufacturing progress and, upon completing a unit (progress $\ge 1.0$), instantiates the new physical item into the output section.
methods.limitInputsOutputRate: Restricts operational rate according to the limiting input raw material or available output capacity.
methods.getGUIData: Renders telemetry data to the HUD Datapanel, displaying operating efficiency, power usage, and ground resource fertility.
methods.getGUIToolTipForGroundResourceEfficiency: Generates localized tooltip text describing ground resource extraction efficiency and quality ratings.
methods.getGUIFertility: Renders ground resource fertility ratings to the Datapanel GUI.
methods.getGUIState: Renders current operational state string (e.g. "Operating", "No Resources", "Output Full", "Out of Power") to the HUD.
methods.serialise: Serializes machine operational state, output progress fractions, input material buffers, and terrain mining levels into savegame delta records.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Restores production progress, active operational state, and input buffers from serialized savegame records.

properties._base: Inherited storage and container base state (`0x468` bytes).
properties._resourceMiningLevel: Underlying terrain resource quality rating sampled from the local resource biome map.
properties.outSection: Output finished goods inventory grid receiving generated products.
properties.consumptionItems: Input raw material requirements list tracking recipe ingredient consumption rates and capacity.

RaceData.description: Racial archetype descriptor defining base skeleton assets, body part vital multipliers, prohibited equipment slots, natural resistances, and learning rates.

properties.isRobot: Synthetic race flag exempting hunger and cut bleeding.
properties.isAnimal: Creature flag using creature skeleton and attacks.
properties.skillMultipliers: Racial learning and proficiency rate bonuses.
properties.forbiddenSlots: Equipment slot names prohibited for this race.
properties.meshName: Base 3D mesh model file asset name.

methods.RagdollAnimation: Constructs a new `RagdollAnimation` instance, associating it with an `AnimationClass`. Initializes timing fields and internal state to zero or default values.
methods.isAnimating: Checks if the ragdoll recovery blend is actively interpolating. Returns the value of the internal `animating` flag.
methods.update: Performs the per-frame tick for the ragdoll-to-animation blend. If it's the first update, bones are set to manually controlled. It interpolates bone orientations and positions using `nlerp`, and restores regular animation control once the blend duration completes.
methods.setTargetAnimation: Configures the blend sequence by evaluating a target `Ogre::Animation` and matching its track data against the ragdoll bones. It computes the start offsets and target orientations for the transition.
methods.getTargetAnimation: Returns the name of the target animation clip that the ragdoll is blending towards. Used to queue the standard animation state machine upon blend completion.
methods.getAnimationTime: Retrieves the currently elapsed time within the ragdoll transition blend. Represents the active progress of the blend transition.
methods.~RagdollAnimation: Destructor for the `RagdollAnimation` object. Releases any dynamically allocated memory, particularly track channels, and cleans up standard string buffers.

properties.targetAnimationName: Target recovery animation clip name (e.g. get up from ground).
properties.animating: Whether ragdoll-to-keyframe blend is actively interpolating.

RangedCombatClass.description: Ballistic weapon controller governing personal crossbows and mounted defensive turrets. Manages predictive target leading (`getAimPos`), friendly-fire raycast clearances (`takeTheShotCheck`), ammunition consumption and reloading cycles (`reloadCheck`), elevation range multipliers (`getGunRange`), and targeting priority arbitration (`scoreTarget`).

methods.RangedCombatClass: Constructs the `RangedCombatClass` controller, binding owner character reference, initializing state machine variables, and creating the bad-target cache.
methods.setup: Configures ranged weapon operation mode, binding stationary turret building or equipping mobile crossbow controller with governing skill enum.
methods.end: Terminates active ranged combat mode, dropping target locks, clearing aiming positions, and resetting combat animation stances to idle.
methods.setState: Transitions the controller into a new `RangedState` (`SHOOTING`, `MOVING`, `RELOADING`, `WAITING`, `THINKING`), resetting phase timers.
methods.getGun: Returns the active `GunClass` projectile weapon controller.
methods.isInRangedCombatMode: Returns whether the controller is actively engaged in ranged combat stance.
methods._getAttackTarget: Returns the persistent handle of the currently engaged opponent.
methods.updateT: Turret frame update tick. Re-assesses target locks, rotates turret barrel towards aim coordinates, evaluates line-of-fire clearance, and triggers projectile firing.
methods.updateMT: Mobile crossbow frame update tick. Handles reload animations, movement constraints, aim stabilization, and projectile release.
methods.animationUpdate: Updates skeletal spine and arm pitch/yaw animation tracks to point weapon muzzle accurately toward target coordinates.
methods.reloadCheck: Verifies ammunition supply in character inventory, consumes bolts/charges, and initializes reload countdown timer based on weapon reload rate.
methods.takeTheShotCheck: Performs ballistic raycast from muzzle to target, detecting whether line of fire is obstructed by static terrain, architecture, or friendly squadmates.
methods.aimAtTarget: Calculates rotational yaw and pitch angles toward target coordinates, slewing turret swivel joint or rotating character root motion.
methods.getAimPos: Calculates predictive aim position leading the moving target based on projectile flight velocity and target movement vector.
methods.isInRange: Tests whether the given position falls within maximum weapon range, incorporating height bonus scaling.
methods.getGunRange: Calculates maximum range taking into account vertical elevation differences between weapon barrel and target.
methods.scoreTargetRange: Calculates normalized proximity score ($0.0$ to $1.0$) between weapon and target, returning zero if closer than `minRange`.
methods.traceHitFurtherThanTarget: Verifies whether raycast intersection occurred beyond target point, indicating target is not obstructed.
methods.chooseNewTarget: Evaluates available perceived targets, ranking hostile entities by proximity, armor coverage, and friendly fire hazards.
methods.setTarget: Sets `currentTarget` handle and coordinates mutual engagement state.
methods.scoreTarget: Computes aggregate tactical priority score for candidate target, balancing range, health fraction, and ally engagement.
methods.resetShotTimer: Resets aim stability timer back to base threshold ($0.4\text{ s}$) following shot discharge.
methods.reAssessTargeting: Resolves valid live target character from primary or secondary candidate handles, falling back to cached target if still active.
methods.printGUIState: Outputs current aim percentage, reload progress, and ammunition readout strings into HUD datapanel widgets.

properties._lastAimAheadAmount: Calculated lead distance offset applied to target coordinates based on linear velocity.
properties.turret: Handle referencing mounted turret building entity when manning stationary defenses (0x20 bytes: `0x008`–`0x028`).
properties.gun: Pointer to active ballistic firearm controller handling muzzle physics, spread, and bolts.
properties.updateNeededMsg: Dirty flag requesting animation re-evaluation on next frame.
properties.takeAShotMsg: Signal to trigger projectile launch on the next motor or animation tick.
properties.combatMode: Master toggle indicating active engagement in ranged combat stance.
properties.currentAimPos: Cartesian coordinates in engine world units representing current aiming focal point.
properties.currentTarget: Persistent entity handle referencing targeted opponent (0x20 bytes: `0x048`–`0x068`).
properties.me: Owning character entity operating the crossbow or turret.
properties.aimTimer: Accumulated aim focus duration in seconds; stabilizes shot accuracy toward 100%.
properties.reloadTimerMax: Total required duration in seconds for current reload cycle, scaled by skill and weapon tier.
properties.reloadTimer: Current elapsed reload progress countdown in seconds.
properties.stateTimer: Elapsed simulation duration in seconds within active `RangedState`.
properties._isReloading: Flag indicating character is currently engaged in reloading animation.
properties.badTargetRememberer: Memory cache of invalid, obstructed, or out-of-range targets preventing query thrashing.

RobotLimbItem.description: A specialized `Gear` subclass that represents equippable robotic limb replacements. It handles tracking specific limb condition (damage, wear) and computing character stat multipliers (e.g. stealth, athletics, strength) based on the tier and type of the limb.

methods.RobotLimbItem: Constructs a new `RobotLimbItem` instance. Initializes damage properties to zero and calculates limb-specific properties based on base data and material.
methods.~RobotLimbItem: Destroys the `RobotLimbItem` instance. Cleans up any resources and calls the base `Gear` destructor.
methods.getStatMult: Retrieves the multiplier for a specific character stat provided by this robotic limb.
methods.getCraftTime: Retrieves the base time required to craft this robot limb item.
methods._serialise: Serializes the robotic limb item's state to a `GameData` instance.
methods._loadFromSerialise: Deserializes and loads the item state from a `GameData` structure.
methods.getTooltipData1: Populates primary tooltip strings displaying item statistics, effects, and multipliers for robotic limbs.
methods.getTooltipData2: Populates secondary tooltip strings, generally appending flavor text and item descriptions.

properties._base: Base class
properties.statMults: Cached map of stat multipliers provided by this limb.
properties.maxHP: Maximum structural hit points of the limb.
properties.wearDamage: Wear and tear degradation over time.
properties.unarmedDamage: Bonus damage applied to unarmed attacks.

RobotLimbs.description: Prosthetic robotics manager coordinating replacement limb sockets, prosthetic item equipment, health states, and inventory UI bindings.

methods.~RobotLimbs: Destructs the `RobotLimbs` instance and releases allocated resources.

properties.me: Character entity possessing these prosthetic limb sockets.
properties.limbs[6]: Array of equipped prosthetic items for Left Arm, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg, etc.
properties.states[6]: Health/dismemberment state enum for each limb socket.
properties.mask: Bitmask of currently attached prosthetic limbs.
properties.inventoryInterface: UI inventory proxy container for prosthetic slots.

RootObject.description: Polymorphic foundation for all physical and interactive world entities ([`Character`](character.md), [`Building`](building.md), [`Item`](item.md)). Encapsulates spatial orientation quaternion, interior building containment ([`hand`](#)), floor slice indexing, town wall containment checks, spatial partitioning hash keys, and delegation hooks for inventory transactions, sensory awareness, and combat reactions.

methods.RootObject: Primary constructor for `RootObject`. Invokes `RootObjectBase` constructor to initialize object handle, template FCS data record (`GameData`), and owner faction. Initializes interior building handle, floor slice level (0), spatial partition key, and identity rotation quaternion.
methods.~RootObject: Virtual destructor unhooking the entity from its parent container (`RootObjectContainer`), releasing interior spatial linkages, clearing spatial hash keys, and destroying base object resources.
methods.needsSaving: Queries whether this entity has modified runtime state requiring persistence into the active savegame file or mod layer.
methods.getInstanceID: Retrieves the persistent instance identifier record (`InstanceID*`) corresponding to this object's world placement.
methods.getLayoutInstanceID: Retrieves the layout instance string identifier used for building interior items and modular architectural furniture.
methods.threadedUpdate: Threaded background simulation update hook. Allows physics, sensory perception, and animation evaluation across worker threads.
methods.update: Standard per-frame logic update tick. RootObject base implementation serves as a polymorphic virtual hook overridden by derived entities (`Character`, `Building`, `Item`).
methods.periodicUpdate: Periodic low-frequency update tick. Invokes `loadUnloadCheck` to evaluate distance to the camera and player platoons for zone streaming management.
methods.getAABB: Retrieves the world-space axis-aligned bounding box (`Ogre::Aabb`) enclosing the entity's physical geometry.
methods.getVisible: Queries whether the entity's visual scene nodes and meshes are currently visible in the rendering pipeline.
methods.isDisabled: Queries whether the object is in a disabled or dormant state, skipping physics and AI simulation.
methods.loadUnloadCheck: Zone streaming evaluation method. Checks distance between the entity and active player platoons or loaded zone boundaries, managing transitions between active reality and serialized disk storage.
methods.getOrientation: Retrieves the rotational orientation quaternion (`rot`) of the entity in 3D world space.
methods.getZoneMapLocation: Resolves the geographical `ZoneMap` grid cell containing this entity by querying its parent container or spatial coordinate.
methods.amInsideTownWalls: Returns the town wall containment status. If `isInsideTownWalls` is negative, queries the containing building structure or settlement territory to determine defensive perimeter status.
methods.setInsideTownWalls: Sets the cached town wall containment state identifier.
methods.getFloor: Retrieves the interior floor level currently occupied by the entity (0 = ground floor, 1 = first floor, etc.).
methods.setFloor: Sets the interior floor level currently occupied by the entity.
methods.isIndoors: Retrieves the handle of the building structure this object currently resides within (`isInsideBuilding`).
methods.isOnARoof: Queries whether the entity is located on an open-air building rooftop rather than an enclosed interior floor.
methods.setIsInsideBuilding: Updates the interior building residence handle (`isInsideBuilding`) and resets the outdoor delay notification timer.
methods.getRace: Retrieves the biological race data record (`RaceData*`) for the entity.
methods.setFaction: Updates entity faction alignment and re-assigns active platoon membership, synchronizing diplomatic relationship status and ownership tables.
methods.say: Spawns a floating speech bubble or dialogue line over the entity in the world view.
methods.notifyIndoors: Notification handler triggered when the entity crosses from the open world into an interior building space.
methods.notifyOutdoors: Notification handler triggered when the entity exits an interior building space back into the outdoor world.
methods.getIntendedAggression: Queries the current intended combat aggression scalar for this entity.
methods.hitByMeleeAttack: Combat melee impact resolution hook invoked when a melee attack strikes this entity. Determines impact audio material, applies damage calculations, and initiates defensive reactions.
methods.getPlatoonAI: Retrieves the tactical platoon AI controller (`PlatoonAI*`) governing squad coordination for this entity.
methods.notifyEffect: Dispatches environmental and weather effect notifications (e.g. acid rain, duststorms, burning sunlight, toxic gas) to the entity.
methods.select: Invoked when this entity becomes selected by the player in the viewport, enabling HUD selection circles and datapanels.
methods.unselect: Invoked when the player deselects this entity, disabling selection highlights and clearing inspection panels.
methods.getGUIData: Populates the specified `DatapanelGUI` sidebar with categorized attributes, stats, condition bars, and description text for this entity.
methods.getGUIDataCategories: Fills an output list with available datapanel tab categories supported by this entity.
methods.setStandingOrder: Applies a persistent standing combat order (e.g. Hold, Passive, Block, Ranged, Medic, Taunt) to the entity.
methods.getOrders: Retrieves the list of active GOAP tasks and permanent job orders assigned to this entity.
methods.getInventory: Resolves and returns the primary `Inventory` component instance attached to this entity.
methods.giveItem: Deposits an item into the entity's inventory. If inventory space is exhausted, drops the item onto the ground if `dropOnFail` is true, or deletes it if `destroyOnFail` is true.
methods.hasRoomForItem: Checks whether the entity's inventory has sufficient vacant grid slots to accommodate an item instantiated from the specified FCS template record.
methods.hasItem: Checks whether the entity currently possesses an item matching the specified FCS template record in its inventory or equipped slots.
methods.createInventoryLayout: Factory method constructing the specialized `InventoryLayout` widget definition used to render this entity's inventory window.
methods.ImStealingDoYouNotice: Evaluates sensory awareness to determine if this entity notices a pickpocketing theft attempt in progress.
methods.stolenGoodsDetectionCheck: Performs a recognition check to determine if this entity identifies a stolen item being sold or transferred.
methods.equipItem: Equips an item into the named equipment slot on the entity.
methods.unequipItem: Unequips an item from the specified equipment slot, moving it back to the main inventory grid.
methods.dropItem: Drops an item from the entity's inventory into the world at its current spatial position.
methods.takeMoney: Deducts a specified amount of currency (Cats) from the entity's funds or faction treasury.
methods.getMoney: Retrieves the amount of currency (Cats) held by this entity or its faction treasury.

properties._base_state: Inherited position vector, persistent handle, faction, and display name fields (`0x010`–`0x078`).
properties.container: Pointer to owning spatial or gameplay container (`0x078`–`0x080`).
properties.isInsideBuilding: Entity handle of building structure object currently resides within (`0x080`–`0x0A0`).
properties.isInsideTownWalls: Cached town wall defensive perimeter flag (-1 = outside, zone ID if inside).
properties.floorNum: Zero-indexed interior floor level currently occupied (0 = ground floor).
properties.spacialKey: Spatial hashing partition key used for fast proximity and physics grid lookups.
properties.outdoorDelayNotification_timer: Cooldown tick counter preventing rapid jitter when crossing doorway thresholds.
properties.rot: Rotational orientation quaternion in 3D world space (w, x, y, z) (`0x0B0`–`0x0C0`).

SaveFileSystem.description: Low-level filesystem staging engine managing directory layouts, zip archive streaming, atomic file replacement, and slot enumeration.

methods.~SaveFileSystem: Destructs the `SaveFileSystem` instance and releases allocated resources.

properties.rootSaveDirectory: Base directory path containing all savegame slots.
properties.tempStagingDirectory: Scratch directory for atomic double-buffered saves.
properties.discoveredSaveSlots: List of valid save folder names detected on disk.
properties.ioWorkerActive: Background IO thread running state flag.
properties.ioThreadHandle: Thread handle for background file compression and streaming.
properties.fileCrcTable: Checksum validation table for saved chunks.
properties.lastStagedFile: Path of the most recently written disk asset.
properties.totalBytesWritten: Cumulative byte count transferred during active save.
properties.totalBytesExpected: Target byte count expected for active serialization.

SaveManager.description: Master game state serialization, session persistence, and savegame management singleton in Kenshi. Manages save directories (`localSavePath`, `userSavePath`), active save slot metadata (`currentGame`), save/load/import modal dialog windows (`loadMenu`, `saveMenu`, `importMenu`), automated background save intervals (`autoSaveTimer`), version validation (`checkVersion`, `versionCode`), low-level world state serialization (`saveGame`, `loadGame`), and cross-version asset import filters (`importGame`, `importPlayerBuildings`).

methods.getSingleton: Retrieves the global singleton instance of `SaveManager`. Lazily allocates the instance (size `0x120` / 288 bytes) on first invocation via Ogre general allocator if uninitialized.
methods.SaveManager: Private constructor for `SaveManager`. Initializes string buffers for save paths and current session, resets state signaling flags (`signal = 0`, `delay = 0`), zeroes the autosave countdown timer (`autoSaveTimer`), and unbinds GUI menu dialog pointers.
methods.~SaveManager: Private destructor for `SaveManager`. Closes and destroys active GUI modal dialog windows (`loadMenu`, `saveMenu`, `importMenu`), flushes path buffers, and deallocates base Ogre memory.
methods.getCurrentGame: Returns the name or folder identifier of the currently loaded active game session (`currentGame`).
methods.getSavePath: Returns the active filesystem directory path currently configured for saving and loading games.
methods.initialisePaths: Discovers and initializes filesystem directories for local game installation saves (`localSavePath`) and user AppData profile saves (`userSavePath`), establishing directory permissions and fallback paths.
methods.isVisible: Queries whether any save, load, or import modal GUI window is currently open and visible on screen.
methods.showSave: Constructs (if necessary) and displays the modal Save Game GUI dialog window (`saveMenu`), populating current slot suggestions and screenshot previews.
methods.showLoad: Constructs and displays the modal Load Game GUI dialog window (`loadMenu`), scanning available saves and rendering save slot cards.
methods.showImport: Constructs and displays the modal Import Game GUI dialog window (`importMenu`), allowing player selection of import flags and source save files.
methods.hide: Closes and hides all active save, load, and import modal GUI windows, returning focus to the primary game viewport.
methods.newGame: Signals the engine to begin a new game session using scenario identifier `startId`. Sets pending signal `NEWGAME` and arms execution delay timer.
methods.save: Enqueues a game save operation targeting slot name `s`. If `autosave` is true, applies rotating autosave slot indexing. Sets pending signal `SAVEGAME`.
methods.load: Enqueues a game load operation from descriptor `s`, with an option to reset all squad member positions to camera focus point. Sets pending signal `LOADGAME`.
methods.import: Enqueues a game import operation from save slot `s` using configuration bitmask `_flags` (`IMPORT_BUILDINGS`, `IMPORT_RESEARCH`, `IMPORT_NPC_STATES`, etc.). Sets pending signal `IMPORTGAME`.
methods.execute: Master frame execution dispatcher. Decrements delay countdown timer, coordinates fade-to-black screen transitions, and executes queued operational signals (`SAVEGAME`, `LOADGAME`, `IMPORTGAME`, `NEWGAME`) by calling `saveGame`, `loadGame`, or `importGame`.
methods.savesExist: Fast query checking whether any saved game directories exist in the local or user save directories.
methods.saveExists: Checks if a specific savegame slot `name` exists within filesystem path `location`.
methods.scanGames: Scans the default active save directory, populating `list` with `SaveInfo` descriptors for all discovered save slots.
methods.loadInfo: Reads and parses save header files (`info.dat` / `quick.save`) into `SaveInfo& info`, extracting game time, squad size, money, and mod dependencies.
methods.checkVersion: Validates version compatibility of savegame `info` against current engine version, detecting whether migration or warnings are required.
methods.versionCode: Parses a semantic version string (e.g. "1.0.65") into a packed 32-bit integer version code suitable for numerical comparison.
methods.updateAutoSave: Per-frame tick updating the autosave timer. When the elapsed interval exceeds user configured settings (and autosave is unpaused), automatically triggers a rotating autosave.
methods.saveGame: Low-level core save implementation. Serializes active world data, zone states, platoons, player buildings, research, faction relations, and camera transforms to `location/name`.
methods.loadGame: Low-level core load implementation. Clears existing world state, resets zones and platoons, deserializes game objects, and instantiates character entities from `location/name`.
methods.importGame: Low-level core import implementation. Re-initializes a fresh base game world and merges player squads, buildings, research, relations, and NPC death states from source save `location/name` according to filter `flags`.
methods.importPlayerBuildings: Imports player-owned buildings, outposts, and interior furniture placements from modern serialized building records (`path/file`).
methods.importOldPlayerBuildings: Legacy import routine migrating player-constructed buildings and outposts from older Kenshi save formats into current structure definitions.

properties.currentGame: Directory or slot identifier of currently active game session (`0x000`–`0x028`).
properties.saveVersion: Version string token recorded in save file headers (`0x028`–`0x050`).
properties.localSavePath: Base directory path for local saves within application install (`0x050`–`0x078`).
properties.userSavePath: User profile appdata savegame directory path (`0x078`–`0x0A0`).
properties.delay: Frame delay countdown before scheduled save/load operation executes (`0x0A8`–`0x0AC`).
properties.name: Target save slot filename or new game scenario name (`0x0B0`–`0x0D8`).
properties.location: Directory path containing target savegame slot (`0x0D8`–`0x100`).
properties.loadMenu: Modal GUI dialog for browsing and loading saved games (`0x100`–`0x108`).
properties.saveMenu: Modal GUI dialog for naming and saving current game state (`0x108`–`0x110`).
properties.importMenu: Modal GUI dialog for configuring import options and starting game imports (`0x110`–`0x118`).
properties.autoSaveTimer: Elapsed time counter tracking autosave trigger intervals (`0x118`–`0x11C`).
properties.pauseAutoSaveTimer: Flag suppressing autosave timer countdown during menus or dialogue (`0x11C`).

ShopTrader.description: Merchant trade interface proxy adapter mediating retail transactions between customer characters and vendor NPCs. Wraps a vendor [`Character`](character.md) instance with an isolated [`ShopTraderInventory`](inventory.md) containing shop stock, synchronizing currency exchanges, vendor list restocking schedules, barter price markups, and delegating spatial queries to the shopkeeper.

methods.ShopTrader: Constructs a `ShopTrader` merchant proxy for the specified character, instantiating an isolated `ShopTraderInventory`, configuring vendor sections, and loading merchandise items from FCS vendor lists.
methods.~ShopTrader: Destructs the `ShopTrader` proxy, deleting the retail inventory and invoking base `RootObject` cleanup.
methods.getTrader: Retrieves the underlying vendor `Character` entity associated with this shop.
methods.getInventory: Returns the dedicated retail merchandise inventory exposed to customers during barter interactions.
methods.takeMoney: Deducts currency from the vendor character's faction or personal funds during purchases.
methods.getMoney: Queries current money balance available for purchasing goods from the player.
methods.updateInventory: Triggers periodic inventory restock evaluation on the retail inventory according to vendor list timers.
methods.getPosition: Delegates spatial position query to the vendor character entity.
methods.getOrientation: Delegates spatial orientation inquiry to the vendor character entity.
methods.isIndoors: Queries whether the vendor character is currently located inside a building.
methods.getFloor: Queries current building floor level of the vendor character.
methods.getCurrentTownLocation: Retrieves the settlement or outpost where this merchant operates.
methods.getDataType: Returns the polymorphic data type classification (`SHOP_TRADER_CLASS` = 0x5D).
methods.getGUIData: Populates the barter interface data panel with shopkeeper title, faction affiliation, trade price markup factors, and Cat balances.
methods.equipItem: Equipment interface hook; retail shops do not equip merchandise items, so this is a no-op.
methods.unequipItem: Unequip interface hook; retail shops do not equip merchandise items, so this is a no-op.
methods.isPhysical: Reports physical simulation status; proxies have no 3D PhysX rigid bodies and return `false`.
methods.setVisible: Visibility toggle stub; proxies possess no independent mesh and ignore visibility commands.
methods.createPhysical: Physical instantiation stub; returns `false` as proxies are purely logical interfaces.
methods.destroyPhysical: Physical teardown stub; no-op as proxies manage no physics bodies.
methods.serialise: Serialization hook; returns an empty `GameSaveState` as merchant inventory restock is dynamically managed via the vendor character.
methods.loadFromSerialise: Deserialization hook; no-op as proxy state is regenerated from vendor lists.

properties._vftable: Virtual method dispatch table pointer inherited from `RootObject`.
properties.handle: Unique serialized game entity handle assigned to this trader proxy.
properties.data: Base FCS template blueprint of the merchant shopkeeper.
properties.trader: Pointer to the concrete vendor character entity managing this shop.
properties.inventory: Dedicated retail merchandise inventory populated from vendor restocking lists.

StorageBuilding.description: Item and resource storage container managing automatic inventory sorting, hauling jobs, and material supply limits. `StorageBuilding` serves as the foundational container for resource chests, item bins, shop counters, and cross-settlement distribution stockpiles.

methods.StorageBuilding: Constructs a new `StorageBuilding` container entity in the game world, initializing storage filters, registering item type templates for weapons and armour, and establishing inventory capacity limits.
methods.~StorageBuilding: Destructs the `StorageBuilding` container, cleaning up allocated `manyLimitItems` consumption tracking records and releasing base `UseableStuff` resources.
methods.getFunctionStuff: Returns the downcasted polymorphic pointer to this storage functional component. Overrides `Building::getFunctionStuff()`.
methods.getUseableStuff: Returns the downcasted polymorphic pointer to the `UseableStuff` base component. Overrides `Building::getUseableStuff()`.
methods.getDefaultTask: Determines the default Goal-Oriented Action Planning (GOAP) AI task assigned to characters interacting with this container. Always returns `LOOT_TARGET` to trigger item withdrawal or hauling storage.
methods.getItemsWeWantRidOf: Populates a list of item blueprint templates currently occupying this storage container that should be evacuated or hauled elsewhere. Excludes shop counters and terminal (`endOfTheLine`) containers unless forced by player looting commands.
methods.getProductionItemData: Resolves the primary item template associated with this storage container. Returns the specific `productionItem` record if configured, or looks up the default template for categorized containers (e.g. general weapon or armour storage).
methods.getProductionItem: Returns the primary `ConsumptionItem` tracking descriptor governing production and capacity constraints.
methods.getCurrentProductionQuantity: Queries the number of items currently resting in this container's dedicated production inventory section.
methods.canHaveSomeOfThese: Evaluates whether this container can accept the specified item. Validates structure construction completion, inventory section grid space, designated item category filters, and active capacity limits.
methods.getResourcesNeededBecauseEmpty: Identifies items urgently required by this container because its inventory section is currently empty or below required capacity. Emits hauling requests for logistics workers.
methods.getResourcesNeededBecauseNotFull: Identifies items that this container can still accept because it has not yet reached its maximum capacity. Used by AI hauling tasks to keep general supply bins topped off.
methods.isAnyInputsEmpty: Evaluates whether any tracked input or production item slots currently contain zero items or retain room for incoming resources.
methods.isAnyInputsFull: Queries whether any tracked item category in this container has reached its maximum defined capacity limit.
methods.isProductionFull: Queries whether output production is stalled due to container saturation. Always returns `false` for dedicated storage containers since they do not produce output commodities.
methods.isProductionEmpty: Queries whether this container's inventory currently holds zero physical items.
methods.getNumConsumtionItems: Returns the total count of distinct item consumption or capacity descriptors configured for this container.
methods.getConsumtionItems: Retrieves a specific `ConsumptionItem` descriptor by index. Index 0 returns the primary `productionItem`, while higher indices access entries in `manyLimitItems`.
methods.getConsumtionItems_inStock: Filters all configured consumption item descriptors, appending only those that currently have physical items stocked in their designated inventory section.
methods.update: Executes regular simulation update tick for this storage structure. Advances base building state and updates inventory UI capacity displays if currently open.
methods.limitedByType: Queries whether this container enforces item category filtering restrictions (e.g. accepting only weapons, armour, or food rather than general items).
methods.updateInventoryWindow: Synchronizes the player's MyGUI container window with current stock levels, updating capacity text readouts and visual full indicators.

properties._base: Inherited interactive furniture and building state (`0x440` bytes).
properties.specialItemTypesOnly: Filter mask restricting acceptable stored items (e.g. `ITEM`, `WEAPON`, `ARMOUR`).
properties.endOfTheLine: Terminal storage flag preventing automated worker retrieval during hauling passes.
properties.productionItem: Primary storage target descriptor tracking accepted item template, capacity, and section.
properties.manyLimitItems: Multi-item capacity limit configurations for containers accepting multiple designated items.

Sword.description: The `Sword` class represents all melee weapons in the game, inheriting from the base `Weapon` class. It manages weapon-specific stats such as cut and blunt damage, skill modifiers, and handles tooltip generation for weapon inspection.

methods.Sword: Constructs a new `Sword` instance. Initializes the base `Weapon` class, sets up the vtable, and calls `setupStats` to calculate the final weapon damage and modifiers based on its grade and manufacturer.
methods.~Sword: Destroys the `Sword` instance. Calls the base `Weapon` destructor and frees any allocated resources.
methods.setupStats: Calculates the final damage and statistical modifiers for the weapon. It aggregates multipliers from the base item definition, the manufacturer data, and the material data, scaling them according to the weapon's grade level.
methods.getClassType: Runtime type identification method returning the specific `itemType` enum for this class.
methods.isSword: Runtime type identification method returning the `this` pointer cast to a `Sword` pointer.
methods.getTooltipData1: Appends the primary functional stats of the weapon to the UI tooltip. This includes the weapon class, cutting and blunt damage values, armour penetration, and combat bonuses.
methods.getTooltipData2: Appends the secondary lore and flavor text to the UI tooltip. This includes the item description, the manufacturer name, and potentially the specific smith who crafted it.
methods.getSkillModIndoors: Retrieves the indoor combat penalty or bonus for this specific weapon. Long weapons typically return a negative modifier here.

methods.TaskPathfinder: Constructs a new `TaskPathfinder` instance tied to a specific AI controller. Initializes all internal priority queues, lists, and node memory pools to their default empty states.
methods.~TaskPathfinder: Destructs the pathfinder. Cleans up any remaining search graph nodes inside `allNodes` and releases memory allocated during searches.
methods.meIsPlayer: Helper utility to determine if the AI agent currently executing the goal search belongs to the player's faction or is directly controlled by the player.
methods.solve: Performs an A* heuristic search backwards from a desired task to the current world state to generate a viable sequence of action nodes. Prunes dead ends, duplicates, and invalid states while maintaining priority bounds.
methods.getLowestScore: Iterates through a list of search nodes to locate and return the node with the absolute lowest heuristic cost score. Used to find the cheapest path frontier.
methods.getDuplicateCount: Counts the number of equivalent states currently existing in the pathfinder's tracked memory pools to prevent cyclic infinite loops.
methods.createDeadEndNode: Generates an explicit failure boundary node to cap a search branch, signifying that no further resolution can proceed along the given path.
methods.createNode: Allocates and initializes a new search node into the pathfinder's memory pool, populated with the specific task state, target entity, and physical location requirements.
methods.isAllowedDuplicates: Checks if a specific task type is explicitly permitted to exist multiple times within a single generated plan sequence (e.g. chaining multiple movement steps).
methods.successCheck: Evaluates a frontier node to verify if all required conditions of its state are satisfied by the current physical world state, marking the termination of a successful path search.
methods.clearSatisfiedSuccessors: Traverses backwards from a completed search branch to prune or optimize parent states whose dependency requirements are strictly satisfied by the sequence.
methods.getNextBranch: Queries the prerequisites and sub-goals of a search node to generate its child nodes, expanding the search tree backwards towards the initial world state.
methods.takeBestNode: Extracts and removes the search node with the optimal heuristic score from a given list (usually the open queue) for processing.
methods.nodeIsInList: Performs a linear scan to check if a specific node state exists within an evaluated set, primarily used for loop detection and closed set evaluation.
methods.duplicateNodeWasCompleted: Validates if an alternate equivalent sequence branching off a duplicate node state completed a successful search, providing plan fallback recovery.
methods.removeFromList: Removes a specific search node pointer from the given tracked node container queue.
methods.addToOpen: Inserts a generated search node into the priority-sorted 'open' set, staging it for future A* heuristic evaluation.
methods.addToClosed: Archives an evaluated search node into the 'closed' set, indicating its state has been fully resolved and expanded to prevent repetitive cyclical graph traversals.
methods.cleanup: Resets the entire pathfinder state by emptying the open set, closed set, duplicates list, and deallocating all nodes in the internal memory pool. Prepares the instance for a completely fresh search run.

properties.debugHandle: Monitored entity handle for AI debugging overlay.
properties.isRunningAPlayerOrder: Flag indicating active search graph originates from direct player order.
properties.duplicates: Branch nodes pruned due to state duplication.
properties.allNodes: Memory pool tracking all allocated search nodes.
properties.open: Priority queue of frontier search nodes pending expansion.
properties.closed: Closed set of evaluated and expanded search graph nodes.

methods.TaskRepertoire: Constructs a new `TaskRepertoire` instance. Initializes the GOAP task manager base and sets up the internal containers.
methods.~TaskRepertoire: Destructs the `TaskRepertoire` instance. Cleans up internal containers and releases managed resources.
methods.getTaskData: Retrieves the task data associated with a specific task type. Queries the global task data map to fetch the configured data for the specified task type.
methods.hasTask: Checks whether the specified task type is present within this repertoire's available tasks. Iterates over the `myTasks` set to determine if the task is supported.
methods.getTasksWithResult: Fetches all tasks capable of producing or negating a specific target state. Checks the expected boolean value of the state data to search either `positiveResults` or `negativeResults` containers.
methods.initialiseOnceEverythingIsAdded: Finalizes the initialization of the repertoire by evaluating all added task types. Populates the `positiveResults` and `negativeResults` maps based on the results declared by each available task.
methods.createNewTask: Instantiates a new GOAP task using raw properties. This allows creating contextual or spatial tasks dynamically based on given parameters like location, time windows, and base priorities.
methods.setupGOAP: Bootstraps the GOAP systems associated with this specific task repertoire. Handles the preparation of goal heuristics and base solver configurations needed to plan using these tasks.
methods.isPermaJob: Determines if a specified task type operates as a permanent job. Permanent jobs are persistently rescheduled or kept active during character life cycles, typical for continuous automated labor.

properties._base: Inherited base class state.
properties.name: Repertoire identifier name.
properties.myTasks: Set of supported task types available in this repertoire.
properties.positiveResults: Mapping of states achieved to tasks that produce them.
properties.negativeResults: Mapping of states negated to tasks that cancel them.

methods.Tasker: Constructs a new Tasker instance. Initializes handles to null and properties to defaults.
methods.~Tasker: Destroys the Tasker instance. Cleans up handles and unregisters from any tracking systems.
methods.checkTimeOfDay: Checks if the current world time falls within the task's valid execution window. Uses `startTime` and `endTime`.
methods.getFrameTime: Calculates the active frame delta time applicable for this task. May scale based on task settings or character states.
methods.key: Retrieves a unique key or hash representing this task. Useful for identifying identical task configurations.
methods.unSkippableJob: Determines if the current task cannot be interrupted or skipped. Often used for critical animations or states.
methods.getLocation: Retrieves the 3D world location associated with the task. This is the destination for spatial tasks.
methods.setLocation: Updates the target location for the task. Used to dynamically adjust destinations.
methods.sameAs: Checks if this task is functionally identical to another. Compares task data, subject, and targets.
methods.getDescription: Generates a human-readable description of the current task. Typically used for debugging or UI tooltips.
methods.score: Calculates the utility score for this task. Higher scores increase the probability of selection by the AI system.
methods.isResultsComplete: Evaluates whether the intended outcomes of the task have been fully achieved. Signals the task is complete.
methods.isResultsComplete_ignoreSubtasker: Checks if the primary results of the task are complete without validating sub-task constraints.
methods.isRequirementsComplete: Determines if all preconditions necessary to execute this task are currently met.
methods.getRequirementComplaint: Retrieves a string explaining why the requirements for this task are not met. Used for debugging or UI feedback.
methods.hasActionFunc: Checks if this task has a bound action function to execute.
methods.isSubTasker: Checks if this task acts as a manager for multiple sub-tasks.
methods.getNextSubTarget: Retrieves the next target entity for a sub-task operation.
methods.getSubTask: Retrieves the currently active child task if this is a sub-tasker.
methods.isSubTaskerTargetFinishedWith: Checks if a specific target entity has been fully processed by the sub-tasker.
methods.isInfiniteGoal: Determines if the task is meant to loop indefinitely (e.g., patrolling, idle).
methods.needsSubjectOrLocation: Checks if this task requires either a target entity or a target location to be valid.
methods.getTaskData: Retrieves the blueprint data associated with this task configuration.
methods.startAction: Initiates the execution of the task's primary action for the given character.
methods.endAction: Terminates the execution of the task's action and performs cleanup.
methods.taskSaysItsFinished: Checks if the task itself evaluates that it has completed its objectives for the character.
methods.findTarget: Searches the environment for a valid entity target that satisfies the task requirements.
methods._targetsRemaining: Internal helper that counts the number of valid targets left to process for the task.
methods.isSubTaskerComplete: Checks if all delegated sub-tasks managed by this sub-tasker are finished.

properties.resetsWhenDone: Whether task loops indefinitely when conditions satisfied.
properties.subject: Primary target entity/object handle.

TortureBuilding.description: Execution and peeler apparatus inflicting periodic physical damage to locked occupants and generating anatomical animal skin/leather byproduct.

methods.~TortureBuilding: Destructs the `TortureBuilding` instance and releases allocated resources.
methods.TortureBuilding: Constructs a new `TortureBuilding` instance from game data and spatial transform parameters.
methods.update: Performs update and simulation tick for `TortureBuilding`.

properties._base: Inherited interactive furniture and production state.
properties.timer: Execution duration and damage interval timer.

Town.description: Specialized municipal settlement controller governing electrical power grids, generator output, battery storage reserves, defensive perimeter gates, public commerce policies, commodity trade price modifiers, and outpost progression tiers. Derived from [`TownBase`](townbase.md), `Town` interacts directly with [`GameData`](gamedata.md) for FCS settlement and resident records, [`UseableStuff`](useablestuff.md) for electrical machinery and generators, [`GatewayBuilding`](gatewaybuilding.md) for perimeter access gates, [`AlarmManager`](alarmmanager.md) for emergency alert states, [`DatapanelGUI`](datapanelgui.md) for inspector telemetry, and [`Faction`](faction.md) for municipal diplomatic relationships.

methods.Town: Primary constructor for `Town`, initializing base settlement state, gateway set, power generator and consumer arrays, battery storage, and economic trade multiplier tables.

methods.notifyUnloading: Notifies the town that its containing zone chunk is being unloaded from memory, serializing ephemeral state and suspending resident AI tasks.
methods._initialiseResidentData: Internal protected helper parsing resident definitions from specified FCS record, validating squad availability and building designation requirements.
methods.getGameData: Retrieves the active FCS template data record defining this town, returning the replacement override record if a world state swap has occurred.
methods.getOriginalGameData: Retrieves the base immutable FCS template data record originally assigned to this town prior to any dynamic world state overrides.
methods.isMyOldHomeTownStillValid: Checks whether a character or squad's original home town record remains valid and compatible under current faction diplomatic conditions.
methods.getDataType: Returns the FCS item type identifier corresponding to municipal town structures (`itemType::TOWN`).
methods.reassessTownPosition: Recalculates the center-of-mass spatial origin of the town based on the geometric median coordinates of all constituent buildings.
methods.showDistantTown: Controls visibility of the low-detail distant billboard mesh used to render town silhouettes from long distances.
methods.getAlarmMgr: Retrieves a pointer to the town's `AlarmManager` controlling sirens, alert levels, guard response calls, and crime notifications.
methods.isOutpost: Determines if the settlement is classified as an outpost (player-built base or minor unwalled settlement) rather than an established major city.
methods.setHandle: Sets the persistent runtime entity handle assigned to this town object.
methods.getBuildingMaterial: Retrieves the primary building construction material FCS record utilized by this settlement's cultural architecture.
methods.isTown: Polymorphic RTTI downcast query checking whether this settlement instance is a fully realized `Town`.
methods.isNest: Polymorphic RTTI downcast query checking whether this settlement instance is a creature or bandit `Nest`.
methods.isPublic: Queries whether the settlement is open to the public, allowing foreign factions and neutral travelers unrestricted entry through gates.
methods.setPosition: Explicitly sets the central Cartesian world coordinates of the town.
methods.getRadius: Computes the effective territorial influence radius of the town, factoring base size, building density, and territorial range multipliers.
methods.isActive: Evaluates whether the town is currently active in the physics simulation and receiving regular tick updates.
methods.deActivationCheck: Checks camera distance, player character presence, and active squads to determine if the town should transition into an inactive or suspended state.
methods.isPlayerBuildingsInThisTown: Queries whether the player faction currently owns or occupies any buildings within this town's jurisdiction.
methods.setPlayerBuildingsInThisTown: Marks the town as containing player-owned buildings, updating faction tax assessments, trade tariffs, and diplomatic interaction routines.
methods.getMapMarker: Returns the visual map marker icon asset name displayed on the world map for this settlement.
methods.getMapMarkerZoomLevel: Returns the minimum map camera zoom level threshold at which this settlement's icon becomes visible on the navigation map.
methods.recalculatePlayerTownLevel: Evaluates player-owned building counts, defensive gate structures, power grid installations, and population to determine outpost progression tier (0 to 4).
methods.getPlayerTownTypeEnum: Determines the appropriate settlement type classification enum based on calculated player town level and installed municipal facilities.
methods.facilitesWeHaveHere: Aggregates bitmask tags representing all functional facility types present in this settlement (e.g., weapon shop, armor shop, bakery, bar, police station).
methods._setMainResident: Designates the primary resident squad or faction detachment occupying a specific building, establishing ownership and guard assignments.
methods.chooseResidents: Distributes resident squad templates, merchants, and patrol groups across all available matching municipal buildings in the settlement.
methods.spawnTheBarFlies: Spawns ambient bar patrons, wandering mercenaries, drunks, gambling NPCs, and recruitable drifters inside designated public tavern buildings.
methods.chooseBuildingForResident: Selects the most suitable building from a candidate collection matching the architectural and functional requirements of a resident descriptor.
methods.hasResidentHQ: Queries whether the specified faction maintains an active headquarters, diplomatic embassy, or military command post within this settlement.
methods.addGate: Registers a defensive gateway structure entity handle into the town's perimeter gate management collection.

methods.updatePowerGrid: Executes core electrical grid simulation tick: iterates generator outputs, sums total consumer demand, routes power quotas, and charges or discharges connected battery arrays.
methods.addBuilding: Enrolls a building into the settlement electrical power distribution network, configuring its roles as power generator, electrical consumer, or battery reservoir.
methods.removeBuilding: Deregisters a demolished, disabled, or removed building entity from the electrical generator, consumer, and battery collections.

methods.drainBattery: Draws electrical wattage from battery storage units to cover generation deficits for an unpowered consumer building.
methods.getLocalTradePriceMult: Calculates local commodity price multiplier for a specified item record, combining base item value, local market adjustments, and cultural trade modifiers.
methods.getFactionTradeCultureMult: Evaluates faction trade culture policies (e.g., illegal contraband bans, high-demand religious goods) to determine cultural pricing markup or discount.
methods.addNest: Registers a creature or bandit nest site anchor within the settlement boundaries, linking it to an optional enclosing building structure.
methods.removeNest: Removes a creature or bandit nest anchor associated with the specified building entity.

methods.saveState: Serializes runtime town state into savegame data record, writing power grid parameters, battery charge status, gate lock states, and resident squad IDs.

methods.loadStateEditor: Loads town configuration from FCS record within level editor mode.

TownBuildingsManager.description: Municipal architectural graphics manager governing building mesh rendering, multi-floor visual slice visibility, commercial signboard fixtures, and OGRE GPU hardware mesh instancing. Coordinates directly with [`TownBase`](townbase.md) and [`Town`](town.md) for settlement ownership, [`Building`](building.md) for architectural hierarchy, and [`DatapanelGUI`](datapanelgui.md) for camera floor-slicing controls.

TurretBuilding.description: Mounted defensive weapon station encapsulating [`GunClassTurret`](gunclassturret.md). Governs operator gunnery tracking, horizontal and vertical articulated physics rotation joints, defensive wall elevation advantages, power consumption for electrified harpoons, and ammunition feed cycles. Derived from [`UseableStuff`](useablestuff.md), `TurretBuilding` interacts directly with [`Character`](character.md) for gunnery AI tasks, [`Building`](building.md) and [`WallBuilding`](wallbuilding.md) for parent rampart mounting, and [`TownBuildingsManager`](townbuildingsmanager.md) for settlement defensive spatial registration.
