UseableStuff.description: Interactive furniture, production machinery, medical recovery beds, prisoner cages, training dummies, and shop trade counters. Extends the base [`Building`](building.md) class with operator assignment slots, electrical power grid consumption and battery storage, door locks, training XP acceleration, and interactive MyGUI layouts.

methods.UseableStuff: Constructs a new `UseableStuff` interactive furniture or machine instance within the game world, linking spatial placement, owner settlement, and layout context.
methods.~UseableStuff: Destructs the `UseableStuff` instance, unregistering from the town power grid, releasing operator slots, and deleting allocated inventory and door lock subsystems.
methods.setup: Parses the FCS template definition (`data`) to initialize inventory grids, door locks, operational capacities, hunger scaling, and electrical ratings.
methods.setupFromData: Applies dynamic mod overlays and live FCS record updates to internal properties without reconstructing the object instance.
methods.operate: Simulates a single frame of character operation. For training dummies and machines, awards skill experience and updates progress visualizers.
methods.tryOperate: Attempts to reserve an active operator slot for the specified character, evaluating current worker limits and availability.
methods.couldIOperate: Queries whether a character can potentially operate this station without mutating operator assignment sets.
methods.stopOperating: Vacates an operator assignment slot previously occupied by the specified character.
methods.isFreeSlot: Checks whether there is an unoccupied operator slot available for character assignment.
methods.dontNeedWorkRightNow: Evaluates whether the station is currently in a state where operating tasks should be suspended (e.g. broken, unpowered, or full).
methods.getOccupant: Retrieves the primary character entity resting or imprisoned inside this furniture (e.g. in a hospital bed or cage).
methods.occupantHandleChangedEvent: Handles occupant handle reassignment events (e.g. when an occupant is kidnapped, dies, or is transferred).
methods.getCostToUse: Calculates the rental fee in Cats required for a character to rest in this bed or utilize this facility.
methods.getStatUsed: Returns the specific skill or attribute trained or utilized by this station.
methods.getReachRange: Returns the physical proximity radius required for a character to begin interaction.
methods.getDefaultTask: Determines the default AI job or right-click player command type dispatched upon interacting with this furniture.
methods.getMouseCursor: Selects the active mouse cursor icon displayed when hovering over this interactive station.
methods.switchPowerOn: Toggles the station's operational power switch, registering or unregistering it from the municipal electrical distribution network.
methods.isPowerOn: Queries whether the station's electrical circuit breaker switch is currently turned on.
methods.hasPower: Checks whether the station is currently supplied with sufficient electrical wattage to function.
methods.needPowerRightNow: Queries whether this station is actively demanding electricity from the power grid in the current frame.
methods.isOutOfPower: Returns a normalized penalty factor ($0.0$ to $1.0$) indicating the severity of electrical power deficit.
methods.howMuchPowerDoYouWantMax: Calculates the theoretical peak power demand factoring research upgrades and maximum battery charging limits.
methods.howMuchPowerDoYouWantNow: Calculates the instantaneous unsatisfied electrical deficit required to meet demand this simulation frame.
methods.howMuchPowerDoYouWantForSortingFunction: Priority sorting key used by the settlement grid solver to distribute limited electricity to critical infrastructure first.
methods.givePower: Injects electrical power into the machine or battery from the settlement power distribution grid.
methods.takePowerFrom: Discharges electrical energy from this generator or battery to satisfy external settlement network demand.
methods.resetPower: Clears instantaneous power buffers at the beginning of each electrical distribution cycle.
methods.getMaxPower: Returns the maximum potential electrical wattage output for generators.
methods.getPowerOutput: Calculates current active power output factoring fuel availability, weather wind speeds, and mechanical health.
methods.getFuelConsumptionRate: Returns the rate at which biofuel or generator fuel items are consumed per second.
methods.isBattery: Determines whether this object operates as an electrical battery energy accumulator.
methods.isGenerator: Determines whether this object functions as an electrical power generator.
methods.getBatteryCharge: Retrieves current accumulated electrical energy stored within the battery bank.
methods.getBatteryChargeMax: Calculates maximum battery storage capacity factoring construction health and player technology research multipliers.
methods.isRecievesBatteryPower: Queries whether battery power consumption is currently permitted by user configuration.
methods.togglePowerButton: GUI callback toggling master power switch and triggering physical generator audio cues.
methods.toggleBattButton: GUI callback toggling battery power permission switch and emitting click sound.
methods.calculateEfficiencyMult: Calculates overall machine operating efficiency multiplier based on electrical satisfaction and structural condition.
methods.getOutputBasedRotationSpeedMult: Calculates rotation animation speed for turbine blades, fans, or gears proportional to active power generation.
methods.getInventory: Retrieves the internal item inventory container attached to this furniture or workstation.
methods.createInventoryLayout: Instantiates the MyGUI widget pane layout binding the internal storage grid to the user interface.
methods.canHaveSomeOfThese: Validates whether the specified item type is legally permitted to be stored inside this furniture's inventory.
methods.isAnyInputsEmpty: Virtual hook querying whether raw ingredient input hoppers are starved of supplies.
methods.equipItem: Equipment attachment hook. No-op on furniture instances as furniture does not possess equipment paperdolls.
methods.unequipItem: Equipment removal hook. No-op on furniture instances.
methods.dropItem: Ejects an item or entity from internal storage, dropping it onto the floor adjacent to the furniture.
methods.takeMoney: Transfers monetary currency into or out of the shop counter or merchant till.
methods.getMoney: Queries current monetary currency stored in the merchant's till or settlement treasury.
methods.getDoorLock: Retrieves the security lock mechanism assigned to this container, cage, or machine.
methods.hasDoorLock: Queries whether this furniture possesses an active security lock.
methods.getAnimation: Returns the name of the skeletal animation clip played when a character actively operates this furniture.
methods.getAnimationKO: Returns the animation clip applied when the occupant is unconscious, sleeping, or knocked out.
methods.getAnimationDazed: Returns the animation clip applied when the occupant is crippled, injured, or in medical recovery.
methods.getGUIData: Populates the MyGUI bottom inspection panel with machine state, power status, efficiency meters, and occupant profiles.
methods.getGUIPower: Appends electrical grid statistics, generation/consumption wattages, and battery charge bars to the datapanel.
methods.getGUIEfficiency: Renders operating efficiency percentage meters and tooltip explanations.
methods.getGUIWorkers: Lists active workers operating this station and displays occupant portraits.
methods.getGUIToolTipForGroundResourceEfficiency: Generates contextual tooltips describing ground water, stone, or iron resource fertility underneath this resource extractor.
methods.getGUIPowerEfficiencyToolTipString: Formats a comprehensive diagnostic tooltip explaining why current efficiency is restricted (e.g. lack of power, worker skill, or damage).
methods.threadedUpdate: Performs concurrent background physical simulation updates, integrating battery charge accumulators over elapsed frame time.
methods.needsUpdate: Checks whether this station has dirty state requiring an immediate rendering or simulation update step.
methods.hitByMeleeAttack: Defines physical material collision response when struck by weapons or martial arts attacks.

methods.loadFromSerialise: Restores active machine state, battery charge, door locks, and inventory items from save data.

WallBuilding.description: Defensive wall fortification piece governing perimeter segment connections, rampart walkway placement, shared construction scaffolds, and structural upgrades. Derived from [`Building`](building.md), `WallBuilding` coordinates directly with [`ZoneMapContent`](zonemapcontent.md) for neighboring structural discovery, [`TurretBuilding`](turretbuilding.md) for mounted rampart defenses, and [`DatapanelGUI`](datapanelgui.md) for fortification upgrade and demolition controls.

methods.~WallBuilding: Virtual destructor unlinking adjacent wall segments, releasing shared construction scaffolding, and detaching PhysX static obstacle colliders.
methods.WallBuilding: Primary constructor configuring wall segment geometry, orientation, defensive faction ownership, municipal settlement handle, and initializing scaffold-sharing containers.
methods.addConstructionProgress: Advances engineering construction progress, propagating completed progress to all child segments sharing this segment's build state.
methods.setConstructionProgress: Sets absolute construction completion percentage, updating visual scaffold meshes and material appearance.
methods.notifyConstructionComplete: Triggered when construction reaches 100%, finalizing NavMesh obstacles, enabling rampart walkway navigation, and unhiding fortified parapets.
methods.addDismantleProgress: Applies dismantling progress to demolish the wall segment, recovering recyclable construction materials.
methods.notifyConstructionDismantling: Triggered when wall demolition begins, severing shared scaffolding links and alerting defending garrison units.
methods.getBuildState: Retrieves the active `ConstructionState` structure controlling material delivery and engineer tasks, following shared parent links if joined.
methods.runLinkingCheck: Analyzes adjacent wall segments within the active zone chunk to determine link typology (NORMAL, CONNECTOR, LOWER_WEDGE, SINGLE, SHORT) and share construction scaffolds.
methods.isALittleWallPartLikeACornerOrSomething: Queries whether this segment is a minor transitional piece such as a corner connector, bevel wedge, or joint transition.
methods.isAShortWallPart: Queries whether this segment is classified as a short wall piece bridging small spans between towers or gates.
methods.letsShare: Evaluates proximity and orientation compatibility with an adjacent wall piece, pooling construction material requirements under a unified scaffold.
methods.getReachRange: Returns maximum interaction distance for engineers repairing, upgrading, or dismantling this wall segment.
methods.createPhysical: Instantiates PhysX static rigid bodies and terrain collision obstacles bounding the wall rampart and parapets.
methods.isDamaged: Queries whether the wall segment has sustained structural damage below its maximum health pool.
methods.hitByMeleeAttack: Processes incoming melee attacks against the wall structure, reducing structural hit points and emitting stone/metal impact debris.
methods.upgrade: Initiates a fortification upgrade operation (e.g. Tier 1 Makeshift Wall to Tier 2 Defensive Wall) from a UI button click event.
methods.getGUIUpgrade: Populates the UI DataPanel inspector with upgrade button controls, displaying material costs and research status.
methods.getGUIDestroyButton: Renders the dismantle/destroy button widget in the settlement management UI for player-owned walls.
methods.canUpgrade: Queries available structural upgrade templates for this wall segment, validating technology research prerequisites.
methods.dismantleButton_all: Demolishes the entire continuous connected wall line sharing this construction scaffold.
methods.getUseableStuff: Returns associated `UseableStuff` pointer if wall includes operable rampart machinery (nullptr for passive wall sections).
methods.isForSale: Queries whether the wall structure can be purchased by the player faction (walls are municipal fortifications and cannot be bought).

methods.getOutsideGateCode: Returns navigation side classification code (inside vs outside municipal wall perimeter).

Weapon.description: Weapon represents an equippable weapon item in the game. It extends `Gear` with weapon-specific properties such as attack modifiers, bleed damage, and weapon skill categories.

methods.Weapon: Constructor for the `Weapon` class. Initializes base properties from `Gear` and parses weapon-specific stats from the provided `GameData` definition blocks, including calculating base value, bleed values, and attack modifiers.
methods.~Weapon: Destructor for the `Weapon` class. Cleans up internal structures before falling back to `Gear` destruction.
methods.getItemWeight: Retrieves the weight of the weapon when stored in an inventory. This is calculated using the inventory multiplier during construction.
methods.getCombatWeight: Retrieves the combat weight of the weapon. This weight affects character encumbrance and animation speeds while the weapon is drawn.
methods.getValueSingle: Calculates the actual value of a single instance of this weapon based on whether it is owned by a player and whether it was crafted by a player.
methods.getCraftTime: Calculates the number of game hours required to craft this weapon. Bases its formula on weapon level and base defined item value.
methods.getCraftMaterialMult: Fetches the material cost multiplier defined by the underlying item `GameData`.
methods.getCategory: Gets the primary weapon category this weapon belongs to (e.g., Heavy, Hackers, Katanas). This maps to which skill determines the effectiveness of the weapon.
methods.getCategory_animationOverride: Gets the weapon category used specifically for determining which combat animations to play. Generally mirrors the primary category.
methods.is2HandedOnly: Determines if the weapon requires both hands to wield based on its skill category. Heavy weapons, Bows/Crossbows, and Polearms are always two-handed.
methods.isWeapon: Runtime type identification method returning `this` pointer cast to Weapon. Used safely downcast from `Gear`.
methods.isSword: Runtime type identification method used to check if the weapon is a melee sword. Overridden by subclasses.
methods.isCrossbow: Runtime type identification method returning `this` pointer cast to Crossbow. Overridden by the `Crossbow` subclass.
methods.getSkillModIndoors: Fetches the indoor combat penalty or bonus specific to this weapon type. Base weapon implementation simply returns 0.

ZoneManager.description: Master spatial streaming manager governing the 64x64 continuous world zone grid (4,096 ZoneMap chunks). Coordinates background zone loading threads, distance activation, spatial grids, island topologies, biomes, and terrain splatmaps. Interacts directly with [`ZoneMap`](zonemap.md) for individual sector terrain chunks and foliage, [`BiomeMap`](biomemap.md) for regional environmental palettes, [`Building`](building.md) and [`BuildingFinderClass`](buildingfinderclass.md) for structural spatial queries, and [`Town`](town.md) for settlement chunk registration.

ZoneMap.description: Spatial terrain chunk representing an individual zone tile within Kenshi's continuous 64x64 world grid. Manages heightmap data, PhysX collision sectors, multi-layer biome textures, scent tracking, and dynamic actor population. Coordinates directly with [`ZoneManager`](zonemanager.md) for master grid paging, [`ZoneMapContent`](zonemapcontent.md) for chunk entity instances, [`ZoneSmell`](zonesmell.md) for predator scent trails, and [`MapFeatureList`](mapfeaturelist.md) for static geographical landmarks.

methods.ZoneMap: Primary constructor for `ZoneMap`, zero-initializing chunk coordinate vectors, neighbor pointer arrays, biome list, deactivation timers, and state readers.
methods.init: Initializes chunk spatial coordinates (X, Y) within the 64x64 world grid, calculates corner and center positions, and builds bounding box extents.
methods.initialise: Initializes internal chunk subsystems, checking disk cache presence, initializing scent trails, and configuring background load queues.
methods._activate: Internal activation routine initiating multithreaded chunk streaming, terrain mesh generation, and object population based on camera distance.
methods._dactivateMT: Deactivates chunk on the main thread, unloading dynamic actors, saving modified chunk state if requested, and releasing physics collision shapes.
methods.~ZoneMap: Destructor destroying terrain collision meshes, releasing splatmap overlays, clearing biome allocations, and purging inter-thread message queues.
methods.threadedUpdate: Worker thread update tick: loads terrain heightmaps from disk, deserializes static meshes, and processes procedural foliage.
methods.update: Main thread update tick: consumes messages from the worker thread, updates deactivation countdown timers, and commits loaded scene nodes.
methods.isActive: Queries whether the chunk is currently active in the world simulation.
methods.isActivationType: Checks if chunk was activated under a specific activation category.
methods.getDeactivationCountdown: Returns remaining deactivation countdown timer in seconds before chunk unloads.

methods.isBeingLoadedBT: Checks whether the background worker thread is currently loading assets for this chunk.
methods.isLoadedMT: Queries whether the main thread has fully integrated and finalized the loaded chunk.
methods.isBeingLoadedMT: Queries whether the main thread is currently awaiting background load completion.
methods.getAreaSector: Retrieves pointer to high-level `AreaSector` geographical partition.
methods.getBounds: Retrieves 2D horizontal boundary coordinates of the chunk as a vector (minX, minY, maxX, maxY).
methods.getBoundingBox: Retrieves the 3D axis-aligned bounding box enclosing all terrain and objects within the chunk.
methods.getBoundsMinusUnloadedEdges: Computes chunk bounding extents indented by specified border thickness along edges adjacent to unloaded neighboring chunks.
methods.isWithinBoundsMinusUnloadedEdges: Tests whether a 3D world position falls within chunk boundaries, excluding border margins bordering unloaded neighbor chunks.
methods.getCornerPos: Calculates 3D spatial position of the north-west origin corner of the chunk in world units.

methods.getActiveNeighbours8: Collects up to 8 orthogonal and diagonal adjacent active neighbor chunks.
methods.isANeighbour: Tests whether the specified chunk is an immediate neighbor in the 8-direction adjacency neighborhood.
methods.getTerrainHeight: Samples terrain elevation at specified horizontal (X, Y) world coordinates.
methods.getTerrainHeightWithNormal: Samples terrain elevation and calculates surface normal vector at given horizontal coordinates.
methods.getTerrainSlope: Computes terrain incline slope angle at specified horizontal coordinates.
methods.getTerrainSector: Retrieves the PhysX `TerrainSector` collision mesh instance, optionally forcing construction if unallocated.
methods.isTerrainCollisionLoaded: Queries whether PhysX collision geometry for this terrain sector is resident in memory.
methods._makeSureTerrainHeightmapLoaded: Verifies heightmap data buffer is loaded, triggering synchronous load if missing.
methods.selectBiomes: Evaluates world biome partition map for this sector and populates list of active biome records intersecting the chunk.
methods.getBiomeCount: Retrieves the number of unique biomes intersecting this chunk.
methods.getBiomeData: Retrieves FCS `GameData` template record for the biome at specified index.
methods.getOverlay: Retrieves pointer to `ZoneMapOverlay` managing terrain splatmap textures and multi-layer blending.
methods.getMaterialValues: Extracts terrain shader texture scaling, blend ranges, and absorbance coefficients from biome `GameData`.
methods.getTerrainMaterial_DX11: Compiles and returns DirectX 11 Ogre material instance configured with multi-layer biome texture arrays and splatmap channels.
methods.getBiomeTextureArrayData: Collects texture file paths for biome diffuse and normal maps, populating output list.
methods.createTextureArray: Creates a GPU 2D texture array containing all slice textures for biome layer rendering.
methods.materialCallback: Ogre terrain paging callback invoked to generate LOD terrain materials dynamically for specified bounding volume.
methods.destroyMaterialCallback: Ogre terrain paging callback invoked when quadtree node is unloaded, releasing material instance.
methods.generateNavMeshes: Requests NavMesh generator task to reconstruct navigation tile polygons across chunk terrain and structures.
methods.updateBuildingUsageNodes: Refreshes building entry and usage nodes for all structural entities located within this chunk.

properties.mapContent: Content data container for spawns, items, foliage, and buildings (8 bytes: `0x000`–`0x008`).
properties.mapFeatures: Placed geographical features and landmarks (8 bytes: `0x008`–`0x010`).
properties.zoneSmell: Predator scent and tracking trail manager (8 bytes: `0x010`–`0x018`).
properties.coordinates: 2D zone grid coordinate (X, Y) within the 64x64 world grid (8 bytes: `0x018`–`0x020`).
properties.hasFile: Flag indicating persistent disk chunk file exists.
properties.zoneIncomingMessagesT: Thread-safe inter-thread chunk staging queue (96 bytes: `0x028`–`0x088`).
properties.stateT: Dual-buffer chunk loading state container (48 bytes: `0x088`–`0x0B8`).
properties.terrainCollision: PhysX heightfield collision mesh sector (8 bytes: `0x0B8`–`0x0C0`).
properties.activatedCountdown: Layered deactivation timeout countdown counters (12 bytes: `0x0C0`–`0x0CC`).
properties.AABB: 2D horizontal boundary extents (minX, minY, maxX, maxY) (16 bytes: `0x0E8`–`0x0F8`).
properties.center: World center point Cartesian position vector (12 bytes: `0x0F8`–`0x104`).
properties.biomes: Biome definition descriptors active within zone (24 bytes: `0x108`–`0x120`).
properties.neighbors: Orthogonal adjacent zone neighbors (N, S, E, W) (32 bytes: `0x128`–`0x148`).
properties.neighborsDiagonal: Diagonal adjacent zone neighbors (NE, NW, SE, SW) (32 bytes: `0x148`–`0x168`).
